en.description: Lead humanity’s greatest weapon, the Grey Knights, in this fast-paced turn-based tactical RPG. Root out and purge a galaxy-spanning plague in a cinematic, story-driven campaign, using the tactics and talents of your own personalised squad of Daemonhunters.

games.name: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap
games.description: オークを滅ぼせ！「Deathtrap」では狡猾にトラップを設置する戦略が求められ、三人称視点のカオスな戦闘が繰り広げられる。バトルを重ねるごとに強くなるウォーメイジとなり、ゲームをエンドレスに楽しもう。ソロまたは最大4人で、容赦ないオークの大群を撃退しよう。

en.name: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap
en.description: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap combines chaotic third-person combat with devious trap-laying strategy. Enjoy endless replayability as your War Mage grows stronger through roguelite progression. Repel relentless orc hordes solo or with up to 4 players.

games.name: Far Cry® New Dawn
games.description: 世界が核の恐怖に包まれてから17年… 変わり果てたモンタナ州ホープカウンティで冒険が待っている 仲間を導き、残された資源を狙う 「ハイウェイマン」に立ち向かえ

en.name: Far Cry® New Dawn
en.description: Dive into a transformed vibrant post-apocalyptic Hope County, Montana, 17 years after a global nuclear catastrophe. Lead the fight against the Highwaymen, as they seek to take over the last remaining resources.

games.name: Unfair Flips
games.description: A non-idle clicker game about flipping a coin that hates you. Starting with just a 20% chance of getting heads, can you get ten heads in a row?

en.name: Unfair Flips
en.description: A non-idle clicker game about flipping a coin that hates you. Starting with just a 20% chance of getting heads, can you get ten heads in a row?

games.name: Punch Club 2: Fast Forward
games.description: この激しいファイターマネジメントシミュレーターの続編でトレーニングし、戦い、トップに上り詰めよう！ファイターを指導して、彼を究極のチャンピオンへと育て上げよう！様々な戦闘スタイルから選択肢、ルーチンをコントロールし、誇りある師匠のように、彼の勝利に全力を尽くそう！

en.name: Punch Club 2: Fast Forward
en.description: Train, fight, and rise to the top in this knockout sequel to the smashing fighter management simulator! Mentor your fighter and guide him to become the ultimate champion: choose from different combat styles, control his routine, and watch him kick some butt like a proud sensei!

games.name: ブラスフェマス 2
games.description: 『Blasphemous 2』では、悔悟者は再び「奇蹟」を相手に終わりなき戦いに身を投じる。謎と秘密で満ちた危険な新世界に飛び込み、目の前に立ちはだかる恐ろしい敵を切り裂いて、サイクルを終わらせよう。

en.name: Blasphemous 2
en.description: The Penitent One awakens as Blasphemous 2 joins him once again in an endless struggle against The Miracle. Dive into a perilous new world filled with mysteries and secrets to discover, and tear your way through monstrous foes that stand between you and your quest to end the cycle once and for all.

games.name: Bear and Breakfast
games.description: 可愛らしいクマと楽しい動物たちの物語。まったりとした森のモーテル経営を楽しもう！

en.name: Bear and Breakfast
en.description: Bear and Breakfast is a laid-back management adventure game where you build and run a bed and breakfast...but you’re a bear.

games.name: 30XX
games.description: 跳んで、撃って、切り拓け！ 30XXはローグライトなアクション・プラットフォームゲームです。友達と一緒にプレイできます！ 緑で覆われた千変万化の世界を探検しましょう。正確な操作で跳び移りながら、決死の戦いに勝って道を切り拓いてください。恐ろしいガーディアンを倒し、不思議なパワーを会得しましょう。人類が失った数千年を取り戻すのです。

en.name: 30XX
en.description: Jump, shoot, and slash your way through 30XX, the roguelike action platformer you can play with a friend! Explore lush, ever-changing worlds that mix precise platforming with fevered combat. Destroy fearsome Guardians. Master unique Powers. Rediscover the thousand years we've lost.

games.name: 無名者：屠竜
games.description: 非常に強い且つ厄介な竜を退治するにはどうすれば？ゲームブック風ターン制RPG『無名者：屠竜』 で巨竜と深い恨みを持つ少年になり、その英雄が埋もれ、希望が消えていく世界でいい加減な仲間と出会い、共に強大で陰険、無数の秘密を秘めた敵に立ち向かおう……

en.name: The Nameless: Slay Dragon
en.description: The Nameless: Slay Dragon is like a mix of CRPG and JRPG. In short - how to slay the immensely powerful and cunning evil dragon? You will play as a young man having a bloody feud with a dragon, and face powerful, sinister and tricky enemies with friends....

games.name: NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound
games.description: 『Blasphemous』の開発陣が贈る、クラシック版 「NINJA GAIDEN」 シリーズの新作2Dゲームがついに登場。壮大かつスリリングな戦闘が繰り広げられる忍者アドベンチャーは、王道の横スクロールアクションゲームを次のステージへと引き上げます。

en.name: NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound
en.description: A brand-new side-scrolling entry to the NINJA GAIDEN series from the team behind Blasphemous, NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound redefines the classic platformer saga in a spectacular, thrilling and challenging ninja adventure.

games.name: Eastward（イーストワード）
games.description: 『Eastward』の世界へようこそ！（人口は減っているけれど…）崩壊しつつある世界を冒険して、美しい町や変わった生物、それよりもっと変わった人々を見つけよう。ジョンのフライパンと珊の神秘的な力を駆使して、未知なる旅へ出発しよう…。

en.name: Eastward
en.description: Welcome to the charming world of Eastward - population declining! Journey through a society on the brink of collapse. Discover delightful towns, strange creatures and even stranger people! Wield a trusty frying pan and mystic powers on an adventure into the unknown…

games.name: LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW RePOP
genres: ハックアンドスラッシュ
games.description: 世界で愛された伝説のゾンビハンター・ジュリエットが４K対応でカムバック！

en.name: LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW RePOP
en.description: The chainsaw-wielding cheerleader Juliet Starling returns in Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP!

games.name: Bright Memory
genres: ハックアンドスラッシュ
games.description: 『Bright memory』は個人デベロッパーFYQDがUnreal Engine 4で開発した、FPSとACTを融合したスピード感あふれる作品です。さまざまなスキルや能力を組み合わせ、華麗なコンボを叩き込みましょう。超自然科学研究機構(SRO)に所属するシアの冒険が、今始まります。

trailers.name: 光明记忆最新预告片（英文配音）
光明记忆最新预告片（日文配音）

en.name: Bright Memory
en.description: Bright Memory is a lightning-fast fusion of the FPS and action genres, created by one-man development studio FYQD using Unreal Engine. Combine a wide variety of skills and abilities to unleash dazzling combo attacks.

games.name: Taxi Life: A City Driving Simulator
games.shortName: TAXI LIFE: A CITY DRIVING SIMULATOR
games.description: 愛車と会社のアクセル全開！お客を運んで街を駆け、会社をどんどん大きくしよう！眠らない街バルセロナ。毎日降りかかるチャレンジをクリアして、一流のタクシードライバーを目指そう！

en.name: Taxi Life: A City Driving Simulator
en.description: Climb into the driver's seat of your car and your business, transport passengers across Barcelona and grow your company! Can you help relieve the transportation challenges of a city that never sleeps?

games.name: Infernax
games.description: Infernaxで描かれるのは、ひとりの勇敢な戦士の冒険。物語は邪悪な魔法に蝕まれた故郷へと戦士が帰ってきたことから始まります。呪いの謎を解き、己の行動によって導かれる結末を目にしましょう。

en.name: Infernax
en.description: Infernax is the adventures of a great knight who returns to his homeland only to find it plagued with unholy magic. Uncover the mysteries of the curse and face the consequences of your actions.

games.name: Tank Mechanic Simulator
games.description: Tank Mechanic Simulatorとは第二次世界大戦の戦車、戦車の乗員と彼らが戦記への貢献についてのゲームです。

en.name: Tank Mechanic Simulator
en.description: Renovate & build II World War tanks. Experience highly detailed & realistic simulation game. Take tanks fully apart by using different tools. Transform them from rusty and ruined to fully working. Check them on the training ground, sell or put into your own museum.

games.name: Drill Core
games.description: 『Drill Core』へようこそ！このゲームでは、ビジネスの欲望と戦略的な惑星採掘の融合を楽しめます。労働者を管理し、最先端技術を研究し、エイリアンの攻撃から守りつつ、惑星の中心部まで掘削作業を進めましょう。労働者の安全を無視しながらも効率を優先するのか、生き残りをかけて防御に徹するのか、すべてはあなた次第！

en.name: Drill Core
en.description: Corporate greed meets strategic planet-mining in Drill Core! Drill to the heart of planets while managing workers, researching cutting-edge tech, and fortifying against alien attacks. Will you prioritize efficiency and risk your workers' safety, or focus on defense for survival?

games.name: Crown Trick / 不思议的皇冠
games.shortName: CROWN TRICK / 不思议的皇冠
games.description: 「不思議な王冠」は、ターン制ローグライクのRPGゲームになる。手描き風な美術スタイル、面白味満載な奇妙な冒険中、あなたは数々のダンジョンを練り歩き、危険な敵と出会う。死と成長を繰り返し、果てなき深淵に立ち向かったその先には……

en.name: Crown Trick
en.description: Enter a labyrinth that moves as you move, where mastering the elements is key to defeating enemies and uncovering the mysteries of this underground world. With a new experience awaiting every time you enter the dungeon, let the power bestowed by the crown guide you in this challenging adventure!

games.name: Pioneers of Pagonia
games.description: 霧に覆われ失われた世界に、希望を取り戻そう。 開拓者たちを率いてパゴニアの諸島を巡り、散り散りになった部族をまとめ、豊かな共同体を築き上げよう。 そして、新たなストーリーキャンペーンで、世界を取り戻しながら自分たちの民の歴史を解き明かしていこう。

en.name: Pioneers of Pagonia
en.description: Rebuild hope in a world that was lost in the fog. Lead your Pioneers across the isles of Pagonia, unite scattered tribes, raise thriving communities and discover the history of your people as you reclaim your world in the new story campaign.

games.name: The Crust
games.description: The Crustへようこそ - 月を植民地化する巨大企業の CEO になるゲームです。 豊富な設定とドラマティックな脚本に加えて、サバイバルの要素も取り入れた大規模な経済シミュレーターです。

trailers.name: The Crust - Official Announcement Trailer EN

en.name: The Crust
en.description: Build and automate a lunar colony that Earth depends on. Mine regolith, run conveyor-and-drone factories above and below the surface, manage colonists, trade with rival Earth factions — and play a story campaign with multiple endings.

games.name: Armello
genres: ターン制ストラテジー
games.description: アルメロは不気味な民話の世界をモチーフにしたボードゲームです。奥深く戦術的なカードゲームと、卓上のディープな戦略、RPG要素を組み合わせた、スリル満点の冒険に満ちています。シングルプレイヤーとマルチプレイヤーの戦闘に挑み、呪文をかけ、エージェントを採用し、玉座を目指したクエストで毒や罠を活用しよう！

en.name: Armello
en.description: Armello is a grim fairy-tale board game come to life, with every match combining deep, tactical card play, rich tabletop strategy and RPG elements. Leverage subterfuge, spells and careful strategy to wrangle control of the game's chaotic odds as you quest for the throne.

games.name: Torchlight II
genres: ハックアンドスラッシュ
games.description: 『Torchlight II』で冒険はまだまだ続く！壮大なバトル、たっぷりあるお宝、ランダムに変わるワールドが詰まった充実のアクションRPG。オンラインやLANマルチプレイで友達と一緒に冒険に出かけよう。

en.name: Torchlight II
en.description: The adventure continues in Torchlight II! An Action RPG filled with epic battles, bountiful treasure, and a fully randomized world. Bring your friends along for the journey with online and LAN multiplayer.

games.name: SimRail - The Railway Simulator
games.description: SimRail is new, advanced railway simulator. Master high-speed long-distance EMU, heavy freight hauls and suburban trains. Travel 500 km of geodetic-data based real routes. Become train dispatcher and control the traffic according to the schedule or cooperate with other players on multiplayer mode.

en.name: SimRail - The Railway Simulator
en.description: SimRail is new, advanced railway simulator. Master high-speed long-distance EMU, heavy freight hauls and suburban trains. Travel 500 km of geodetic-data based real routes. Become train dispatcher and control the traffic according to the schedule or cooperate with other players on multiplayer mode.

games.name: Cartel Tycoon
games.description: Cartel Tycoon is a survival business sim inspired by the ‘80s and '90s narco trade. Expand and conquer, fight off rival thugs and evade the authorities. Earn people's loyalty and strive to overcome the doomed fate of a power-hungry drug lord.

trailers.name: Cartel Tycoon 1.0 Release - Official Gameplay Trailer

en.name: Cartel Tycoon
en.description: Cartel Tycoon is a survival business sim inspired by the ‘80s and '90s narco trade. Expand and conquer, fight off rival thugs and evade the authorities. Earn people's loyalty and strive to overcome the doomed fate of a power-hungry drug lord.

games.name: Temtem
genres: クリーチャーコレクター
games.description: 『テムテム』は、モンスター収集オンラインアドベンチャーです。フレンドと7つの島を冒険しながら165種類の個性溢れる生き物をテイムして他のテイマーとバトルしたり、神話の隠れ家に挑戦、ルーマ種とウンブラ種を追いかけ、お気に入りテムを繁殖させましょう！いざ色鮮やかなモンスター収集の冒険へ、テムテムアップ！

en.name: Temtem
en.description: Temtem is an online creature-collection adventure. Tame 165 unique creatures across 7 vibrant islands, battle other tamers, tackle mythical Lairs, chase Luma & Umbra variants, and breed your favorite Tems - with friends by your side! Dive into a colorful monster catching adventure, so Temtem up!

games.name: Selaco
games.description: Selaco is a brand new original shooter inspired by classics, featuring thrilling action set pieces, destructibility, smart enemies and a fleshed out story taking place within an immersive game world.

en.name: Selaco
en.description: Selaco is a brand new original shooter inspired by classics, featuring thrilling action set pieces, destructibility, smart enemies and a fleshed out story taking place within an immersive game world.

games.name: EVERSPACE™
games.description: 『EVERSPACE™』で、ローグライク要素・美しいビジュアル・魅力的なストーリーを織り交ぜたテンポの速い戦闘を体験しよう。変化する美しい宇宙に挑む旅には、驚きが満ちている。勝算のない戦いで、敵を撃ち、資源を集め、装備を作成し、勝利への道を切り開け。

trailers.name: Early Access Launch Trailer 60 fps PEGI

en.name: EVERSPACE™
en.description: EVERSPACE™ combines fast-paced combat with roguelike elements, great visuals and a captivating story. It takes you on a challenging journey through an ever-changing, beautifully crafted universe full of surprises. Shoot, craft and loot your way to victory while the odds are stacked against you.

games.name: ヒンターベルクのダンジョン
games.shortName: ヒンターベルクのダンジョン
games.description: Hinterbergの至る所に潜むモンスターを倒すには、剣と魔法が不可欠。風を操ったり、魔法で空中からスノーボードを出現させたり、ゼリーの塊で敵を凍らせたり…好きな方法で倒していこう！

trailers.name: Dungeons of Hinterberg - New Trailer EN
Dungeons of Hinterberg - IGN FanFest Trailer - Release date

en.name: Dungeons of Hinterberg
en.description: Discover the magic and lore of the Alps in this acclaimed Action Adventure. Forge relationships with locals to help you solve puzzles, battle monsters and uncover secrets of the legendary Dungeons of Hinterberg!

games.name: Orcs Must Die! 3
games.description: 不快なオークたちの大軍を切って、燃やして、放り投げて、ついでに感電させて、すり潰して骨抜きにしてやろう。受賞作品であるOrcs Must Die!シリーズの待望の続編が登場。

en.name: Orcs Must Die! 3
en.description: Slice, burn, toss, zap, grind and gib massive hordes of repugnant orcs in this long-awaited successor to the award-winning Orcs Must Die! series.

games.name: Zero Stress King: Idle Defense
games.description: タワーディフェンスに見せかけた、短くてリラックスできるインクリメンタルゲーム。 敵は城壁にたどり着けません。溶岩のおかげで。

en.name: Zero Stress King: Idle Defense
en.description: A short relaxing incremental game disguised as a tower defense, but enemies can’t reach your walls. Thanks to lava.

games.name: Killer Frequency
games.description: Killer Frequencyは、深夜ラジオ番組の司会者Forrest Nashとしてプレイする1人称ホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。電話をかけてくる人々は、リアルタイムで謎の殺人鬼に追われています。ジュークボックスから流れるレトロな80年代音楽を聴きながら、謎を解き、人命救助し、交換台を操作しましょう！

en.name: Killer Frequency
en.description: Killer Frequency is a first-person horror puzzle game set in 1987, that puts you in the role of a late-night radio talk show host in small town America whose callers are being stalked by a mysterious killer.

games.name: Dwarf Fortress
games.description: 史上最も奥深く、最も複雑に作り込まれた世界のシミュレーションゲーム『Dwarf Fortress』がSteamに登場。要塞を築き、綿密に生成された世界でドワーフが生き残れるよう手を尽くそう。

en.name: Dwarf Fortress
en.description: Build a fortress and try to help your dwarves survive against a deeply generated world. Keep your dwarves happy, grow their community and beware of digging too deeply. The deepest, most intricate simulation of a world that's ever been created.

games.name: Golf With Your Friends
games.description: 友達がいるなら…「みんなでゴルフ」をやらなきゃ意味がない！最大12人で楽しめる、ハイペースでエキサイティングな同時進行の9つのコースでのミニゴルフなら、OBなんてありません！パーティーはまだまだ続きます。早期アクセス中、追加のコースやコンテンツを皆様にお届けする予定予定です！

trailers.name: Golf With Your Friends - Olympus Odyssey Launch Trailer

en.name: Golf With Your Friends
en.description: Why have friends if not to play Golf... With Your Friends! Nothing is out of bounds as you take on courses filled with fast paced, exciting, simultaneous mini golf for up to 12 players!

games.name: Borderlands Game of the Year Enhanced
games.shortName: BORDERLANDS GAME OF THE YEAR ENHANCED
games.description: 協力型ハックアンドスラッシュシューティングの元祖が、豊富な強化要素と共に登場！ それぞれに独自のRPGライクなスキルを持った4人の好戦的な傭兵から好きなキャラクターを選んだら、膨大な種類の武器を手に、砂漠の惑星パンドラで暴れ回ろう！

en.name: Borderlands Game of the Year Enhanced
en.description: Discover the original co-op shooter-looter, crammed with new enhancements! As one of 4 trigger-happy mercenaries with RPG progression, equip bazillions of guns to take on the desert planet Pandora.

games.name: UBOAT
games.description: UBOAT is a simulator of a submarine from WWII era. It is a survival sandbox with crew management mechanics while its primary theme is life of German sailors. The boat is their home, but it can become their grave at any time.

en.name: UBOAT
en.description: UBOAT is a simulator of a submarine from WWII era. It is a survival sandbox with crew management mechanics while its primary theme is life of German sailors. The boat is their home, but it can become their grave at any time.

games.name: Sniper Elite V2 Remastered
games.description: 第2次世界大戦の末期という暗黒時代の中、廃虚と化したベルリンで一つの銃弾が歴史を変えれます… 新機能、現代的なグラフィックと新しいコンテンツが入った受賞ステルスアクション体験のリマスターでエリートスナイパー Karl Fairburne が最前線に戻ってきます。

en.name: Sniper Elite V2 Remastered
en.description: In the dark days of the end of World War 2 amidst the ruins of Berlin, one bullet can change history… Elite sniper Karl Fairburne returns to the front line in the remaster of this award-winning stealth-action experience. Packed with new features, contemporary visuals and definitive content.

games.name: SOS OPS!
games.description: SOS OPS! は単なるゲーム以上です。あなたの任務は市を救うことです。あなたは友達と共に協力してミッションを遂行し、自分自身を狂気の中心に見つけるでしょう。そして、アドレナリンを限界まで高めるでしょう！

en.name: SOS OPS!
en.description: SOS OPS! is more than a game. Your task is to save the city. You will find yourself in the epicenter of madness, where co-op missions with friends will raise the adrenaline to the limit!

games.name: Card Survival: Tropical Island
games.description: Card Survivalはカードを使ったサバイバルゲームです。無人島に取り残されたあなたは、知恵とスキルを駆使して生き延びなければなりません。カードを組み合わせて探索し、資源を集め、便利な道具を作り上げて、なんとしてでも生き残る術を身に着けよう。

en.name: Card Survival: Tropical Island
en.description: Card Survival is a card-based survival experience. Stranded on a desert island you must use your wits and skills to stay alive. Use cards and combine them together to explore, gather resources and craft useful tools.

games.name: ATOM RPG: Post-apocalyptic indie game
games.description: ATOMは、古典的なRPGやゲームブックに影響を受けた、オールドスクールのロールプレイングゲームです。

en.name: ATOM RPG: Post-apocalyptic indie game
en.description: ATOM RPG is a post-apocalyptic indie game, inspired by classic CRPGs: Fallout, Wasteland, Deus Ex, Baldur's Gate and many others.

games.name: The Precinct
games.description: 1983年、アヴェルノ・シティ。ギャングが町を支配したままでは、亡くなった父も安らかには眠れない。ネオン・ノワール・アクションサンドボックス・ポリスゲームで、町を浄化し、真実を明らかにして、破壊可能なオブジェクトに満ちた環境でスリリングな大捕り物を始めよう。

en.name: The Precinct
en.description: Averno City, 1983. Gangs rule the streets and your father lies restless in his grave. Clean up the city, uncover the truth, and embark on thrilling vehicle chases through destructible environments in this neon-noir action sandbox police game.

games.name: Tales from the Borderlands
games.description: 『テイルズ・フロム・ザ・ボーダーランズ』は過酷な環境を持つ惑星パンドラを舞台に『ボーダーランズ2』と『ボーダーランズ3』の間の出来事が描かれる5つのエピソード形式のゲームシリーズです。

trailers.name: Tales from the Borderlands Trailer - EN NR

en.name: Tales from the Borderlands
en.description: Tales from the Borderlands is a five-part episodic game set on the unforgiving world of Pandora between the events of Borderlands 2 and Borderlands 3. This is a story full of Borderlands' trademark humor, following two adventurers on their quest for greatness.

games.name: Terraforming Mars
games.description: The taming of the Red Planet has begun! Corporations are competing to transform Mars into a habitable planet by spending vast resources and using innovative technology to raise temperature, create a breathable atmosphere, and make oceans of water.

en.name: Terraforming Mars
en.description: The taming of the Red Planet has begun! Corporations are competing to transform Mars into a habitable planet by spending vast resources and using innovative technology to raise temperature, create a breathable atmosphere, and make oceans of water.

games.name: WRC 7 FIA World Rally Championship
genres: 乗り物シミュレーション
games.description: 忠実に再現された舞台で、WRCの13のラリーに挑戦。ベストドライバーになりきって、新しい車のステアリングを握ろう。ひとりでもオンラインでも楽しめる。Epic Stagesに参加したり、ウイークリーチャレンジに挑戦したり、プロのようにWRCを体験しよう！

en.name: WRC 7 FIA World Rally Championship
en.description: Take on all the challenges of the 2017 World Rally Championship: the official cars and drivers, 13 countries, 52 Special Stages, every surface, more powerful cars, more demanding physics, longer races, and an eSports mode to keep you on the edge of your seat all year round.

games.name: Car Dealer Simulator
genres: 乗り物シミュレーション
games.description: Uncover a goldmine in the used car market! Sniff out deals, buy low, modify, and sell high. Your journey from amateur grease monkey to car dealer magnate awaits. How fast will you rise in this lucrative venture?

trailers.name: Up 2 You DLC - Release Date Trailer
Car Dealer Simulator - Release Date Trailer
Car Dealer Simulator Free Demo - Release Date Trailer

en.name: Car Dealer Simulator
en.description: Uncover a goldmine in the used car market! Sniff out deals, buy low, modify, and sell high. Your journey from amateur grease monkey to car dealer magnate awaits. How fast will you rise in this lucrative venture?

games.name: No Time to Relax
games.description: 『リラックスしてらんない』はオンライン対戦にも対応した対戦人生シミュレーションゲームである。プレイヤーはCPUやオンライン上の最大3プレイヤーを相手に、出世をしつつも勉学に励み、さらに理性を保たなければならない。

en.name: No Time to Relax
en.description: No Time to Relax is a life simulation game where up to 4 players online or locally compete against each other in the ultimate game of life.

games.name: Transport Fever
games.description: Transport Fever is a railroad-focused tycoon game. Players start in 1850 and build up a thriving transport company. As an emerging transport tycoon, the player constructs stations, airports, harbors and makes money by connecting areas requiring transport services. Build up your own Empire!

en.name: Transport Fever
en.description: Transport Fever is a railroad-focused tycoon game. Players start in 1850 and build up a thriving transport company. As an emerging transport tycoon, the player constructs stations, airports, harbors and makes money by connecting areas requiring transport services. Build up your own Empire!

games.name: Heat Signature
games.description: Heat Signature is a game from the developers of Gunpoint where you break into spaceships, make terrible mistakes, and think of clever ways out of them. You take a mission, fly to the target ship, sneak inside, and make clever use of your gadgets to distract, ambush and take out the crew.

en.name: Heat Signature
en.description: Heat Signature is a game from the developers of Gunpoint where you break into spaceships, make terrible mistakes, and think of clever ways out of them. You take a mission, fly to the target ship, sneak inside, and make clever use of your gadgets to distract, ambush and take out the crew.

games.name: Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition
games.description: 廃墟と化した夢の惑星ステージアに不時着し、生き残りか復讐かの選択に迫られるグレイソン・ハント。 廃墟と化した夢の惑星ステージアに不時着し、生き残りか復讐かの選択に迫られるグレイソン・ハント。

trailers.name: Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition Accolades Trailer - PEGI
Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition Story Trailer - PEGI

en.name: Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition
en.description: Step into the boots of Grayson Hunt after a crash landing on an old resort planet forces him to make a hard choice: survival or revenge. Execute masterful kills with Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition’s unique combat system that rewards you for performing the most creative and deadly kills imaginable.

games.name: Ithya: Magic Studies
genres: デスクトップコンパニオン
games.description: 『Ithya: Magic Studies』 は、生産性ツールを備えた、心安らぐ作業用アプリです。手描きの美しい空間でお部屋をカスタマイズしながら、lofiや幻想的なプレイリストに耳を傾けてリラックス。魔法の世界で、集中した作業や創造的な時間を過ごしましょう。

en.name: Ithya: Magic Studies
en.description: Ithya: Magic Study is a cozy background app combined with productivity tools. Customize your room and relax with lofi or fantasy playlists in beautiful, hand-drawn environments. Perfect for a focused or creative session in a magical world.

games.name: SAND: Raiders of Sophie
games.description: 1910年のもう一つの世界で、巨大な「トランプラー」に乗ってソフィーの砂漠を探索せよ。高度にカスタマイズ可能な移動基地を建設し、ソロまたはチームで出撃。戦利品や武器、貴重なアーティファクトを集め、歴史と混沌が生んだプロシージャル生成の過酷な砂漠で他のプレイヤーと衝突せよ。

en.name: SAND: Raiders of Sophie
en.description: In SAND you build your highly customizable walking mech fortress. Squad up or go solo. Scavenge the dunes, gather loot, weapons, priceless artifacts, survive and extract. Clash with other players in a brutal procedurally generated desert set in an alternate 1910.

games.name: Trepang2
games.description: 筋金入りのワルになれ。FPS『Trepang2』は、遠い未来を舞台に繰り広げる血なまぐさいアクション満載のFPSゲーム。ハードコアかつ熱狂的なシューティングで敵を完膚なきまでに叩きのめし、銃弾を回避し、破壊の爪痕を残していこう。

en.name: Trepang2
en.description: Become the ultimate badass in Trepang2: A gory, action-packed FPS set in the near future. Unleash all hell on your enemies, dodge bullets and leave a trail of destruction in this hardcore and frenetic shooter.

games.name: WRC 8 FIA World Rally Championship
games.description: 史上最高の完成度を誇る本格的な公式WRCシミュレーションゲーム。全路面で一新されたオフロード物理演算、完全に再設計されたキャリアモード、ダイナミックな天候、50チーム、14カ国での開催、100コース、ウィークリーチャレンジに eSports モード…

en.name: WRC 8 FIA World Rally Championship
en.description: The most complete and authentic official WRC simulation yet. New physics for all surfaces, a completely redesigned career mode, dynamic weather conditions, 50 teams, 14 countries, 100 tracks, weekly challenges and an eSports mode…

games.name: Echo Point Nova
games.description: 『Echo Point Nova』は、圧倒的な自由度とスリル満点のスピード感が楽しめるオープンワールドFPSです。シングルプレイとCO-OPプレイに対応しています。『Severed Steel』の開発チームによって制作されました。

en.name: Echo Point Nova
en.description: Echo Point Nova is an open-world FPS that offers unparalleled freedom and thrilling speed. Designed for both singleplayer and coop. From the creators of Severed Steel.

games.name: Sniper Elite 3
games.description: スナイパーエリート3はステルスゲームプレイ、リアリスティックな弾道特性と巨大なオープンレベルを持つ戦術的な第二次世界大戦サードパーソンシューティングゲームです。

en.name: Sniper Elite 3
en.description: Sniper Elite 3 is a tactical third-person shooter that combines stealth, gameplay choice and genre-defining ballistics with huge, open levels and the exotic terrain of World War 2 North Africa.

games.name: 『ゴルフ PGAツアー 2K25』
games.description: 『ゴルフ PGAツアー 2K25』で最高のショットを決めて、栄光を掴め！「ゴルフ PGAツアー 2K」シリーズ初登場の3つの権威あるメジャートーナメントで競い合おう。進化したMyCAREER、MyPLAYER、コースデザイナーでは多彩なカスタマイズが可能。ランク、カジュアル、クロスプラットフォームのマルチプレイで、フレンドと対戦しよう。

trailers.name: PGA TOUR 2K25 - Launch Trailer - EN - No Rating

en.name: PGA TOUR 2K25
en.description: Take your best shot at glory in PGA TOUR 2K25! In a 2K-first, compete in three prestigious major tournaments. Personalize your game with expanded MyCAREER, MyPLAYER and Course Designer options. Challenge friends across ranked, casual, and cross-platform multiplayer.

games.name: CaseCracker（ケースクラッカー）
games.description: 余計な映像演出はない。あるのは、極限まで頭脳を刺激する推理だけ。複雑に絡み合う手掛かりの中から自ら情報を探し出し、照合を重ね、一本ずつ真相への糸をたぐり寄せていく。文字だけで挑むハードコア推理では、悪魔は常に細部に潜んでいる。さあ、名探偵。準備はできているか？

en.name: CaseCracker
en.description: No flashy visuals, just pure mental gymnastics. Actively search, cross-reference, and unravel the truth from a complex database. In this hardcore text-based deduction game, the devil is always in the details. Detective, are you ready?

games.name: Hello Neighbor 2
games.description: 『Hello Neighbor 2』は、不気味な隣人たちの秘密を探るステルスホラーゲームです。しかし、それよりも大変なことは、その隣人が高度なAIによって操作されるということです！あなたは隣人たちを出し抜き、彼らが隠しているものを見つけ出すことができるでしょうか？

trailers.name: Hello Neighbor 2 - Halloween Update Gameplay Trailer

en.name: Hello Neighbor 2
en.description: Welcome back to the eerie town of Raven Brooks! You play as Quentin, a journalist investigating the bizarre events of the original Hello Neighbor game, uncovering a larger mystery. Sneak into your creepy Neighbors’ houses to dig up the truth.

games.name: JOHN GLEEP
games.description: ジョン・グリープは、小さな宇宙人。しかし抱えている問題はとてつもなく大きい。 経営するカジノは大失敗、しかも宇宙マフィアに銀河ひとつ分の借金をしている。解決策は？ 惑星から惑星へ飛び回り、住民たちをさらうことで客を増やし、借金を返済し、そして破綻した結婚生活を立て直すこと。これが何でもありの銀河規模のアクション × ローグライクゲームの組み合わせ！

en.name: JOHN GLEEP
en.description: JOHN GLEEP is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

games.name: バブルガム ギャラクシー
games.shortName: バブルガム ギャラクシー
games.description: 『バブルガム ギャラクシー』は、リラックスして遊べるカジュアルな銀河再建ゲームです。惑星創りデザイナーの実習生として出社したあなたは、初日に銀河のデータが消えてしまうピンチに陥ってしまいます。仕事仲間と友情を築きながら、多彩な銀河を再建するのがあなたの役目です！

en.name: Bubblegum Galaxy
en.description: Bubblegum Galaxy is a cozy narrative building game about rebuilding the galaxy tile by tile. Discover and design new planets, complete missions, explore your office and befriend your co-workers... all while trying to find out who deleted the galaxy!

games.name: Heartreasure: Stellar Journey
games.description: ギミックを解きながら、しかけ絵本のような宇宙でハートを探そう！手描きイラスト、可愛いアニメーション、やさしいピアノ演奏で癒しのひととき🚀✨

en.name: Heartreasure: Stellar Journey
en.description: Solve puzzles and hunt for hearts in an interactive picture book universe! Take a load off, with hand-drawn illustrations, adorable animations and gentle live-recorded piano music.

games.name: Drawquarium ドロークアリウム
games.shortName: DRAWQUARIUM ドロークアリウム
genres: デザイン＆イラストレーション
games.description: 自分で描いた魚たちと、ほっこり癒やされる小さな水槽を作ろう。アニメーションするデスクトップ壁紙にもできるよ！ 絵が動き出す様子を眺め、餌をあげて育てながら金のウロコを集め、新しい飾りを解放しよう。集中やリラックスに役立つ便利なツールもあるよ。

en.name: Drawquarium
en.description: Draw your very own fish and build a cozy little aquarium. And if you like, set it as your animated desktop wallpaper! Watch your drawings come to life. Feed them, raise them and collect golden scales to unlock new decorations. There's also some handy tools to help you focus and unwind.

games.name: Bottled by Bears
genres: クリーチャーコレクター
games.description: クマの家族と一緒に、ブンブン賑やかな、小さなおはちみつ農園を経営しましょう！ このほのぼの放置ゲームで、珍しいハチを集め、はちみつを瓶に詰め、農園を大きくして、畑に咲き誇る花々を眺めましょう。

en.name: Bottled by Bears
en.description: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

games.name: Scawy Game
games.description: ケングイン・スティングは、自分の傑作を書くために安いアセットストア製の家を買った売れないホラー作家です。彼の仕事はひとつだけ。猫に餌をやること。ついでにおばあちゃんに薬を飲ませること。そして4日間と4つの夜を生き延びること。ばかばかしいパロディホラーゲームです。

en.name: Scawy Game
en.description: Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer, buys a cheap asset-store house to write his masterpiece. His only job: feed the cats. And keep Grandma on her pills. And survive 4 days and 4 nights. An absurd parody horror game.

games.name: 犬の夢
games.description: あなたの第六感を試してみてください。 野ウサギを食べるか、それとも人を線路に縛りつけるか…。 すべてはあなたの選択次第。 悪夢の中で笑えることを願っています。

en.name: a Dogs Dream
en.description: Test your sixth sense. Will you eat a wild rabbit, or tie someone to the train tracks? Every choice is yours to make. May you find a reason to laugh inside your nightmares.

games.name: 脱毛サロンシミュレーター
games.shortName: 脱毛サロンシミュレーター
genres: 職業シミュレーション
games.description: 自分だけの最強脱毛サロンを作り上げよう！本作は、男性専用サロンを経営するシミュレーションゲーム。最新の医療用レーザーを駆使して、お客様の濃い体毛を焼き尽くそう！お客様の痛みの限界ギリギリを攻め、財布の中身を見て最適な高額ケアプランを売り込み、稼いだ金で設備を強化し、スタッフを雇用。小さな店を、漢がつるつるになる聖地へと、一歩ずつ成長させていこう！

trailers.name: リリース日発表トレーラー
公式ゲームプレイトレーラー

en.name: Hair Removal Salon Simulator
en.description: Run a men's hair removal salon! Zap body hair with a laser, watch the pain meter, and pitch aftercare packages for every budget. Earn good reviews to bring in new clients, then use your profits to upgrade your gear, hire staff, and make your shop the go-to spot for hairy hunks.

games.name: Wildsite
genres: オープンワールドサバイバルクラフト
games.description: Crash-land in a sci-fi survival craft game set on a planet plagued by toxic plasma storms. Alongside Bob, your sarcastic Virtual Sidekick, build and shrink your base to move it anywhere. Fight with primitive or plasma weapons, solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op!

en.name: Wildsite
en.description: Crash-land in a sci-fi survival craft game set on a planet plagued by toxic plasma storms. Alongside Bob, your sarcastic Virtual Sidekick, build and shrink your base to move it anywhere. Fight with primitive or plasma weapons, solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op!

games.name: Number Machine: 数学工場
games.description: Number Machineは、数学的なメカニクスを特徴とするオープンエンド型の工場経営と自動化ゲームです。複雑な数値構造を自動的に組み立て、配送する工場を設計、建設、最適化します。Opus MagnumとInfinifactoryから着想を得た作品です。

en.name: Number Machine: Math Factory
en.description: Number Machine is an open-ended factory and automation game with math mechanics. Design, build, and optimize factories that automatically assemble and deliver complex numerical structures. Inspired by Opus Magnum and Infinifactory.

games.name: テニスの王子様　ぎゅ～っと！ ドキドキサバイバル Tie break ♡ game
games.shortName: テニスの王子様 ぎゅ～っと！ ドキドキサバイバル TIE BREAK ♡ GAM
genres: 恋愛シミュレーション
games.description: 中学テニス全国大会を間近に控えた夏のある日。 絶海の孤島に強化合宿へ向かう選手達と同じ船に乗り合わせたあなたとその友人は突然の嵐に遭遇し、無人島に漂着してしまう。 必要最低限の道具しかない閉鎖空間でサバイバル生活を強いられるあなたと選手達。 果たして、無事に脱出することはできるのだろうか――？

en.name: The Prince of Tennis Doki Doki Survival ~eternal passion! Tie break ♡ game~
en.description: One summer day, just before the national junior tennis tournament, you and your friend board the same ship as players heading to a training camp. A sudden storm leaves you all stranded on a deserted island, where survival becomes unavoidable.

games.name: 一口ちょうだい！
genres: ローカルマルチプレイヤー
協力プレイキャンペーン
games.description: 「命がけ」の惑星へようこそ！『一口ちょうだい！』では、落ちてくる食べ物をキャッチして腹ペコのモンスターたちに食べさせないと、逆にキミが食べられてしまいます！ゲームはシングル、2人協力、対戦モードに対応。友達を誘って、このドタバタなエサやりアドベンチャーを生き残りましょう！

trailers.name: One More Plate! - Launch Trailer JP

en.name: One More Plate!
en.description: Feed your fellow Shape Buddies to a bizarre cast of Glutton Monsters before they put you on the menu. Catch, balance and fling food with absurd, anything-but-proper plates — solo, or 2 players on one PC or via Steam Remote Play Together. Everything obeys physics; nothing obeys you.

games.name: Cake & Bake
games.description: 人生の特別な瞬間をお祝いするお客様のために、素敵なケーキを焼き、デコレーションして、最高の状態でお届けしましょう。すべての注文をあなた好みにカスタムし、新しい食材や飾り付けでベーカリーをどんどん広げていけます。時間や焦りに縛られることなく、あなた自身の心地よいペースで、街で一番あたたかくて可愛いケーキ屋さんを作ってみませんか？

en.name: Cake & Bake
en.description: Bake, decorate, and serve beautiful cakes for customers celebrating life's special moments. Customize every order, expand your bakery with new ingredients and decorations, and create the coziest cake shop in town at your own relaxing pace.

games.name: メジャーマン
games.description: 『メジャーマン』は、プラットフォームアクションとパズルを組み合わせたゲームです。手にしたメジャーを巧みに使い、数々の謎で構成された巨大な迷宮を探索しましょう。メジャーは足場にも、道を切り開く鍵にもなります。さらに、さまざまな使い方を発見できます。

en.name: Tape Man
en.description: Tape Man is a puzzle platformer full of hidden mechanics. Throw your tape measure and set off into a vast maze built out of puzzles. The tape measure can serve as both a platform to stand on and a key to opening new paths — and it can do a lot more than that. You'll just have to find out.

games.name: Catalyst Core
games.description: あらゆる行動が次のリアクションにつながる、グリッドベースのローグライクデッキ構築ゲーム。デッキを組み、エレメンタルコアを集め、強力な元素コンボを連鎖させて敵を倒そう。

en.name: Catalyst Core
en.description: A grid-based roguelike deckbuilder where every move sets up your next reaction. Build your deck, collect Elemental Cores and chain powerful elemental combos to defeat your enemies.

games.name: We March as One
games.description: Start with a few shapes and build an army tens of thousands strong. Paint your troops onto the battlefield and send them to war against enormous hordes in this incremental auto battler where every unit is individually simulated.

en.name: We March as One
en.description: Start with a few shapes and build an army tens of thousands strong. Paint your troops onto the battlefield and send them to war against enormous hordes in this incremental auto battler where every unit is individually simulated.

games.name: Chocolate Parade / チョコレートパレード
games.shortName: CHOCOLATE PARADE / チョコレートパレード
games.description: ”最強スイーツたちの重火器ズババババトル！” 「チョコレートパレード」はスイーツを転がし重火器をぶっ放すハチャメチャなローグライクアクションです！ プレイヤー（ソロまたは協力プレイ）は自分だけのパレードを作り、ボスラッシュが巻き起こる戦場でのコイン争奪戦に挑みます！

en.name: Chocolate Parade
en.description: A heavy-weapon battle between the mightiest sweets! "Chocolate Parade" is a crazy roguelike action game where you roll sweets and unleash heavy weapons! Players (solo or co-op) can create their own parade and compete for coins on a boss-rush battlefield!

games.name: ムーミン：ムーミン谷の夏まつり
games.shortName: ムーミン：ムーミン谷の夏まつり
games.description: ムーミントロールと一緒に、心あたたまる冒険へ。本作は、トーベ・ヤンソンの『ムーミン谷の夏まつり』に着想を得た作品です。ムーミントロールやリトルミイと力を合わせ、大洪水から逃れ、離ればなれになった仲間を探し、ムーミン谷への帰り道を見つけましょう。

trailers.name: 発売日は発表トレーラー
Steam トレーラー（Moomin: Midsummer Madness）

en.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
en.description: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.

games.name: Paystreak: A Gold Mining Tycoon
games.description: Paystreak is a top-down gold mining tycoon about running your own modern day gold rush. Take over a small claim, start by hand, and reinvest every ounce into machines, crews, and new land. Sell when the price is right and turn a struggling camp into a mining empire.

en.name: Paystreak: A Gold Mining Tycoon
en.description: Paystreak is a top-down gold mining tycoon about running your own modern day gold rush. Take over a small claim, start by hand, and reinvest every ounce into machines, crews, and new land. Sell when the price is right and turn a struggling camp into a mining empire.

games.name: The Devil's Due
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: あなたは悪魔とポーカーで対決し、魂を失った。地獄の奥底に囚われたあなたに唯一残された希望は、戦い、自由を取り戻すこと。さまざまな怪物たちが不可能に近いポーカーバトルを挑んでくる。だが幸い、あなたは──イカサマ師だ。

en.name: The Devil's Due
en.description: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.

games.name: Ultima™ I: The First Age of Darkness
games.shortName: ULTIMA I: THE FIRST AGE OF DARKNESS
games.description: 初代「Ultima I」は、ファンタジーRPGに新たな基準を確立した画期的な作品でした。暗黒時代の第一時代へと遡り、「Ultima」の年代記における原初のクエストに挑みましょう。

en.name: Ultima™ I: The First Age of Darkness
en.description: The original Ultima I was a pioneering product that established new standards in fantasy role-playing games. Journey back to the First Era of the Dark Ages and embark on the original quests of the Ultima chronicles.

games.name: DEADBOOT
games.description: 『DEADBOOT』は、レトロでハイテンポなローグライクFPS。武器や強化アイテムを集めながら、ランダムに生成されるステージを突破し、ネオンが光るこのデッドゾーンで自分の限界に挑戦しよう。

en.name: DEADBOOT
en.description: DEADBOOT is a fast-paced retro roguelike FPS. Blast through randomized levels, scavenge weapons and upgrades along the way, and see how far you can make it in this neon death zone.

games.name: Satelital
games.description: エイリアンが遺したシンボルをグリッド上に配置し、法則を発見していくパズルゲーム。雰囲気たっぷりの太陽系を旅しながら、その謎をあなた自身の手で解き明かしていく。

en.name: Satelital
en.description: A rule-discovery puzzle game where you place alien symbols on a grid. Uncover their logic as you journey through an atmospheric solar system.

games.name: スプラット・パチンコ
games.shortName: スプラット・パチンコ
games.description: 愛する彼女を救うため、恋に燃えるエイリアンが銀河を駆ける！ピクセルアートで描かれる、カオスなパチンコローグライク。敵の惑星めがけて目弾を発射し、奇想天外な変異型をアンロックして強烈なコンボを作り出せ。

en.name: Splatchinko
en.description: Play as a lovestruck alien in this chaotic roguelike pachinko in pixel art! Launch your EYES across hostile planets, unlock bizarre mutations and build devastating combos as you tear through the galaxy to rescue your beloved.

games.name: Calmaria: Wild Growth
games.description: Build and automate your settlement in this island survival game, play solo or with friends, but it’s better with friends! Start by tilling the soil and planting your first crops, delegate tasks to your settlers. Sail to new islands, loot dungeons, and prepare your defenses for the next wave.

en.name: Calmaria: Wild Growth
en.description: Build and automate your settlement in this island survival game, play solo or with friends, but it’s better with friends! Start by tilling the soil and planting your first crops, delegate tasks to your settlers. Sail to new islands, loot dungeons, and prepare your defenses for the next wave.

games.name: The Staring Man | 凝視男
games.description: 日本のコンビニを舞台にした一人称ホラーゲーム。深夜、一人で夜勤をするあなた。道路の向こうには、毎晩こちらを見つめる男が立っている。不可解な出来事に遭遇し、過去に姿を消した店員の謎を追う。

en.name: The Staring Man | 凝視男
en.description: A first-person horror game set in a Japanese convenience store. You work the night shift alone. Across the street, a man stands staring at you every night. As you encounter inexplicable events, you investigate the mystery of a former employee who disappeared.

games.name: 重生2我独自逆袭 Re2 I Rise Alone
games.shortName: 重生2我独自逆袭 RE2 I RISE ALONE
genres: 恋愛シミュレーション
フルモーションビデオ
games.description: Interactive movie‑game blending SLG gameplay and real‑life romance simulation: Step into the shoes of an underdog and live out a power‑fantasy rags‑to‑riches story. Combat, character progression, drinking and romance — all in one! 100‑GB content volume- redefines your power‑fantasy experience!

en.name: Re2 I Rise Alone
en.description: Interactive movie‑game blending SLG gameplay and real‑life romance simulation: Step into the shoes of an underdog and live out a power‑fantasy rags‑to‑riches story. Combat, character progression, drinking and romance — all in one! 100‑GB content volume- redefines your power‑fantasy experience!

games.name: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure
genres: 精密プラットフォーム
games.description: 『Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure』は、精密な操作が鍵を握るピクセルアートの2Dプラットフォームアクション。浮遊砲でスイッチを撃ち、足場を動かし、能力アイテムを消費してダッシュ。使える回数や方向、距離はアイテムごとに異なります。仕掛けだらけの地下世界でルートを見極め、発電所を再起動し、AI「Deus」が語らない秘密を解き明かそう。

en.name: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure
en.description: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a pixel-art precision platformer. Fire your floating cannon to trigger switches and move platforms. Grab items to dash with varying charges, directions and distances. Chart a path underground, restart power stations, and uncover the AI Deus's secrets.

games.name: Towers of Babble
games.description: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.

en.name: Towers of Babble
en.description: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.

games.name: Greedy
games.description: アライグマになってお宝を持ち帰る、1～8人用の協力型エクストラクションゲーム。おバカなホラーにローグライト要素をプラス！自動生成の遺跡でお宝を漁り、遺物を回収し、仲間と強大なボスを倒してNPCを救い出そう…その間も、強欲の悪魔マモンは仲間同士の信頼を試してくる。

en.name: Greedy
en.description: A raccoon co-op extraction game for 1-8 players, blending goofy horror with a roguelite twist. Loot procedural ruins, extract relics, defeat powerful bosses and rescue NPCs together… All while Mammon, the Greed Demon, tests your trust in each other.

games.name: Bullet Meltdown
genres: ハックアンドスラッシュ
games.description: 死が永久に失われる、アドレナリン全開の弾幕サバイバル。個性豊かな仲間を雇って育成し、950種類以上の武器を発見しながら、敵の大群やボスと戦おう。プレイするたびに強くなれるが、チームが全滅すれば仲間は永遠に失われる。

trailers.name: Steam Next Fest Trailer - Bullet Meltdown

en.name: Bullet Meltdown
en.description: An adrenaline-pumping bullet heaven where death is permanent. Hire and evolve unique companions, discover 950+ weapon variations, and fight through swarms of enemies and bosses. Grow stronger every run, but if your team falls, they're gone for good.

games.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
games.description: Brew potions, compete with fellow alchemists, and save the magical world from destruction in the digital adaptation of the beloved board game.

en.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
en.description: Brew potions, compete with fellow alchemists, and save the magical world from destruction in the digital adaptation of the beloved board game.

games.name: Powder Park: Ski Resort Builder
games.description: 山を形づくり、リフトとジャンプ台を設置。そして自分で滑る——ひとりでも、友達とでも。『Ski Resort Tycoon』オリジナル開発者のひとりが贈る、ほっこりスキーリゾート建設ゲーム。

en.name: Powder Park: Ski Resort Builder
en.description: Shape the mountain. Build the lifts and jumps. Then ride it yourself, solo or with friends. A cozy ski resort builder from one of the original creators of Ski Resort Tycoon.

games.name: Combustor
games.description: Gas reaction simulator. Build the ultimate jet engine, solve puzzles, or just make everything explode!

en.name: Combustor
en.description: Gas reaction simulator. Build the ultimate jet engine, solve puzzles, or just make everything explode!

games.name: Frankenmine
games.description: 呪われた墓を掘り進み、骨や肉、さまざまな資源を集め、ゼロから自分だけのクリーチャーを作り上げるインクリメンタルゲーム。強力なアーティファクトを発見し、ユニークな組み合わせを試しながら、少しずつ命を吹き込もう。

en.name: Frankenmine
en.description: An incremental game where you dig through cursed tombs, harvest bones, flesh, and various resources; stitch together your own creature from nothing. Discover powerful artifacts, experiment with unique combinations, and bring your creation to life—piece by piece.

games.name: Progress98
genres: デスクトップコンパニオン
games.description: 満足感と達成感に満ちた、レトロなデスクトップ放置型インクリメンタルゲーム。建前はかなぐり捨てて、あなたが最も求める純粋な進捗を手に入れよう！アクティブにプレイして進捗を加速させるもよし、他のことをしている間に、バックグラウンドでゆっくりと進めるもよし。ストレスなし、進捗あるのみ。

en.name: Progress98
en.description: A satisfying incremental idle game that drops the pretense to give you pure unadulterated progress. Boost, earn bonuses and buy upgrades to speed up your progress or take it easy and let it make progress by itself while you make progress elsewhere. No stress, only progress!

games.name: 恋爱，我就借走咯
genres: インタラクティブフィクション
games.description: 恋愛レンタルADV『恋愛、借りちゃいました』好評発売中！

en.name: 恋爱，我就借走咯
en.description: 为了筹集妹妹高昂的学费，守财奴男主新海幸意外踏入了名为「人才租赁」的奇妙行当。在扮演男友、密友乃至情夫的虚假契约掩护下，少女们不为人知的隐秘欲望与真实心声悄然绽放。以金钱维系的脆弱羁绊终将遭遇现实的考验，当这层层伪装剥落时，究竟会是财尽缘散，还是假戏真做呢？一场充满谎言与心跳的青春恋爱喜剧就此上演。

games.name: After the Wane
games.description: 舞台で脚光を浴びることを夢見るレナ。だが、頭の中の声には別の思惑がある。ダンスに懸ける夢、恋、家族の謎、そしてオカルトの誘い。あなたの運命へと続く道はいくつにも分かれ、複雑に入り組んでいる。レナ、マグダレナ、それともマドレーヌ……幕が下りるとき、あなたは誰になっているだろうか。

en.name: After the Wane
en.description: Lena wants to step into the limelight, but the voice in her head has other plans. Between artistic ambitions, romance, family mysteries and the call of the occult, the ways toward your destiny are multiple and tortuous. Lena, Magdalena ou Madeleine… Who will you be when the curtain falls?

games.name: Zombie Hamsters
games.description: あなたたちは、危険な研究所に閉じ込められた小さなゾンビハムスター。脱出口を探し、ハチャメチャな能力を試し、思いっきり大暴れしよう！脱出するたびに、まったく違う展開が待っている。ヒントは一切なし！目標はただ一つ。果たして、無事に脱出できるのか？

en.name: Zombie Hamsters
en.description: You're tiny zombie hamsters trapped in a dangerous laboratory. Find a way out, experiment with crazy abilities, and unleash chaos. Every escape is unique. No hints! Just one goal and one challenge — can you escape?

games.name: SNIP SNAP
games.description: 撮って、切って、貼って！オンラインパーティーゲーム。カラフルな3Dの世界で写真を撮り、切り抜いて貼り合わせて、ラウンドで求められるものを作ろう。そのあとは作品に投票して、誰が何を作ったかを当てよう。絵心は不要！

trailers.name: SNIP SNAP ゲームプレイトレーラー

en.name: SNIP SNAP
en.description: Snap it. Snip it. Stick it. An online party game: take photos in a colorful 3D world, cut them up and stick the pieces together to make what the round asks for. Then vote and guess who made what. No drawing skills needed.

games.name: No Love No Money
games.description: Love or Money? Or destroy them both? No Love No Money is a comedy visual novel that starts as a school dating sim and ends with a socialist revolution. Or maybe not.

en.name: No Love No Money
en.description: Love or Money? Or destroy them both? No Love No Money is a comedy visual novel that starts as a school dating sim and ends with a socialist revolution. Or maybe not.

games.name: Logic Arrows
games.description: 『Logic Arrows』は、論理ゲートから本格的なコンピューターまで、さまざまな回路を自由に設計できるサンドボックスゲームです。シンプルな要素を組み合わせて複雑なシステムを構築し、設計上の課題に挑みながら、デジタル論理の仕組みを学びましょう。

en.name: Logic Arrows
en.description: Logic Arrows is a sandbox game where you design your own mechanisms: from logic gates to an entire computer. Use simple elements to build complex systems, solve engineering challenges and master computer logic.

games.name: Pig King
games.description: ピッグキングの座を巡る戦いが始まった！最大 4 人のプレイヤーが参加する、アリーナ形式のパーティーバトルゲームで頂点を目指そう。

en.name: Pig King
en.description: The battle for the pig throne has begun! Fight your way to the top in this arena party brawler for up to 4 players.

games.name: One More Adventure
games.description: One More Adventure is a hexcrawl roguelike inspired by Nethack and Castle of the Winds. It is part of the Old School Renaissance (OSR), and has heavy influences from TTRPGs from the 1970s and 1980s. Each world map and dungeon is new, allowing for a high amount of replayability.

en.name: One More Adventure
en.description: One More Adventure is a hexcrawl roguelike inspired by Nethack and Castle of the Winds. It is part of the Old School Renaissance (OSR), and has heavy influences from TTRPGs from the 1970s and 1980s. Each world map and dungeon is new, allowing for a high amount of replayability.

games.name: Abracademia
genres: デスクトップコンパニオン
人生シミュレーション
games.description: 魔法使いになろう！ 訓練さえ受けりゃ、そんじょそこらの奴よりすごくなるタイプのね！ Abracademiaは作業や他のゲームの間に画面端で動き続ける、ほのぼの系魔法学園放置ゲームです。寮選び、日々の勉強に呪文の練習、友達作りに冒険と……やることはいっぱい！ 来たる試験の日を乗り越えて、卒業を目指そう！

en.name: Abracademia
en.description: Become a wizard, and a thumping good one! Abracademia is a cozy mage idle life-sim that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play. Pick a coven, manage your daily routine, learn spells, make friends, embark on adventures, and pass exams on your way to graduation.

games.name: Pidgeon Pocket
games.description: かわいいピクセルアートでまったり遊べる、ほっこりインクリメンタル。あり得ないほど愛らしいハトの群れで、にぎやかな公園を狙ってコインを持ち帰り、アップグレードに使いましょう。 どのハトにも専用のスーパーパワーがあります。飛んで、集めて、強化して。

en.name: Pidgeon Pocket
en.description: A cozy incremental with beautiful pixel art and a flock of adorable pigeons. Aim at a busy park, bring the coins home and spend them on upgrades. Every pigeon gets its own superpower. Swoop, collect, upgrade.

games.name: Dub Party
genres: フルモーションビデオ
games.description: 声優気分で動画を吹き替えるパーティーゲーム。好きな動画クリップに友達とアフレコ。役を決めて、ブースで1セリフずつ録音し、みんなでプレミア上映。ソファではスマホから参加して録音するか、1本のマイクを回し、オンラインは最大16人で5つのパーティーゲームを遊べます。

en.name: Dub Party
en.description: A voice acting party game: dub any video clip with your friends. Claim the roles, record every line in the booth, then watch the premiere together. On the couch, friends join and record from their phones, or one mic goes round. Online, up to 16 players and five party games.

games.name: Boss in Diapers
games.description: Boss in Diapersは、カオスな保育園を舞台にしたパーティーゲーム！ ライバルを蹴散らしてボスチェアに座れ。小さなトラブルメーカーを作り、2〜4人で保育園の支配者を目指そう。

en.name: Boss in Diapers
en.description: Boss in Diapers is a party game set in a chaotic daycare! Defeat your rivals to sit on the Boss Chair. Create your little troublemaker and battle with 2–4 players to rule the daycare.

games.name: Prerolled
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: Sell boxes of dice to silly clients in this cozy roguelike deckbuilder! Each die has unique effects based on the positioning of other dice in the box! Create your own crazy combos, make numbers go up, and overcharge shamelessly to pay rent!

en.name: Prerolled
en.description: Sell boxes of dice to silly clients in this cozy roguelike deckbuilder! Each die has unique effects based on the positioning of other dice in the box! Create your own crazy combos, make numbers go up, and overcharge shamelessly to pay rent!

games.name: The Usual, Please
genres: 職業シミュレーション
games.description: 短めのホラー料理ゲーム。1970年代、霧に包まれた港の桟橋で、亡くなった叔父のハンバーガー屋台を引き継ごう。町の人たちに料理を出し、窓口に来る前に溺死者を見抜き、叔父を本当に殺したのは誰なのかを突き止めよう。

en.name: The Usual, Please
en.description: A short horror cooking game. Run your dead uncle's burger cart on a foggy harbour pier in the 1970s. Cook for the locals, spot the drowned before they reach your window, and find out who really killed your uncle.

games.name: Dying Patience
games.description: 何年もの間、あなたは母親の世話をしてきた。だが、母親の病は次第にあなたの人生を壊し始める。弱々しい声、やつれた姿、消えゆく意識……あなたは、この苦しみに耐え続けられるだろうか？

en.name: Dying Patience
en.description: For years, you cared for your mother until her illness began to destroy your life. Her weak voice, her exhausted appearance, her fading consciousness... Are you willing to keep enduring this?

games.name: Bros Survivors
games.description: 2人のプレイヤー、1つの体、絶対的なカオス。この協力型サバイバーライクで敵の群れを生き延びろ。フレンドと巨大メカに合体し、1人が水平移動、もう1人が垂直移動を操作する。2人は連携できるか、それとも死あるのみか？

en.name: Bros Survivors
en.description: Two players, one body, absolute chaos. Survive enemy hordes in this co-op Survivors-like. Merge with a friend into a giant mech: one controls horizontal movement, the other vertical. Will you coordinate or die trying?

games.name: Aldmark Calls for Aid
games.description: A medieval siege-defence strategy game where a rival crown comes for your city. Command your troops on the walls and in the field, and between rounds light beacons to choose which allies will march to your aid. Win or lose, every battle earns renown to make Aldmark stronger.

en.name: Aldmark Calls for Aid
en.description: A medieval siege-defence strategy game where a rival crown comes for your city. Command your troops on the walls and in the field, and between rounds light beacons to choose which allies will march to your aid. Win or lose, every battle earns renown to make Aldmark stronger.

games.name: Yuhaの悪夢：エピソード1：大惨事
games.shortName: YUHAの悪夢：エピソード1：大惨事
games.description: Yuhaの悪夢へ飛び込め。グリッチ・アポカリプスを目撃せよ。3次元の夢に隠されたレイヤーを探り、バラバラになった彼女の記憶と恐怖をつなぎ合わせよう。階段は消え、声を失い、時間切れが繰り返される…真に呪われる感覚を体験しよう。

trailers.name: Yuha’s Nightmares | Episode One: Catastrophe [Demo Launch Trailer]
Yuha’s Nightmares | Episode One: Catastrophe [Announcement Trailer]

en.name: Yuha's Nightmares. Episode One: Catastrophe
en.description: Dive into Yuha's nightmares. Bear witness to a glitch apocalypse. Explore the hidden layers of a 3D-dreamscape. Piece together her memories and fears. Experience a true haunting with vanishing staircases, lost voices and time that keeps running out.

games.name: Night Cart: The Immortal Plague
games.description: A first-person gothic adventure where you drive a horse-drawn cart through plague-ridden Transylvania alongside an immortal woman, exploring forgotten places, battling desperate foes, uncovering ancient secrets, and searching for the legendary Count Saint Germain.

en.name: Night Cart: The Immortal Plague
en.description: A first-person gothic adventure where you drive a horse-drawn cart through plague-ridden Transylvania alongside an immortal woman, exploring forgotten places, battling desperate foes, uncovering ancient secrets, and searching for the legendary Count Saint Germain.

games.name: Fraga
games.description: You are a pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest. Survive in this procedurally generated, turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Celtic mythology. Upgrade your gear, adapt your strategy and remember: something is always lurking in the shadows.

en.name: Fraga
en.description: You are a pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest. Survive in this procedurally generated, turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Celtic mythology. Upgrade your gear, adapt your strategy and remember: something is always lurking in the shadows.

games.name: Broken Horror Anthology
games.description: A collection of four atmospheric horror games about brokenness and malfunction. Inspect toys for defects, cheat on an exam, follow a radio signal, and explore the darkness by the light of matches.

en.name: Broken Horror Anthology
en.description: A collection of four atmospheric horror games about brokenness and malfunction. Inspect toys for defects, cheat on an exam, follow a radio signal, and explore the darkness by the light of matches.

games.name: Boltz
games.description: Boltz は、画面上のターゲットとなるすべてのボルトとナットを取り除く、ミニマリストなロジックパズルゲームです。約10レベルごとに追加される新しいギミックにより、奥深いパズル体験を楽しめます。

en.name: Boltz
en.description: Boltz is a minimalist logic puzzle where you try to remove all the target bolts and nuts on the screen. It offers a rich puzzle experience thanks to new mechanics added approximately every 10 levels.

games.name: Extreme Forklifting 3
genres: 乗り物シミュレーション
職業シミュレーション
games.description: フォークリフトオペレーターとして夢の生活を体験しよう！ 倉庫キリンのスリル満点な日常を味わえます。頼れるフォークリフトを駆使して問題を解決し、パレットを運びましょう。持ち上げて、下ろして…想像力こそが唯一の限界です！

en.name: Extreme Forklifting 3
en.description: Live the dream as a forklift operator! Experience the thrilling life of a warehouse giraffe! Use your trusty forklifts to solve problems and deliver pallets in this 3D vehicular platformer.

games.name: 勤劳的蜜蜂 busy bee
games.description: **Busy Bee** is a match-3 puzzle game featuring light-hearted and engaging gameplay. Players solve puzzles by matching three or more identical elements to achieve objectives, with a moderate number of levels designed to keep players challenged.

en.name: busy bee
en.description: **Busy Bee** is a match-3 puzzle game featuring light-hearted and engaging gameplay. Players solve puzzles by matching three or more identical elements to achieve objectives, with a moderate number of levels designed to keep players challenged.

games.name: Voody Hex
games.description: Voody Hex is a roguelite plateformer. Enter into a voodoo cabaret and curse yourself to increase difficulty. You cannot attack - You need to survive.

en.name: Voody Hex
en.description: Voody Hex is a roguelite plateformer. Enter into a voodoo cabaret and curse yourself to increase difficulty. You cannot attack - You need to survive.

games.name: 検問所：鳥疫
games.description: 致命的な鶏疫病が世界を破壊した。人類の最後の安全保障地域の防衛として、あなたは庇護を求める生存者を検査しなければならなくて、1つの誤りはコミュニティ全体を破壊するかもしれなくて、彼らが入ることを許可する前に、すべての人を注意深く検査しなければなりません。

en.name: ChickenPlaguePolice
en.description: A deadly Chicken Plague has destroyed the world. As a guard of humanity’s last safe zone, you must inspect survivors seeking refuge and identify the infected. One mistake could doom the entire community, so examine everyone carefully before allowing them inside.

games.name: Lands of Fury
games.description: 過酷な山を戦い抜いて登れ。武器、カートリッジ、ルーン、仲間を組み合わせて凶悪な戦闘ビルドを築き上げ、容赦なく襲い来る敵を薙ぎ払う——戦闘特化のローグライトARPG。

en.name: Lands of Fury
en.description: Fight your way up a brutal mountain. Combine weapons, cartridges, runes, and companions to create devastating combat builds and carve through relentless enemies in this combat-driven roguelite ARPG.

games.name: HitTube
games.description: HitTubeは1-4人でプレイできるホラー系シューティングゲームです。ゾンビ・アポカリプスが今まさに到来！君は寄付金を稼ぐために配信中にゾンビをぶっ倒すストリーマーだ。武器はミニガンで、ミニガンは君の最高の相棒だ！

en.name: HitTube
en.description: HitTube is a 1-4 player horror streamer shooter. The zombie apocalypse is here and now you're a streamer who kills live for donations. Your weapon is a minigun and your minigun is your best friend!

games.name: Dino Slug
games.description: アクション満載の手描きトップダウンシューターに飛び込もう。暗いジャングルを探索し、潜む全体主義政権の兵士たち、そしてもちろん恐竜たちと戦え！ 数多くの武器、手榴弾、アイテムが傭兵生活を少し楽にしてくれる！

en.name: Dino Slug
en.description: Dive into an action-packed, hand-drawn top-down shooter. Explore a dark jungle and fight the lurking soldiers of a totalitarian regime and, of course: dinos! Numerous weapons, grenades, and items make mercenary life a bit easier! 90s retro fun guaranteed.

games.name: Thieves and Gold
games.description: コンテナを壊せ。金をかき集めろ。時間切れになる前に隠された鍵を見つけ出せ。盗賊の仲間を募り、この中世を舞台にした短編インクリメンタル・ハイストゲームで、再び領主から奪い取れ。

en.name: Thieves and Gold
en.description: Smash containers. Grab the gold. Find the hidden keys before time runs out. Recruit a crew of thieves and rob the lord again in this short medieval heist incremental.

games.name: TaskFall
games.description: 『TaskFall』で、あなたと仲間たちは謎に包まれた「シタデル」からの任務を引き受ける。仕事は難しくない。少なくとも、シタデルの連中はそう言っている。完全破壊可能なレベルで任務を遂行し、生きて脱出し、新たな装備を購入し、シタデルの秘密を徐々に解き明かせ。

en.name: TaskFall
en.description: In TaskFall, you and your friends take on tasks from the mysterious Citadel. The work is not difficult. At least, that’s what they say in the Citadel. Complete tasks on fully destructible levels, make it out alive, buy new equipment, and gradually uncover the secrets of the Citadel.

games.name: Among Paws
genres: ソーシャルディダクション
games.description: 魚を盗んだのは誰？Among Paws は、こっそり魚を盗むネコたちが朝に疑い合い、最初の5kgチャンピオンを目指す、4～8人向けのほのぼのソーシャル推理パーティーゲームです。脱落なし、待ち時間なし。

en.name: Among Paws
en.description: Who stole the fish? Among Paws is a cozy 4-8 player social deduction party game where sneaky cats steal fish at night, accuse each other by morning, and race to be the first 5 kg champion. No eliminations, no waiting.

games.name: Against Heroes
games.description: 勇者が攻めてくるまで待つ必要はあるだろうか？ モンスター軍団を編成して出撃させ、勇者たちが魔王を倒せるほど強くなる前に排除しよう。魔王の視点で楽しむ戦略ローグライト！

en.name: Against Heroes
en.description: Why wait for heroes to come for you? Build and deploy a monster army to eliminate them before they grow strong enough to defeat you. A strategy roguelite from the Demon Lord’s perspective!

games.name: Wild Hive
games.description: 巣を築き、生き延びろ——ローグライク・コロニーシム。働きバチを孵し、花蜜を集め、超リアルに変動する相場でハチミツを最高値で売り抜けろ。巣の温度・湿度・CO₂を管理し、スズメバチの襲撃を迎え撃て——さもなくば、コロニーは崩壊する。巣を極め、ハチミツ帝国を築き上げろ。

en.name: Wild Hive
en.description: Build your own bee hive in this cozy roguelite. Hatch worker bees, forage nectar and sell your honey on the stock market. The royal crown demands more honey every year! How long will your hive survive?

games.name: Travellin Cats Advent Calendar
games.description: クリスマスまでのカウントダウンを、隠れネコがいっぱいの素敵なアドベントカレンダーでもっと楽しく！家族みんなで楽しめる癒やし系アイテム探しゲームです。バイラルヒットした隠れネコゲームの生みの親、Travellin Cats制作！

en.name: Travellin Cats Advent Calendar
en.description: Sweeten the countdown to Christmas with this fabulous advent calendar full of hidden cats for you to find in this relaxing hidden object game for the whole family by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator!

games.name: Explosiovania
games.description: 壊れた地下世界へと降り立ったあなたは、サタン・ヒルを越える術を身につけなければなりません。爆発するファイアボールを使ってロケットジャンプを決め、能力を解放し、進化し続ける移動システムを習得しましょう。悪魔を打ち倒し、秘密を発見し、地下世界の非線形な隅々を探索して「邪悪の眼」を取り戻してください。

en.name: Explosiovania
en.description: Rocket-jump using exploding fireballs, unlock abilities and master an ever-growing movement system. Explore the non-linear corners of the underworld, find secrets, defeat demons and reclaim the Eye of Evil.

games.name: Dew & Dink
games.description: 島暮らしシミュレーター。ゼロから自分だけの楽園を作り上げよう。農業、動物の飼育、釣り、鉱山探検など、様々なアクティビティを楽しめます。村人たちと友達になり、四季の移り変わりを感じながら、ストーリーモードまたはサンドボックスモードで夢のマイホームをデザインしよう！

en.name: Dew & Dink
en.description: An island life simulator. Build your own paradise from scratch: cultivate a farm, raise animals, go fishing, and explore mines. Make friends with the locals, experience the changing seasons, and design your dream home either through a story driven campaign or in sandbox mode!

games.name: Shadey's Quest
games.description: Shadey’s Quest is an autobattler roguelike featuring character building. Shadey is a monster who wants to be a hero, but the only thing he is good at is eating. Guide him through a rich fantasy world, feed and equip him, and help him defeat the fearsome King of Shadows!

en.name: Shadey's Quest
en.description: Shadey’s Quest is an autobattler roguelike featuring character building. Shadey is a monster who wants to be a hero, but the only thing he is good at is eating. Guide him through a rich fantasy world, feed and equip him, and help him defeat the fearsome King of Shadows!

games.name: Ace of Jianghu
games.description: Reading wuxia is one thing. Living it is another. Shaolin, Wudang, Unorthodox Alliance, Heavenly Demon Cult. Become one of four and step into a jianghu of hidden currents. You hold cards; you fight with martial arts. Your road changes who you meet and the story. In the jianghu, a man is just a card.

en.name: Ace of Jianghu
en.description: Reading wuxia is one thing. Living it is another. Shaolin, Wudang, Unorthodox Alliance, Heavenly Demon Cult. Become one of four and step into a jianghu of hidden currents. You hold cards; you fight with martial arts. Your road changes who you meet and the story. In the jianghu, a man is just a card.

games.name: Castlebound
games.description: ローグライク要素のある 1～4 人用アクション プラットフォーム ゲームで、邪悪なモンスターの大群と戦い、城を守りましょう。

en.name: Castlebound
en.description: Fight hordes of evil monsters and defend your castle in this 1-4 player action platformer with Roguelike elements!

games.name: COSMIC HOLES Junior
games.description: 数字が要素になっている、異星人の数独を想像してみてください。どの要素を、どこに、いつ配置すればいいのでしょうか？バランスを保つためには、それぞれの要素が他の要素と調和していなければなりません。大人も子供も楽しめます。 宇宙人は数独なんてやらない――彼らは「COSMIC HOLES」を遊ぶんだ！

en.name: COSMIC HOLES Junior
en.description: Imagine an alien Sudoku where the numbers are elements. Figure out which element to place on the grid, where, and when!? In order to maintain balance, each element must harmonize with the others. “Aliens don't play Sudoku—they play COSMIC HOLES!” For adults and children.

games.name: Combo Break
games.description: Combo Break fuses the hypnotic pull of a peg-bouncer with roguelite deckbuilding. Load your board with special pegs, chain their effects into screen-filling combos, and watch the payouts explode. One more ball. One bigger combo. One perfect board.

en.name: Combo Break
en.description: Combo Break fuses the hypnotic pull of a peg-bouncer with roguelite deckbuilding. Load your board with special pegs, chain their effects into screen-filling combos, and watch the payouts explode. One more ball. One bigger combo. One perfect board.

games.name: Runback
games.description: Fight, upgrade, and fight again! Runback is an online roguelite party fighter where the phrase ‘best-of-five’ takes on a whole new meaning. Spend points between fights to evolve your character, turn the tide, or simply cement your dominance over your friends!

trailers.name: Runback X Rivals of Aether Reveal Trailer

en.name: Runback
en.description: Fight, upgrade, and fight again! Runback is an online roguelite party fighter where the phrase ‘best-of-five’ takes on a whole new meaning. Spend points between fights to evolve your character, turn the tide, or simply cement your dominance over your friends!

games.name: Fablery
games.description: Take control of legendary Heroes from myths, tales, and legends of every culture. Each Hero has a unique deck reflecting their personality and powers. Enter a tactical card game where strategy and foresight turn every battle into an unforgettable story.

en.name: Fablery
en.description: Take control of legendary Heroes from myths, tales, and legends of every culture. Each Hero has a unique deck reflecting their personality and powers. Enter a tactical card game where strategy and foresight turn every battle into an unforgettable story.

games.name: 真夏の僕たち
genres: 恋愛シミュレーション
インタラクティブフィクション
没入シミュレーション
games.description: 夏休みを前に、学内で撮影のアルバイトを始めたあなた。優しく気遣ってくれる学園のマドンナ・劉詩琳先輩、クールな表情に温かさを秘めた文芸派の李飛児先輩、いたずら好きで振り回してくるモデルの後輩・夏薇、そしていつもそばにいる幼なじみの楽彤。卒業シーズンの撮影に向け、それぞれの得意分野を生かして力を合わせる日々。個性豊かな４人と過ごす、あなただけの胸ときめく夏の思い出が、今そっと幕を開ける……

en.name: Love in Summer
en.description: Summer nears. A campus photo job brings you to caring beauty Liu Shilin, aloof yet warm artist Li Feier, mischievous model Xia Wei, and childhood friend Le Tong. Together, you plan graduation shoots, each lending your talents, as your own summer romance with four unique girls quietly begins.

games.name: Funeral for the Sun
games.description: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

trailers.name: Funeral for the Sun - Release Date Trailer

en.name: Funeral for the Sun
en.description: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

games.name: MONOMOON
games.description: 『MONOMOON』では、知識を得た大胆不敵な者だけが、前へと進むことができる。月明かりに導かれ、隠れた真実を解き明かし、こじんまりとしたミステリアスなオープンワールドを歩き回ろう。

en.name: MONOMOON
en.description: In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world.

games.name: Neo Junk City
games.description: 沈んだ都市で不穏な潮流が高まる。 サイバーパンクアクションRPGに飛び込んで、速いシュートアウトとレトロなアーケードレースを楽しもう。自分が犯した記憶のない殺人の真相を明らかにしよう！

en.name: Neo Junk City
en.description: Sinister tides are rising in the Drowned City. Dive into a Point and Click action-RPG with fast-paced shoot-outs and retro arcade racing. Uncover the truth behind a murder you don't remember committing!

games.name: Apotheosis Engine
games.description: 虚空に迷う宇宙探査機が、決して持つはずのなかった心に目覚める。Apotheosis Engineは、異星のオペレーティングシステムを探索し、ちっぽけな探査機からデジタルの神へと成長していく、ロアに満ちたインクリメンタルゲーム。

en.name: Apotheosis Engine
en.description: Lost in the void, a space probe awakens to a mind it was never designed to possess. Apotheosis Engine is a lore-rich incremental game about exploring an alien operating system and growing from a simple probe into a digital deity.

games.name: Zombies Aren't Real
genres: アウトブレイクシミュレーション
games.description: Zombies Aren't Real is a horde-defense, strategy game where you deploy military forces in an attempt to quell a quick-spreading zombie infection and save as many civilians as you can!

en.name: Zombies Aren't Real
en.description: Zombies Aren't Real is a horde-defense, strategy game where you deploy military forces in an attempt to quell a quick-spreading zombie infection and save as many civilians as you can!

games.name: Oboro no Ichi
genres: デザイン＆イラストレーション
games.description: 本にインスパイアされた霊の市場を築き、さまよう魂を迎え入れ、資源を生産・販売しながら、思い出と心地よい雰囲気の中で市場を発展させましょう。

trailers.name: Oboro No Ichi - Official Story Trailer

en.name: Oboro no Ichi
en.description: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

games.name: ゲレンデ社長！伝説のスキーリゾート経営
games.shortName: ゲレンデ社長！伝説のスキーリゾート経営
games.description: ゲレンデ社長の出番だ！経営シミュレーションゲームで夢にまで見た温もりあふれるスキーリゾートを作り上げよう。刻々と変わる天候に対応しながら、コースを描いて、リフトを建設し、ロッジやアフタースキーを楽しめるバーを設置。何千人ものスキーヤーが暖かく、満腹で、満足して過ごせるリゾートを目指せ。

en.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon
en.description: You're the Ski-E-O - build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management tycoon game. Adapt to ever-changing weather, paint trails, build lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

games.name: Dice Hoarder
games.description: 「Dice Hoarder」は、謎めいたダイスショップの品出しをする、ほのぼのとした整理整頓ゲームです。店内のダイスをすべて仕分けし、7個1組のTRPGダイスセットを完成させながら、新しい仕事の裏に隠された秘密を解き明かしていきましょう。

en.name: Dice Hoarder
en.description: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

games.name: ジャーニーTD
games.description: Journey TDは、タワーそのものが迷路になるローグライトタワーディフェンスです。属性を選び、168種のタワーからドラフトしましょう。パワーアップ、装備、ルーン、3つのスキルツリーを組み合わせれば、凶悪なビルドの完成です。毎週、同じ Seed でほかのプレイヤーと競い合い、ランキング1位を目指しましょう。

en.name: Journey TD
en.description: Journey TD is a roguelite tower defense where your towers are the maze. Pick your elements and draft from 168 towers. Combine power-ups, gear, runes and three skill trees into deadly builds. Every week, battle other players on the same seed to top the leaderboard.

games.name: Amnea28: Two Eternities
games.description: A group of university students is going to spend a week in the old hotel "Amnea". Within these seven days they have to find out what is hidden behind its facade and to unravel all the mysteries without losing their minds.

en.name: Amnea28: Two Eternities
en.description: A group of university students is going to spend a week in the old hotel "Amnea". Within these seven days they have to find out what is hidden behind its facade and to unravel all the mysteries without losing their minds.

games.name: 勇者パーティはぜんめつしました。
games.shortName: 勇者パーティはぜんめつしました。
games.description: 『勇者パーティはぜんめつしました。』は、壊れてしまった仲間の〈業〉と向き合い、一緒にケジメをつける高湿度・激重感情RPGです。壊滅した勇者パーティから1人だけを救出し、ダンジョンから脱出しましょう。限界状況のなか生まれる感情は、絆か、疑心か、依存か。

en.name: Annihilated
en.description: A story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.

games.name: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story
genres: 見下ろし型シューティング
games.description: 『Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story』は、物語重視のアドベンチャーと容赦ないトップダウンアクションを融合させた作品。人間と動物が暮らす犯罪のはびこる街で、あなたは昼は街の住人、夜は殺し屋。葬られた過去に追いつかれる前に、その真実を掘り起こせ。

en.name: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story
en.description: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story blends narrative adventure with brutal top-down action. In a crime-ridden town of humans and animals, you're a resident by day and a hitman by night. Uncover your buried past before it catches up with you.

games.name: 500 FINGER FILLET
games.description: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?

en.name: 500 FINGER FILLET
en.description: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?

games.name: Nocturnal 2
games.description: ここは、遥か昔に自ら招いた破滅によって忘却の彼方に取り残された島——己の剣に宿した炎をかかげ、深淵に足を踏み入れ、そびえる塔を探索せよ。

en.name: Nocturnal 2
en.description: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

games.name: DIG
games.description: 1～8人の友だちと遊べる、まったりオンライン協力穴掘りゲーム。日当たりのいい裏庭に穴を掘り、鉱石や失われた設計図を見つけ、工房ですてきな品を作って世界中のお客さんへ届けよう。お返しに手紙や写真が届きます。制限時間なし。ただ掘るだけ。

en.name: DIG
en.description: A cozy online co-op digging game for 1-8 friends. Dig a hole in your sunny backyard, find ore and lost blueprints, craft lovely things in your workshop and ship them to customers around the world, who write back with letters and photos. No timers. Just dig.

games.name: Novus Orbis
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: 時空を巡るループを舞台にしたコンボ型デッキ構築ローグライク。カードを集め、恵みを受け、ペットを仲間に加え、さらなる強さを手に入れよう。カードを正しい順番で組み合わせて最大限の力を引き出し、敵が行動する前に先手を打て。相乗効果を生み出すデッキを構築し、数々の秘密を発見し、ケタ違いの数字を叩き出そう！

en.name: Novus Orbis
en.description: A combo-based deckbuilding roguelike through a space-time loop: collect cards, receive blessings, add pets to your party, and grow stronger. Chain together cards in the right order for max power, and act before the enemy does. Build synergistic decks, find many secrets, and make BIG numbers!

games.name: Imperial Grace
games.description: Imperial Grace is a visual novel about romance, medieval intrigue, and political strategy. Will you rule with your head, or your heart?

en.name: Imperial Grace
en.description: Imperial Grace is a visual novel about romance, medieval intrigue, and political strategy. Will you rule with your head, or your heart?

games.name: Alterum
genres: ソーシャルディダクション
games.description: 呪文を声に出して唱える、マルチプレイヤーホラー推理ゲーム。仲間の一人は憑かれている。声で魔法を放ち、裏切り者を暴き、儀式を生き延びろ。その一言が、命取りになるかもしれない。

en.name: Alterum
en.description: A multiplayer social deduction horror where spells are spoken aloud. One of you is altered. Cast magic with your voice, hunt the traitor, survive the ritual. Every word can save - or kill.

games.name: Cardaire: Eternal Aces
games.description: Get ready to crack packs and throw cards in a single-player collectible card RPG! Explore a unique world while collecting your own cards to build the deck that'll make you a Cardaire legend.

en.name: Cardaire: Eternal Aces
en.description: Get ready to crack packs and throw cards in a single-player collectible card RPG! Explore a unique world while collecting your own cards to build the deck that'll make you a Cardaire legend.

games.name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 6
games.description: かわいい猫娘たちと一緒に、回転パズルを解こう。のんびり楽しめる、ゆるやかな成長要素のあるゲームプレイ。猫娘とおしゃべり。なぜかパズルが上達していく。ちょっと怪しい選択をする。意外と役に立つアイテムをアンロック。

en.name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 6
en.description: Solve rotating puzzles with cute cat girls. Cozy, soft-incremental gameplay. Chat With Cat Girls. Somehow Get Better at Puzzles. Make Questionable Choices. Unlock Surprisingly Useful Stuff.

games.name: Pelikeeper: A TD Adventure
games.description: 『Pelikeeper』はタワーディフェンスと基地建設を合わせた、居心地のいいストラテジーゲーム。君は影のような霧に飲み込まれた世界で最後のペリカンとなってプレイする。灯台の周りを開拓しながら防衛し、迷子になった動物仲間を救い、宇宙に星座を取り戻そう。

en.name: Pelikeeper: A TD Adventure
en.description: Defend fallen stars from an onslaught of shadow creatures, strategize with unique animal towers, and upgrade your lighthouse community as you adventure through the changing seasons to uncover the memories of fallen stars.

games.name: MultiScope Air Traffic Control
games.description: Take control of the skies. MultiScope Air Traffic Control is a realistic approach radar simulator where you vector arrivals, sequence approaches and keep them separated from your departures. Use your own voice or the input panels, with pilot readbacks over simulated VHF radio.

en.name: MultiScope Air Traffic Control
en.description: Take control of the skies. MultiScope Air Traffic Control is a realistic approach radar simulator where you vector arrivals, sequence approaches and keep them separated from your departures. Use your own voice or the input panels, with pilot readbacks over simulated VHF radio.

games.name: Bottle Flip Inc
games.description: ボトルをひっくり返し、ユニークな能力を解放・強化しながら、シンプルなボトルフリップをどんどん爽快で満足感のある瞬間へと変えていくインクリメンタルゲーム。

en.name: Bottle Flip Inc
en.description: An incremental game about flipping bottles, unlocking and upgrading unique abilities, and turning simple bottle flips into increasingly satisfying moments.

games.name: Rolls and Dungeons
games.description: カジノとダンジョンが融合した放置系インクリメンタルゲーム！借金まみれの英雄たちでチームを組み、ダンジョンを攻略し、チップを貯めて戦闘中にスロットを回してモンスターやボスを倒そう。運を強化し、戦利品やアーティファクトを集め、新たな階層を解放せよ――究極のジャックポットが最後に待っている！

en.name: Rolls and Dungeons
en.description: An incremental game about casinos and dungeons! Assemble a team of debtor-heroes, clear dungeons, hoard chips, and spin the slot machine in combat to defeat monsters and bosses. Level up your luck, hunt for loot and artifacts, unlock new dungeon levels – the ultimate jackpot awaits at the very end!

games.name: ONE FENIX DOWN
games.description: A retro-inspired, classic turn-based RPG for those with nostalgia for the '90s golden era. Explore a vast world with 14 playable characters, fight hundreds of unique enemies, and delve into an epic story of war, betrayal, and redemption.

en.name: ONE FENIX DOWN
en.description: A retro-inspired, classic turn-based RPG for those with nostalgia for the '90s golden era. Explore a vast world with 14 playable characters, fight hundreds of unique enemies, and delve into an epic story of war, betrayal, and redemption.

games.name: Agromatic
games.description: A farming and automation game where your automation is people. Hire workers, pay their salaries, build their houses, and lay out your farms and factories like a town. Produce and sell valuable goods to keep your business profitable. This isn't colony survival, it's running a company.

en.name: Agromatic
en.description: A farming and automation game where your automation is people. Hire workers, pay their salaries, build their houses, and lay out your farms and factories like a town. Produce and sell valuable goods to keep your business profitable. This isn't colony survival, it's running a company.

games.name: One More Lawn
genres: 趣味シミュレーション
games.description: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.

en.name: One More Lawn
en.description: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.

games.name: Hell Wait
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: 『HELL WAIT』は、リーチ麻雀をベースとしたローグライク・デッキ構築ゲーム。ジョーカー牌をスタックし、役をアップグレードせよ。相手をアガらせてはならない…指を失いたくはないだろう？

en.name: Hell Wait
en.description: HELL WAIT is riichi mahjong crossed with roguelike deckbuilding. Stack your jokers. Upgrade your yaku. Try not to deal in. You'll need those fingers.

games.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer  - タヌキ： ポンの夏
games.shortName: TANUKI: PON'S SUMMER - タヌキ： ポンの夏
