genres: 人生シミュレーション
games.description: タヌキ祭りまで1か月しかないのに神社は荒れ放題。ちょっと怠け者のタヌキのポンとなり、郵便局で働きながら夏が終わる前に神社を建て直そう。小包を届け、友達を作り、立派な神社を建ててタヌキ祭りを迎えるんだ！

en.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
en.description: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

games.name: Vena: Hex Automation Roguelike
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: ランひとつが一度のセッションで完結する自動化ローグライク。ヘックスタイルを配置して生産する有機体を育てよう。ただし資源の需要は時間とともに増していく。ショップでダイスを振ってタイルを買い足し、ルールを変えるパークを選んで、経済を完全に壊してみせよう。

en.name: Vena: Hex Automation Roguelike
en.description: An automation roguelike where a run fits in one session. Place hexagonal tiles to grow a production organism while the resource demands rise over time. Roll dice in the shop to buy more tiles, and pick perks that change the rules and try to completely break the economy.

games.name: 光を喰らう者
genres: ハックアンドスラッシュ
ベルトスクロールアクション
games.description: 『Light Devourer』は、ピクセルアートのソウルライクARPGです。 高速なバトル、探索しごたえのある豊かな世界、そしてダークファンタジーの物語が特徴です。

en.name: Light Devourer
en.description: Light Devourer is a pixel-art soulslike ARPG featuring fast-paced combat, a rich world to explore, and a dark fantasy story.

games.name: Near Mint
games.description: 自分だけのカードを作り、常に変化し続けるユニークなデッキに組み込もう。荒廃した大地を探索しながら戦い、奇妙な生き物たちと出会い、このローグライク・デッキビルダーで完璧な戦略を編み出せ。

en.name: Near Mint
en.description: Create your own cards and combine them in a unique and everchanging deck. Explore and battle through hostile lands, encounter bizarre creatures and craft the perfect strategy in this roguelike deckbuilder.

games.name: Castillon
games.description: Castillon is an RTS + TD base-building strategy hybrid. Gather resources, explore and fortify your defenses during the day. Then survive waves of enemies attacks through the night. Level up, improve your stats, and master 4 schools of magic to become the ultimate wizard warrior.

en.name: Castillon
en.description: Castillon is an RTS + TD base-building strategy hybrid. Gather resources, explore and fortify your defenses during the day. Then survive waves of enemies attacks through the night. Level up, improve your stats, and master 4 schools of magic to become the ultimate wizard warrior.

games.name: コンビニサバイバーズ
games.shortName: コンビニサバイバーズ
games.description: 謎めいたコンビニチェーン「シフト24」。夜が更けるほど、奇妙な客が次々と押し寄せてきます。カップ麺、お菓子、コーヒーなど、手に取れる店の商品はすべて武器になります。客を撃退するうちに、世界各地の支店に隠された不可解な手がかりが見えてきます。手がかりを追い、借金を返していけば、シフト24の真実が明らかになります。

trailers.name: コンビニサバイバーズ

en.name: Mini Mart Survivors
en.description: Survive 10 minutes on the night shift at SHIFT24, where cup noodles, snacks, and coffee turn the aisles into a bullet heaven. Fight off nightmare customers, pay off your debt, and uncover what SHIFT24 is hiding in this survivors-like roguelite.

games.name: We Steal From Old People: The Game
games.shortName: WE STEAL FROM OLD PEOPLE: THE GAME
games.description: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!

en.name: We Steal From Old People: The Game
en.description: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!

games.name: Project Tomorrow
games.description: テラフォーミングとクラフトで拠点を築き、生き延びよ。1万年前に侵略された地球は、毒にまみれて放棄された。人類が再び地球で生きていけるよう、停滞から目覚めて脆い基盤を守り、死んだ世界を復興させるのだ。

en.name: Project Tomorrow
en.description: A base-building survival game with terraforming and crafting. Earth lies poisoned and abandoned ten thousand years after invasion. Awaken from stasis, defend your fragile foothold, and restore a dead world so humanity can live here again.

games.name: SONIC PICO PARK
games.description: 多人数協力型アクションパズルゲーム『PICO PARK』シリーズの最新作は、なんとSEGA『ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ』とのコラボレーション！ 『ソニック』らしさと『PICO PARK』らしさを兼ね備えた協力プレイがたくさん！ ローカル/オンラインにて2人から最大8人まで遊べるよ！

en.name: SONIC PICO PARK
en.description: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

games.name: Warp to Sector One
games.description: 80年代SF映画のコンピューター画面と初期のテキストベース宇宙ゲームに着想を得た、奥深い宇宙交易ゲーム。プロシージャル生成された銀河で交易し、戦い、探索しよう。艦隊を指揮し、エイリアン勢力と交渉し、惑星に入植し、5つのキャリアパスで自らの伝説を刻め。

en.name: Warp to Sector One
en.description: Trade, fight, and explore a procedurally generated galaxy in this deep space trading game inspired by 80's sci-fi computer screens and early text based space games. Command fleets, negotiate with alien factions, colonize planets, and forge your legacy across five unique career paths.

games.name: The Big Suck
games.description: 竜巻そのものになって暴れる、アーケード型のインクリメンタルゲーム。牛を吸い込み、街を更地にして、稼いだお金はランの合間に強化へつぎ込もう。炎・洪水・凍結・虚無の4つの災害にも変身できる。最初は草一本が精いっぱい。地球を引き裂いたら、その嵐で異星へ。自分だけの農場で、牛も育てよう。

en.name: The Big Suck
en.description: An arcade incremental where you ARE the tornado. Suck up cows, flatten cities, and spend the cash on upgrades between runs. Become fire, flood, winter or void. Start with a blade of grass. Tear Earth apart, then take your storm to an alien world. Raise cows on a farm of your own.

games.name: 百鬼退散
games.description: 『百鬼退散』（Ghosts Before Dawn）は、中華伝承の世界を舞台にしたピクセル風サバイバー系アクションローグライク。道士、屍導士、夜警となり、自動発動する法器と身のこなしで群がる妖怪を退散させよう。法器の進化と五行相生を組み合わせ、荒村、鬼市、湘西義荘の死線を切り抜けろ。10分間の長夜を生き延び、夜明けを阻む最終ボスを撃破せよ——この夜、お前は天明を迎えられるか？

en.name: Ghosts Before Dawn
en.description: Survive a night of Chinese folklore in Ghosts Before Dawn, a pixel-art survivor-like. Wield auto-casting talismans, flying swords, and spirit-banishing gongs. Combine weapons and the Five Elements, brave haunted villages and ghost markets, then face the final bosses after ten minutes of survival.

games.name: Heavensmith: Dungeon Unbound
games.description: Explore dungeons in a single-player, turn-based RPG. Learn skills across classes, craft gear with your choice of materials, and lead a party of up to five against bosses. Develop your village and build bonds with your companions.

trailers.name: Learn Every Class Skill | Romance Every Companion

en.name: Heavensmith: Dungeon Unbound
en.description: Explore dungeons in a single-player, turn-based RPG. Learn skills across classes, craft gear with your choice of materials, and lead a party of up to five against bosses. Develop your village and build bonds with your companions.

games.name: Industry Unbound：无界工业
games.description: 無限のキャンバスを舞台にした工場自動化ストラテジー。資源を採掘し、物流と電力を整え、入植地を支え、技術を研究して、自給自足の惑星産業を築こう。

en.name: Industry Unbound：无界工业
en.description: A factory automation strategy game on an infinite canvas. Mine resources, route logistics, balance power, supply settlements, and research new technologies to build a self-sustaining planetary industry.

games.name: ブースターパックヒーロー
games.shortName: ブースターパックヒーロー
games.description: ブースターパックを開けて、次のホイルヒーローを手に入れよう。『ブースターパックヒーロー』はインクリメンタルゲーム。1パックごとに、次の主力となるヒーローが眠っているかもしれない。果てしないモンスターの群れからタワーを守り、幾多のレルムを戦い抜け。

en.name: Booster Pack Heroes
en.description: Rip open booster packs and pull your next foil hero in Booster Pack Heroes - an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Defend the tower from an endless onslaught of monsters and fight your way through the realms.

games.name: Icy Tower
genres: 精密プラットフォーム
games.description: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores. How high can you get?

en.name: Icy Tower
en.description: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores. How high can you get?

games.name: Rejected Draft
games.description: ゴミ箱に捨てられた「意味のないボツ画」となり、ライバルを倒してその力を吸収し、その本懐を遂げろ。数字が爆発的に跳ね上がるのを眺めるサブモニターに最適な放置系バトル。数えきれないほどのスキルツリーとランダム化された周回要素により、二つとして同じ体験はない。

en.name: Rejected Draft
en.description: Climb out of the trash and fight your way back to the artist who rejected you. Defeat sketches, steal their strengths, and begin a months-long incremental journey through an ever-growing web of stats, upgrades, prestige layers, automation, and absurd numbers. Easy to start, hard to master.

games.name: ワロタ、俺の家のとなり魔王城www
games.shortName: ワロタ、俺の家のとなり魔王城WWW
games.description: 【 村づくりアクションRPG 】女神に救われたあなたが転生したのは、魔王に支配され荒れ果てた世界。素材を集めて施設を建て、ジョブを変えられる帽子を使い分け、村人それぞれに仕事を任せながら、村を発展させよう。だが…ある晩、隣の城でアイドル魔王のライブが開催され、熱狂した魔物たちが村になだれ込んでくる！？

en.name: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
en.description: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!

games.name: Flowers to Honey
games.description: ハチの進化を選び、花を植え、巣を導き、繁栄するハチミツ帝国を築いていく、心地よいインクリメンタルゲーム

en.name: Flowers to Honey
en.description: A cozy incremental where you choose how your bees evolve, plant flowers, guide your hive, and grow a thriving honey empire.

games.name: How They Built the Pyramids
games.description: 1〜8人で遊べる、ハチャメチャなオンライン協力建築ゲーム。レンガを作り、巨大なピラミッドを建設しよう。生産ラインを自動化したり、仲間を雇ったり、あの手この手でレンガを頂上まで運ぼう！

en.name: How They Built the Pyramids
en.description: A chaotic online co-op building game for 1–8 players. Make bricks, build a giant pyramid and turn a small operation into a massive automated production line. Work together, hire help and find increasingly ridiculous ways to get those bricks to the top.

games.name: Springs, Eternal
games.description: 暗く静かな夜。謎めいた温泉保養地にやってきたあなたは、同じように人生に迷い、この場所に引き寄せられた様々な人物と出会うこととなります。

trailers.name: Springs, Eternal - ローンチトレーラー
Springs, Eternal - 発売日発表トレーラー
Springs, Eternal - アナウンストレイラー

en.name: Springs, Eternal
en.description: A first-person story exploration game from the studio that brought you Gone Home & Tacoma. Explore a mysterious hot springs in the dead of night and meet the other lost souls who are drawn to this place.

games.name: ファーム＆フィースト / Farm & Feast
games.shortName: ファーム＆フィースト / FARM & FEAST
genres: 農場シミュレーション
games.description: 新鮮な食材を育て、自分だけの小さなレストランを切り盛りしましょう。畑から食卓へとつながる、穏やかな一日を味わってください。楽しい一日のために新鮮なメニューを考え、食料庫をいっぱいに保ち、お客さまを笑顔にしましょう。自分のお金を稼いで、あなたの小さな世界を一歩ずつ築いていきます。

en.name: Farm & Feast
en.description: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.

games.name: ストームフォージ
genres: オープンワールドサバイバルクラフト
games.description: 1〜8人用のこのオープンワールドサバイバルクラフトゲームで、竜巻が迫り来る魔法の嵐に立ち向かえ。竜巻から逃げ切るかその風に乗り、新たな島へ航海し、ボスを倒してクラスをアンロックし、次なる混沌の嵐を乗り越えられる家を建てよう。

en.name: Stormforge
en.description: Brave magical storms where tornadoes hunt you in this open-world survival crafting game for 1 to 8 players. Outrun the tornadoes or ride their winds, sail to new islands, defeat bosses to unlock classes, and build a home that can weather the next chaos storm.

games.name: Fat Goblins
games.description: ゴブリンだらけの16対16チームバトル！帽子を奪い、城壁を攻め、味方のぽっちゃりプリンセスを救い出そう。捕らえた敵のプリンセスにはおいしい肉をたっぷりと！新しい帽子やクラスを解放して、おバカでハチャメチャなPvP戦争で何度でも倒し合おう！

trailers.name: Fat Goblins Steam Next Fest Trailer
Fat Goblins Raw Playtest Demo Reel

en.name: Fat Goblins
en.description: Prepare for goblin-packed, hat-stealing, and princess-fattening team based 16v16 combat! Siege the castle walls, rescue your pudgy princess, fatten up the enemy princess with delicious meat, unlock new hats & classes, and kill each other repeatedly in silly and chaotic PvP war!

games.name: 雨降る街のホープ
games.description: 17歳のホープ・ソンにとって最大の悩みは大学入試……のはずだった。荒らされたアパートと、消えた両親を目にするまでは。芸術家の目で捜査し、スケッチを証拠へと変え、答えを見つけるたびに奇妙さと闇を増していく家族の謎を追え。

trailers.name: Hope in the City - 発売開始！
新シネマティックトレーラー

en.name: Hope in the City
en.description: 17-year-old Hope Song thought the national exams were her biggest worry... until she got home to a ransacked apartment and two missing parents. Investigate through the eyes of an artist, turn sketches into evidence, and watch her family's mystery grow stranger and darker with every answer.

games.name: Skyreap
games.description: 忘れられた浮遊諸島を探索しよう。資源を集め、生産を建設・自動化し、島々を結んで繁栄する交易網を築き、やがて空があなたのものになるまで。

en.name: Skyreap
en.description: Explore a forgotten archipelago of floating islands. Gather resources, build and automate production, and link islands into a thriving trade network, until the sky belongs to you.

games.name: Kimbap Heaven Simulator
genres: 人生シミュレーション
games.description: Kimbap Heaven Simulatorで、自分だけの韓国食堂を経営しよう。お米を研ぎ、食材を茹で、キンパを巻くリアルな調理を体験。おいしい料理でお客さんを満足させ、資金や在庫を管理しながら店を拡大し、自分だけのグルメ帝国を築き上げよう。

en.name: Kimbap Heaven Simulator
en.description: Run your own Korean restaurant in Kimbap Heaven Simulator. Dive into a realistic cooking experience—wash, blanch, and roll your way to success. Satisfy customers with delicious recipes, manage your finances, and expand your business to build a culinary empire.

games.name: Gas N Cars
genres: 乗り物シミュレーション
games.description: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.

en.name: Gas N Cars
en.description: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.

games.name: Edge of the Blade
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: 血と鋼に染まる戦乱の地で、軍団を指揮せよ。ローグライト×大戦略×オートバトラー。三つの軍団から一つを率いて青丘を駆け、週ごとに拠点を攻略し、デッキを強化してリアルタイムのオートバトルに挑め。ストーリーモードでは、あなたの選択が誰が生き、誰が死ぬかを決める。

trailers.name: 発売日公開トレーラー

en.name: Edge of the Blade
en.description: Command your legion in a war-torn land of blood and steel. A roguelite grand-strategy autobattler: lead one of three legions across Cheonggu, capture strongholds week by week, build your deck, and clash in real-time auto battles. In Story Mode, your choices decide who lives and dies

games.name: Beholder: The Landlord's Handbook - Digital Comic
games.description: A digital comic set in the Beholder universe, presented as a handbook for the ever-watchful landlord. Discover the fine art of minding everyone else's business through dark humor, suspicious tenants, and the absurd rules of the Great State that never stops watching.

en.name: Beholder: The Landlord's Handbook - Digital Comic
en.description: A digital comic set in the Beholder universe, presented as a handbook for the ever-watchful landlord. Discover the fine art of minding everyone else's business through dark humor, suspicious tenants, and the absurd rules of the Great State that never stops watching.

games.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon
games.description: 100年以上の歴史を通じて映画館を経営するタイクーンゲーム。第7芸術の進化に追いつかれないよう、自分の映画帝国を築き、カスタマイズしましょう。

en.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon
en.description: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

games.name: Midwest 90: Rapid City
games.description: 『Midwest 90: Rapid City』は、モンスター・アポカリプスを舞台にした経営サバイバル・シミュレーションです。モンスター肉を出すロードサイド・ダイナーを経営し、利益を取るか街の存続を取るかを選択しよう。怪物と戦う者は、自らも怪物になりかねないのだから。商売を続けるため、あなたはどこまで踏み込みますか？

trailers.name: M90 Steam Next Fest Gameplay Trailer

en.name: Midwest 90: Rapid City
en.description: Midwest 90: Rapid City is a tycoon survival sim in a monster apocalypse. Run a roadhouse serving monster meat and choose between profit or the city's survival, because those who fight monsters risk becoming one. How far will you go to stay in business?

games.name: Pro Basketball Manager 2027
games.description: Take charge of a basketball club and oversee every aspect of its development. Build your roster, discover emerging talent, develop future stars, and implement the tactical vision that will define your team's identity.

en.name: Pro Basketball Manager 2027
en.description: Take charge of a basketball club and oversee every aspect of its development. Build your roster, discover emerging talent, develop future stars, and implement the tactical vision that will define your team's identity.

games.name: STARLINERS
games.description: From Earth to the Moon and beyond, build colonies, develop industries, and manage supply chains in this incremental logistics game. Harness the resources of the Solar System to build an ark and carry humanity to other stars.

en.name: STARLINERS
en.description: From Earth to the Moon and beyond, build colonies, develop industries, and manage supply chains in this incremental logistics game. Harness the resources of the Solar System to build an ark and carry humanity to other stars.

games.name: Palisade
games.description: 部隊の細かな操作を排し、地図上で直接領土を指揮するリアルタイム戦略ゲーム。国境を広げ、補給道路をつなぎ、騎兵突撃と上陸作戦で敵陣を突破しよう。6つの歴史キャンペーン、スカーミッシュ、マップエディター、最大8人のオンライン対戦を収録。

trailers.name: Palisade - 公式ゲームプレイトレーラー

en.name: Palisade
en.description: Command frontlines directly in a real time territorial strategy game. Push borders, link settlements with supply roads, and break defenses with cavalry and naval landings. Includes six historical campaigns, Skirmish, a built in map editor, and online matches for up to eight players.

games.name: Fleshbound
games.description: Sam agrees to help his friends by staying the night in their house while they leave for urgent business. Outside, a heavy rainstorm rages, with loud thunderclaps shaking the walls and creating an oppressive atmosphere.

en.name: Fleshbound
en.description: Sam agrees to help his friends by staying the night in their house while they leave for urgent business. Outside, a heavy rainstorm rages, with loud thunderclaps shaking the walls and creating an oppressive atmosphere.

games.name: Big Scoop: Trash Cleaning Simulator
games.description: 海はプラスチックごみであふれている。船を操り、ごみを飲み込み、港で売って船を大きく。全長3.6mの小舟から70mのメガスクープへ、40隻を超える船団を育てよう。ひとりでも、最大4人のオンライン協力プレイでも。海がターコイズブルーに戻るまで、ごみを拾い尽くそう。

en.name: Big Scoop: Trash Cleaning Simulator
en.description: The ocean is drowning in plastic. Steer your boat, scoop up trash, sell at port and grow from a 3.6 m Skiff to a 70 m Megascoop with over 40 boats in your fleet. Play solo or in a crew of up to 4 online, and clean it all up until the sea turns turquoise again.

games.name: Wizard Jars: Tidy Up Together
games.description: 『Wizard Jars』は、ひとりでもオンライン協力プレイでも楽しめる、のんびりした整理整頓ゲーム。散らかった魔法薬店で3,240個の魔法の瓶を棚に戻し、お客さんの依頼をこなし、アップグレードを解放して、お店に秩序を取り戻そう。

en.name: Wizard Jars: Tidy Up Together
en.description: Wizard Jars is a cozy solo and co-op sorting game where you organize 3,240 magical jars in a chaotic apothecary. Put every jar back on its shelf, fulfill magical customer requests, unlock useful upgrades, and restore the apothecary to perfect order

games.name: TORAWASE: The Girl in the Mirror
games.shortName: TORAWASE: THE GIRL IN THE MIRROR
games.description: After his fiancée returns to Japan for work in this visual novel by Dark One!, our protagonist begins dreaming of being a woman in the Middle Ages. The more he has these dreams, the more he becomes a woman in real life. Can he reverse his transformation, or will his life take a different turn?

en.name: TORAWASE: The Girl in the Mirror
en.description: After his fiancée returns to Japan for work in this visual novel by Dark One!, our protagonist begins dreaming of being a woman in the Middle Ages. The more he has these dreams, the more he becomes a woman in real life. Can he reverse his transformation, or will his life take a different turn?

games.name: ロムル
games.description: ロムルは人工知能を備えた戦利品収集協力型ホラーゲームです。音声操作に対応し、本格的な人工知能を持つロボットと共に、不安定な重力を持つ放棄された宇宙ステーションを探索しましょう。モンスターの中で生き延び、目標を撮影し、貴重な貨物を持ち出してください。

en.name: ROMUL
en.description: ROMUL is a co-op looting horror game with AI. Together with a voice-controlled robot with full AI, explore abandoned space stations with unstable gravity. Survive among monsters, photograph objectives, and extract valuable cargo.

games.name: Brick Buddies
games.description: ブロックをひとつ手に取って、小さな世界を作りましょう。説明書を見ながら組み立て、シールを貼り、新しい作品を集める、心安らぐブロック組み立てゲームです。ひとりでのんびり、友達とおしゃべりしながら。少しずつコレクションを増やしていきましょう。

en.name: Brick Buddies
en.description: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.

games.name: Hillthorn
games.description: 隔絶された共同体で起こった失踪事件。真相が眠る山。探偵に迫るタイムリミット。ダークな捜査ゲーム、Hillthornへようこそ。ゲーム中の会話は一切なし。プレイヤーのあなたは論理力と直感力を駆使しながら、手渡されたカードを元に謎の究明を目指す。

en.name: Hillthorn
en.description: A disappearance in a secluded community. A mountain hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game that invites you to uncover the mystery without a single word spoken, using your skills of logic and intuition through cards.

games.name: Touhou: Your Reimu
games.description: 博麗霊夢があなたのデスクトップにやってきます。つついたり持ち上げたりすると霊夢らしく反応し、やることリストやアラームも一緒に見てくれます。そっけないけれど、さりげなくそばにいてくれる霊夢です。

en.name: Touhou: Your Reimu
en.description: Hakurei Reimu comes to your desktop. Poke her or pick her up and she reacts just like Reimu would, and she'll keep an eye on your to-dos and alarms too. Blunt, but the type who quietly sticks by your side.

games.name: HANDS OVER
games.description: HANDS OVERは5人協力ホラーゲーム。無害に見える試練が、運と度胸を試す残酷な場に変わります。ブラフをかけ、友達を妨害し、汚く立ち回って、誰よりも長くテーブルに残りましょう。

en.name: HANDS OVER
en.description: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.

games.name: まあだだよ
games.description: まあだだよ。シーカーの目の前に隠れて、何周目で見つかるか試そう！友達を誘って、楽しいかくれんぼに！家具に変身して色を塗り、周囲に溶け込んだり、変な音声を録音してイタズラしたり、両陣営のスキルを駆使して大活躍！今度は君が探す番？気をつけて。部屋のどのアイテムも、何か企んでいるかも……！

en.name: FAKE ME
en.description: Model, paint, and blend in! FAKE ME is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you create your own disguise. Use simple 3D modeling tools to build the object you’ll hide as. You can also create your own costume by modeling. Hide from the Seekers or find every Faker before time runs out!

games.name: What the Buck?!
games.description: 『What the Buck?!』は、お金を破壊する爽快なインクリメンタルゲーム。札束を裁断し、テーブル中に連鎖反応を巻き起こし、プレステージで永続的なアップグレードを手に入れ、お金の破壊を自動化しよう。体験版の進行状況を製品版に引き継ぎ可能。

en.name: What the Buck?!
en.description: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.

games.name: MycoRelic
games.description: MycoRelicは、部族風のキノコ型ロボットが生息する島を舞台にした、協力型の三人称視点アクションRPGです。放棄された工場を探索し、ロボットの体を強化しましょう。古代の神殿を巡り、忘れ去られた元素の力を取り入れ、キノコを進化させましょう。

trailers.name: MycoRelic - Early Access Release Announcement Trailer

en.name: MycoRelic
en.description: MycoRelic is a cooperative third person action-RPG set on islands inhabited by tribal mushroom robots. Loot derelict foundries to upgrade your robotic body. Explore ancient temples to infuse your fungus with forgotten elemental powers.

games.name: フロンティア物語
games.description: フロンティア物語は、エクストラクションと拠点づくりを融合させた冒険スローライフゲームです。武器を鍛え、未知の世界を探索し、貴重な財宝を持ち帰りましょう。温かみのあるセルルックで描かれたファンタジー世界で、個性豊かな仲間たちとともに、祖先から受け継いだ荒れ果てた領地を開拓。資源を集め、村を発展させ、絆を深めながら、自分だけの理想のホームを築き上げましょう。

en.name: Frontier Tale
en.description: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.

games.name: GoGeez
games.description: GoGeezは、かわいいちびキャラたちを集め、デッキを組み、カードをレベルアップさせる放置系カードゲームです。強力なシナジーを見つけ、コンボをつなげて、数値が爆発的に伸びていく爽快感を楽しもう

en.name: GoGeez
en.description: GoGeez is an idle card game about collecting cute little chibi creatures, building your deck, and leveling up your cards. Discover powerful synergies, stack combos, and watch your numbers grow exponentially

games.name: Worst Class Ever
genres: ソーシャルディダクション
games.description: 鬼教師1人 VS イタズラ生徒7人！最大8人で遊べる対戦パーティーゲーム。生徒は数十人のNPC生徒に紛れて、つまみ食いやスマホいじりのミッションをこっそり達成しよう。先生の目標は、隠れたイタズラ生徒を全員捕まえること。教室の平和を取り戻せ！

en.name: Worst Class Ever
en.description: 1 Teacher vs 7 Students. Hide. Prank. Survive. Up to 8-player asymmetric party chaos! Mischievous students blend into dozens of NPC classmates, secretly snacking, texting, and causing trouble, while the teacher must spot these wannabe delinquents and restore complete order to the classroom.

games.name: スロットバウンド - Slotbound
games.shortName: スロットバウンド - SLOTBOUND
games.description: 運と戦略が交差する、ローグライト・オートバトラー防衛ゲーム。3x3 スロットマシンを回してユニットを召喚し、仲間を吸収して軍勢を強化しましょう。アイテムとコアを駆使して確率を操り、手強い審判ウェーブやボスウェーブを生き残れ。すべてのスピンと、すべての選択が勝敗を分けます。

en.name: Slotbound
en.description: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.

games.name: GroundInFlames
games.description: GroundInFlames is real-time tactics about modern combined-arms warfare. Trenches, suppression and squad morale, FPV drones and electronic warfare, honest armor penetration and vehicle modules. Manpower is scarce, supply runs out, and the enemy only knows what it has seen.

en.name: GroundInFlames
en.description: GroundInFlames is real-time tactics about modern combined-arms warfare. Trenches, suppression and squad morale, FPV drones and electronic warfare, honest armor penetration and vehicle modules. Manpower is scarce, supply runs out, and the enemy only knows what it has seen.

games.name: BATTLE BEARS GOLD
genres: サードパーソンシューティング
ツインスティックシューティング
games.description: An award-winning 4v4 third-person class shooter with more personality than sense! The mobile classic millions grew up with is now on PC. Choose from 11 unique classes, mix hundreds of thousands of loadout combinations, and battle it out online or with friends across 16 wacky maps!

en.name: BATTLE BEARS GOLD
en.description: An award-winning 4v4 third-person class shooter with more personality than sense! The mobile classic millions grew up with is now on PC. Choose from 11 unique classes, mix hundreds of thousands of loadout combinations, and battle it out online or with friends across 16 wacky maps!

games.name: Engagement
games.description: 大型艦を指揮し、ひとりで、あるいは最大4人の協力プレイで、救援が来るまで灰の帯をホロウやその他の敵から守り抜け。強化はすべて目に見えるハードポイントに据えた砲塔。雇った護衛艦は名前と撃墜数を受け継ぎ、戦いは毎回違う展開を見せる。

en.name: Engagement
en.description: Command a capital ship alone or up to 4 players co-op and hold the Belt of Ashes against the Hollow and more until relief arrives. Every upgrade is a turret bolted to a hardpoint you can see, your escorts you recruit keep their names and kills, and every fight has variety to make it new.

games.name: Beellionaire Incremental: Bee Simulator
games.description: 谷にある5,000,000リットルの巨大な瓶を満たそう！最初の巣を手作業で収穫し、ホース網をつなぎ、ドローンと全自動マシンで毎秒10,000リットルの生産へ！200以上のアップグレードを解放し、農場でギターを弾いてくつろぎながら、8〜10時間の癒やし系インクリメンタル体験で瓶の秘密を解き明かそう！

en.name: Beellionaire Incremental: Bee Simulator
en.description: Fill a giant 5,000,000-liter jar in the valley! Harvest your first honeycomb by hand, lay hose networks, and scale up to 10,000 liters/sec with drones and full automation. Unlock 200+ upgrades, play guitar on your farm, and uncover the jar's secret in this cozy 8-10 hour journey!

games.name: Hamstr Protocol
games.description: ハムスターが動かすバイオマイニング事業を築こう。自分の手でリグを組み立て、温度を管理し、ハムスターにエサを与えて生産を維持。ガレージから始め、設備を最適化して大規模な産業施設へと成長させよう。

en.name: Hamstr Protocol
en.description: Build a hamster-powered bio-mining operation from the ground up. Assemble rigs by hand, manage heat, feed your runners, and keep production moving. Start in a garage, optimize every part of your operation, and scale into a full-scale industrial operation.

games.name: Handmancers
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: Handmancersは「グー・チョキ・パー」をテーマにした一人称視点のローグライト・デッキビルダー。デッキを構築し、カードを強化し、強力なアーティファクトを装備して、戦略的なバトルで強敵に挑もう

en.name: Handmancers
en.description: Handmancers is a Rock, Paper, Scissors Roguelite deckbuilder with a first-person twist where clear tactical choices meet deck-building depth. Craft your deck, enhance your cards, equip tricky artifacts and face powerful enemies in strategic fights

games.name: The Hero's Legacy
games.description: 『Realm of the Mad God』の弾幕協力プレイと、『Path of Exile』『Diablo』の戦利品とビルド構築を融合したピクセルアートのARPG。ソロ、オンライン、LAN、最大4人の画面分割ローカル協力プレイに対応。ソフトコアでもハードコアでも遊べる。

en.name: The Hero's Legacy
en.description: A pixel ARPG that mixes the bullet-hell co-op of Realm of the Mad God with the loot and builds of Path of Exile and Diablo. Play solo, online, on LAN or in 4-player split-screen couch co-op. Play Softcore or Hardcore.

games.name: Potions Galore
games.description: A slow-paced, cozy sorting game where you organize 2900+ potions, with no magical upgrades. Just you, the Alchemist's book, and a shop full of mysteries. Read each potion's description, use narrative clues to find out where it belongs, and tidy up the shop!

en.name: Potions Galore
en.description: A slow-paced, cozy sorting game, where you organize 2900+ potions in a fantasy alchemy shop. Read the book to learn about each new potion. Use narrative deduction to find the correct placement and tidy up the mess!

games.name: Treeternal
games.description: Chop, upgrade, repeat. Venture into a fast-regrowing forest in this top-down incremental roguelite. Draft cards to expand your level-up deck, recruit woodcutter friends, and scale your logging empire to harvest massive amounts of timber.

en.name: Treeternal
en.description: Chop, upgrade, repeat. Venture into a fast-regrowing forest in this top-down incremental roguelite. Draft cards to expand your level-up deck, recruit woodcutter friends, and scale your logging empire to harvest massive amounts of timber.

games.name: Menthal
games.description: Menthalは一人称視点のホラーゲームです。あなたは人体実験の被験者となり、実験薬を服用し、副作用に耐えながら、その先に待ち受ける出来事から生き延びなければなりません。

en.name: Menthal
en.description: Menthal is a first-person horror game where you are the test subject. Take experimental medicine, endure the side effects, and try to survive what happens next.

games.name: Football Manager 27
games.description: クラブを選んで指揮を執り、理想のチームを作り上げ、自分だけの戦術を確立しましょう。そして、あなただけが思い描く未来を追い求めてください。 『FM27』では、あなたのサッカーへの信念が現実になります。すべては、あなたの手に委ねられています。

trailers.name: Gameplay Preview: New Features & Upgrades in Action (EN)

en.name: Football Manager 27
en.description: Choose the club. Shape the squad. Set the tactics as the manager of the world’s greatest football clubs. FM27 is where footballing beliefs become reality in a living, breathing football world that blends strategy with RPG in the ultimate sport simulation game.

games.name: デッドバイデイライト
games.shortName: デッドバイデイライト
games.description: 恐怖に満ちた10年。ジャンプスケアに間一髪の回避、残酷な処刑に手に汗握る脱出劇…それは死と隣り合わせの10年。 不気味な悪が支配する領域に、永遠に閉じ込められた生存者たち…その死にさえ救済のない世界で、粘り強い生存者4人と血に飢えた殺人鬼1人が知恵と度胸の試される残酷なゲームに挑む。最高の非対称マルチプレイホラーゲームで生存者または殺人鬼となり、スリルと恐怖に満ちた世界を堪能しよう。

en.name: Dead by Daylight
en.description: 10 years of horror. 10 years of jump scares and close calls. 10 years of brutal sacrifices and thrilling escapes. Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits.

games.name: SILENT HILL: Townfall
games.description: 「状況を正す」べく、海に浮かぶ孤島セントアメリアへと呼び戻されたサイモン・オーデル。だが、そんな彼を緊張感の漂うステルス、一触即発の戦闘、そして知を試される困難なパズルが待ち受ける。全てを越えた先に待つ、霧に沈んだ町の深淵に隠された真相とは。

en.name: SILENT HILL: Townfall
en.description: Returning to an island town to ‘put things right’, Simon Ordell descends into a world of tense evasion, explosive confrontations, and mind-bending puzzles that slowly surface the truth of St. Amelia.

games.name: Shift At Midnight
games.description: 最大3人でオンライン協力プレイを楽しめる、探偵ホラーゲーム。ランダムに生成されたシフトで力を合わせて客を調査し、誰が人間になりすましているかを突き止めよう。一つでもミスをすれば、建物に立てこもって罠を仕掛け、身を隠さなければならない。

en.name: Shift At Midnight
en.description: An online co-op detective horror for up to 3 players. Work together across randomly generated shifts to investigate your customers, as some are only pretending to be human. Make one mistake, and you’ll be forced to board up, set traps, and hide.

games.name: Active Matter
games.description: 崩壊した多元宇宙を舞台にした、この新しいリアルミリタリーシューターで、戦利品を求めて危険なレイドに参加したり、激しいPvPバトルに参加したりしよう。時間と空間を曲げる物質「アクティブマター」の支配権をめぐり、量子不安定ゾーンで戦え。

en.name: Active Matter
en.description: Join dangerous raids for loot or intense PvP/PvE battles in this new realistic military shooter set in a fractured multiverse. Fight in quantum-unstable zones for control of active matter - the substance that bends time and space.

games.name: Content Warning
games.description: SpöökTubeでバズるために、怖いことをしているお友達の姿を撮ろう！(一人で行かないことを強くオススメする）

en.name: Content Warning
en.description: Film your friends doing scary things to become SpöökTube famous! (strongly advised to not go alone)

games.name: Escape from Playtime
games.description: 廃墟と化したおもちゃ工場に閉じ込められたあなたと仲間たちが繰り広げる、1～4人向けオンライン協力型ホラーゲーム。目的を明かさぬ謎の声に従って変化し続ける道を探索し、道具を探しながら闇に潜むクリーチャーと生き残りをかけて戦おう。

trailers.name: Release Date Trailer - Escape from Playtime
Everything You Need To Know - Escape From Playtime

en.name: Escape from Playtime
en.description: An online 2-8 player co-op horror experience where you and your friends are trapped in an abandoned toy factory. A mysterious voice commands you for an unknown purpose as you explore shifting halls, scavenge for tools, and fight for survival against creatures that lurk in the dark.

games.name: REANIMAL
games.description: Little Nightmares™ I & IIのクリエイターからお届けするダークで恐ろしい冒険。このホラー・アドベンチャーゲームは、ある兄弟が行方不明の友達を助け、故郷の島から逃げ出す物語を描いています。

en.name: REANIMAL
en.description: The creators of Little Nightmares™ I & II have returned to take you on a darker, more terrifying journey than ever before. In this horror adventure game, a brother & sister go through hell to rescue their missing friends and escape the island that they used to call home.

games.name: 零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE
games.description: 今度こそ離さない―― 妖しく羽化する、美しき恐怖。

trailers.name: 『零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE』ローンチトレーラー
『零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE』ゲーム紹介トレーラー
『零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE』発売日告知トレーラー

en.name: FATAL FRAME II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE
en.description: Together, always.

games.name: GONE Fishing
games.description: GONE Fishing は、1〜8人で遊べるサバイバルホラーです。仲間と力を合わせ、釣りで生き延びましょう。生き残る唯一の方法は、湖の底なしの飢えを満たし続けること。さもなければ、喰われるのはあなたです。 あなたはその飢えを満たせるか……それとも、次の生贄になるか？

en.name: GONE Fishing
en.description: GONE Fishing is a 1-8 player survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you. Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?

games.name: リトルナイトメア3
games.description: 『リトルナイトメア3』はふたりの主人公ロゥとアローンが出口のない“ノーウェア“から抜け出す旅をするサスペンスアドベンチャーゲームです。ふたりで協力してパズルを解き、恐怖に立ち向かいましょう。 オンラインでの2人協力プレイはもちろん、AIとのソロプレイでもお楽しみいただけます。

trailers.name: Little Nightmares III - Pre-Order Trailer - EN

en.name: Little Nightmares III
en.description: Little Nightmares III is an atmospheric adventure game in which you follow the journey of Low and Alone, two best friends in search of a way out of the Nowhere. In 2 players online cooperation or solo with an A.I., work together to solve puzzles and survive in this nightmarish world.

games.name: MISERY
games.description: 『MISERY』は、核災害区域を舞台にした1～10人プレイの協力型サバイバルゲーム。ここでは毎日が闘いだ。放射能に汚染された廃墟で資源を探し、バンカーを建設し、武器をクラフトし、仲間と共に自動生成される奇妙な世界を探索しよう。アノマリー、モンスター、そして武装した盗賊には気をつけろ。

en.name: MISERY
en.description: MISERY is a 1–10 player co-op survival game set in a nuclear disaster zone. Here, every day is a struggle: search radioactive ruins for resources, build your bunker, craft weapons, and explore a weird, procedurally-generated world with your friends. Beware of anomalies, monsters, and armed bandits.

games.name: DON'T SCREAM TOGETHER
games.description: 『DON’T SCREAM TOGETHER』は、1993年の真っ暗な森を仲間とカメラ片手に歩くオンライン協力型ホラーシミュレーターです。近距離ボイスチャットで協力して脱出を目指そう。ただし誰かが叫ぶとゲームがリスタート、またはハンターとして復活します！

trailers.name: DON'T SCREAM TOGETHER Announcement Teaser Trailer

en.name: DON'T SCREAM TOGETHER
en.description: A very simple co-op jumpscare horror experience where you and friends walk through a pitch black forest and try to stay quiet. Reach 8:00 AM without screaming or making a loud noise, or everyone dies. You will scream, shout, and probably laugh.

games.name: Labyrinthine
games.description: A co-op horror game like no other... Play with 1-8 players online as you solve puzzles, collect items and run from the horrors that lie within. Follow in the footsteps of Joan in the story mode or tackle procedurally generated maps that scale with your level and bring a fresh experience each game..

en.name: Labyrinthine
en.description: A co-op horror game like no other... Play with 1-8 players online as you solve puzzles, collect items and run from the horrors that lie within. Follow in the footsteps of Joan in the story mode or tackle procedurally generated maps that scale with your level and bring a fresh experience each game..

games.name: MADiSON
games.description: MADiSONは、没入感あふれる恐ろしい体験をお届けする一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラーゲームです。インスタントカメラで人間の世界とあの世をつなぎ、写真を撮って自らの手で現像しましょう。パズルを解き、周囲を探索し、そして何よりも――生き延びてください。

en.name: MADiSON
en.description: MADiSON is a first person psychological horror game that delivers an immersive and terrifying experience. With the help of an instant camera, connect the human world with the beyond, take pictures and develop them by yourself. Solve puzzles, explore your surroundings and most importantly, survive.

games.name: The Headliners
games.description: 協力型ホラーゲームで、1～8人のジャーナリストチームとなり、致命的なクリーチャーに侵略されたニューヨークを探索し、壮大な写真を撮影します。あなたの唯一の目標は、見出しを飾ること...そして、生きてそれを読むことです。

en.name: The Headliners
en.description: Co-op horror game where you play in teams of 1 to 8 reckless journalists, ready to explore a city overrun by deadly creatures to snap spectacular footage. Your only goal: make the headlines without becoming one.

games.name: Dead Island 2
games.description: 致命的なウイルスが蔓延し、人々が次々とゾンビに変わっていくロサンゼルス。あなたもゾンビに噛まれ、感染してしまいますが、免疫によって助かります。アウトブレイクの真相を探りながら、自分が何者なのかを解き明かしていきましょう。生き残りながら進化を続け、究極のゾンビスレイヤーとなるのです。

trailers.name: Dead Island 2 Ultimate Edition Launch Trailer
Dead Island 2 Neighborhood Watch Reveal Trailer JPN
Dead Island 2 Steam Launch Trailer JAP

en.name: Dead Island 2
en.description: A deadly virus is spreading across Los Angeles, turning its inhabitants into zombies. Bitten, infected, but more than just immune, uncover the truth behind the outbreak and discover who - or what - you are. Survive, evolve and become the ultimate Zombie Slayer.

games.name: The Last of Us™ Part II Remastered
games.shortName: THE LAST OF US PART II REMASTERED
genres: サードパーソンシューティング
games.description: ゲーム・オブ・ザ・イヤーをはじめ300以上のゲームアワードを受賞した作品がPCに登場。進化したグラフィックでエリーとアビーの物語を楽しもう。ローグライクなサバイバル体験が可能なゲームモード「No Return」など、さまざまな新規機能も追加。

en.name: The Last of Us™ Part II Remastered
en.description: Experience the winner of over 300 Game of the Year awards, now on PC. Discover Ellie and Abby’s story with graphical enhancements, gameplay modes like the roguelike survival experience No Return, and more.

games.name: YAPYAP
games.description: YapYapとは、魔導師となり、ライバルの塔を荒らすために最大5人の友だちを手下として召喚する魔法協力型ホラーゲームだ。様々な呪文を唱え、塔を守る魔獣やモンスターを避けつつ破壊目標を達成せよ。

en.name: YAPYAP
en.description: A magic-themed co-op horror game where you and up to 5 friends are minions summoned by a wizard to break into their rival's towers to cause mayhem. Try to fufill your vandalism target with an assortment of spells while avoiding magical beasts and monsters that protect the tower.

games.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
games.shortName: INTO THE DEAD: OUR DARKEST DAYS
games.description: 1980年、テキサス州の街ウォルトンはゾンビで溢れかえっていた。窮地に立たされた生存者となり、物資を集めて装備を整え、安全なシェルターを探して過酷なサバイバルを乗り越えろ。慎重に計画を立て、力を合わせ、決して立ち止まってはならない——この地獄から生還したいのなら。

en.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
en.description: Texas, 1980. Walton City has fallen to a zombie outbreak. Lead a band of desperate survivors from refuge to refuge by scavenging, crafting, and fighting in a relentless struggle for survival. Plan wisely, stick together, and — above all — keep moving if you want to make it out alive.

games.name: Halloween: The Game
games.description: 1978年のハロウィンの夜、誰もマイケル・マイヤーズから逃れることはできない。『ハロウィン』でブギーマンになるか、悪の化身に立ち向かうかはあなた次第だ。

en.name: Halloween: The Game
en.description: On Halloween night, 1978, no one is safe from Michael Myers. Become the Boogeyman or fight back against the face of evil itself in Halloween.

games.name: Visage
games.description: Visage は一人称視点の心理ホラーゲームです。 薄気味悪い慰めと恐ろしいほど現実的な環境が混在する独特の雰囲気のある世界の中、ゆっくりとしたペースで進行します。怪しく、姿を変え続ける家を探索し、真の恐怖をご体験ください。

en.name: Visage
en.description: Visage is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a mysterious ever-changing house in a slow-paced, atmospheric world that combines both uncannily comforting and horrifyingly realistic environments, and enjoy a genuinely terrifying experience.

games.name: BIOHAZARD 3 LAST ESCAPE (1999)
games.description: あの忌まわしい洋館事件の生存者である「ジル・バレンタイン」を操り、悪夢の続きを目撃せよ。S.T.A.R.S.を辞め、ラクーンシティからの脱出を目論む彼女を待っていたのは、新たな困難だった。人間を捕食するゾンビで溢れた街から生きて逃げ出すには、知恵と力を最大限に振り絞らなければならない。

en.name: Resident Evil 3 Nemesis (1999)
en.description: Join Jill Valentine, the survivor of the notorious disaster, as her nightmare continues. After resigning from S.T.A.R.S. Jill now prepares to head out of Raccoon City… but caught in a town crawling with zombies, more than ever she must rely on brute force and cunning to find a way to escape alive.

games.name: Demonologist
games.description: Demonologistは、最低1人、最大4人で遊べるCo-Opホラーゲームです。呪われた場所にいる悪霊の種類を特定し、装備を駆使して悪霊を祓うことが目的です、一人でもチームでも楽しめます。

en.name: Demonologist
en.description: Demonologist is a Co-Op horror game that can be played with at least 1 and up to 4 players. Your goal is to identify the type of evil spirit in cursed places and exorcise it using your equipment, either alone or with your team.

games.name: The Past Within
games.description: 『The Past Within』は、ラスティレイクがお届けする新しい協力プレイ体験です！信頼できる誰かと一緒にプレイしましょう。それぞれが過去と未来でプレイすることになります。周りをよく観察して、見たものを相手に伝えましょう。パズルを解いて、アルバート・ヴァンダーブームの策略を明らかにしてください。

trailers.name: The Past Within - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer

en.name: The Past Within
en.description: The Past Within is the new co-op experience from Rusty Lake! Play together with someone you deem trustworthy: one in The Past, the other in The Future. Observe and communicate what you see around you. Solve the puzzles and uncover Albert Vanderboom’s plan.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's
games.description: Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where kids and parents alike come for entertainment and food! The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds! The robots' behavior has become somewhat unpredictable at night however, and it's your job to keep an eye on them!

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's
en.description: Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where kids and parents alike come for entertainment and food! The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds! The robots' behavior has become somewhat unpredictable at night however, and it's your job to keep an eye on them!

games.name: Zort
games.description: Zortは、最大4人で遊べるアクション、アドベンチャー、ホラーゲームです。友達と一緒にマップを探索し、さまざまなクリーチャーから逃げながら楽しんでください。ゲーム内のボイスチャットを使用して、友達とリアルなホラー体験を楽しんでください!

en.name: Zort
en.description: Zort is an action, adventure, and horror game that can be played with up to 4 people. Explore maps with your friends and have fun while escaping from various creatures. Experience a realistic horror experience with in-game voice chat with your friends!

games.name: Species: Unknown
games.description: Species: Unknownは1～4人協力プレイ対応のサバイバルホラーです。廃墟となった船で未知の生物に追われながら、危険なミッションを遂行しましょう。生き残り、装備を強化して暗闇に潜む新たな恐怖に立ち向かいましょう。

en.name: Species: Unknown
en.description: Species: Unknown is a 1 to 4 players co-op survival horror. Complete high-risk missions aboard an abandoned ship while being hunted by an unknown creature. Survive and upgrade your gear to face each new threat that lurks in the dark.

games.name: Gears of War: Reloaded
genres: サードパーソンシューティング
games.description: 象徴的なオリジナル作品を、忠実にリマスターしました。

en.name: Gears of War: Reloaded
en.description: Experience the origins of one of gaming’s most acclaimed franchises like never before, faithfully remastered and optimized for PC.

games.name: Oh Deer
genres: ソーシャルディダクション
games.description: ハンター1人、最大4人の友達がシカに変装しています。 このスリリングなかくれんぼゲームでは、すべての動きが最後かもしれません。 あなたは群れに紛れるか、目立ちますか？ オー、シカ...

en.name: Oh Deer
en.description: One hunter & up to 9 friends disguised as deer. A game of hide-and-seek where every move could be your last. Will you blend in with the herd or stand out? Oh Deer...

games.name: [Chilla's Art] The Convenience Store | 夜勤事件
games.description: 夜勤事件は、コンビニの夜勤で働く女子大生に関するJホラーゲームです。

en.name: [Chilla's Art] The Convenience Store | 夜勤事件
en.description: The Convenience Store | 夜勤事件 is a J-horror game about a college girl on a night shift.

games.name: The Mortuary Assistant
games.description: 隣り合わせの死…。遺体をエンバームして悪霊を追い払い、自身の魂を守れ。

en.name: The Mortuary Assistant
en.description: Alone with the dead... Embalm corpses, banish demons, save your soul.

games.name: BIOHAZARD 2 (1998)
games.description: はじめての任務に向かう途中で大事件に巻き込まれた新人警官の「レオン・Ｓ・ケネディ」と、音信不通となった兄を捜す「クレア・レッドフィールド」の物語が個別に展開。最新の3Dアクセラレーテッドグラフィックスが、リアルな恐怖体験を呼び起こす。

en.name: Resident Evil 2 (1998)
en.description: Command Leon S. Kennedy, a rookie cop who stumbles onto the carnage reporting for his first duty, or play as Claire Redfield, desperately searching for her missing brother. Cutting edge 3-D accelerated graphics that create a terrifying, photo-realistic experience.

games.name: Pacify
games.description: PAH社のために超自然的な生物を鎮め、弱体化させ、捕獲するオンライン協力型ホラーゲームです。各ステージには異なるストーリー、ユニークなモンスター、そして複数のエンディングが用意されています。シングルプレイはもちろん、最大6人の友達と一緒にプレイすることも可能です。楽しいエフェクト付きの近接ボイスチャット機能も搭載されています。

trailers.name: Pacify - New Scary Horror Gameplay Trailer

en.name: Pacify
en.description: An online co-op horror game where you pacify, weaken and capture supernatural creatures for PAH Inc. Each level has a different story, unique monsters, and multiple endings. Play single player or together with up to 6 friends. Includes proximity voice chat with fun effects.

games.name: 人喰ノ檻 - KLETKA
games.description: KLETKA(クレトカ)は、君たち囚人を捕食しようとするエレベーターに乗って、地下深くへ降りていく協力型ホラーゲームだ。エレベーターに食べられないよう餌を与え、トラップやモンスターを避け、地下深くまで降りていこう。

en.name: KLETKA
en.description: KLETKA is a co-op (up to 6 players) horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you. Feed the elevator, explore deadly floors and descend deeper.

games.name: PANICORE (パニコアー)
games.description: PANICOREは、パーマデス、AIモンスター、協力プレイをミックスしたサバイバルホラーゲームだ。捕まらないように脱出を試みるが、注意：彼らはあなたの足音だけでなく、声も聞いている。

en.name: PANICORE
en.description: PANICORE is a survival horror game that mixes permadeath, AI monsters and a co-op experience up to 5 players (4 players in demo). Try to escape and don't get caught, but beware: they don't only hear your steps, but also your voice.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
games.shortName: FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S: SECRET OF THE M
games.description: ここは「マレーのコスチュームマナー」。廃墟となったワークショップに立ち入り、隠遁発明家のエドウィン・マレーが残した謎を解き明かせ。『Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic』で、すべての暗がりに秘密が潜み、光がちらつくたびに決して消えることのない脅威を思い起こさせる世界へ足を踏みいれよう。

trailers.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic Trailer

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
en.description: Enter the abandoned workshop of Murray’s Costume Manor and unravel the mystery left behind by the reclusive inventor. In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, you’ll step into a world where every dark corner holds a secret and every flicker of light hints at an ever-present threat.

games.name: Barotrauma
games.description: 『Barotrauma』は、宇宙サバイバルホラー・潜水艦シュミレーターにRPG要素を加えたの2D協力ゲームです。潜水艦を操作して、ミッションをクリアし、モンスターと戦い、リークを修復して、機械を操作して、銃を使い、アイテムをクラフトします。油断は禁物です：ここでは危険の通知というものが存在しません！

en.name: Barotrauma
en.description: Barotrauma is a 2D co-op submarine simulator – in space, with survival horror and RPG elements. Steer your submarine, complete missions, fight monsters, fix leaks, operate machinery, man the guns and craft items, and stay alert: danger in Barotrauma doesn’t announce itself!

games.name: DON'T SCREAM
games.description: 叫んだら即終了。2人の作者により、Unreal Engine 5を駆使して開発された短編ホラゲー。クリア条件は、なんと「叫ばずに18分間森を探索する」…だけ？と思いきや、「時間が経過するのは移動中のみ」という特別ルールあり。お友達やご家族を徹底的にビビらせたい方は必見！プレイにはマイクが必須です！

en.name: DON'T SCREAM
en.description: If you scream, you restart. A jumpscare horror simulator where you walk through a pitch black forest and escape by reaching 8:00 AM.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
games.shortName: FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S: SECURITY BREACH
games.description: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breachでは、フレディ・ファズベアのメガ・ピザプレックスに閉じ込められた少年、グレゴリーとなりプレイしてください。フレディ・ファズベア本人の助けを借りながら、グレゴリーはピザプレックスの秘密を明らかにし、真実を追及しながら夜明けまで生き残らなければなりません。

trailers.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach Launch Trailer

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
en.description: In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach, play as Gregory, a young boy who’s been trapped overnight inside of Freddy Fazbear’s Mega Pizzaplex. With the help of Freddy himself, Gregory must uncover the secrets of the Pizzaplex, learn the truth, and survive until dawn.

games.name: Little Misfortune
games.description: ミスフォーチュンは新しい友達、ミスター・ヴォイスに導かれて、森へ旅立つ。その森で多くの謎を解いて、不幸な目に遭ってしまう。

en.name: Little Misfortune
en.description: Led by her new friend, Mr. Voice, Misfortune ventures into the woods, where mysteries are unraveled and a little bad luck unfolds.

games.name: Lunch Lady
games.description: Lunch Lady は、1～4人でプレイできるオンライン協力型サバイバルホラーゲームです。学校の期末試験が迫るなか、あなたと友達が思いついた最高のアイデアは「試験の答案を盗むこと」。答案10ページをすべて見つけ出し、殺人鬼の給食おばさん「ランチレディ」に捕まらないように逃げ切りましょう！

en.name: Lunch Lady
en.description: Lunch Lady is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror game. The school final exams are coming up and the best idea you and your friends had was to steal the test answers. Find all 10 pages and don't get caught by the murderous Lunch Lady!

games.name: Inside the Backrooms
games.description: Inside the Backrooms is a horror multiplayer game mixed with different mechanics that will make you spend an intense night with friends. Explore, think, interact, but be careful, it is rumored that there are several entities wishing to find you...

en.name: Inside the Backrooms
en.description: Inside the Backrooms is a horror multiplayer game mixed with different mechanics that will make you spend an intense night with friends. Explore, think, interact, but be careful, it is rumored that there are several entities wishing to find you...

games.name: biohazard 0 HD REMASTER
games.description: シリーズ累計販売本数6,500万本を超える『バイオハザード』シリーズ。 その出発点である「洋館事件」の始まりが描かれた作品「biohazard 0」をHDリマスター化。 秘められた恐怖と謎を、あなた自身で体験してもらいたい。 【イーライセンス利用許諾番号】ID34094

en.name: Resident Evil 0
en.description: Before the mansion, before the destruction of Raccoon City, there was Resident Evil 0. Now remastered with improved visuals and sounds, as well as the all-new Wesker Mode, there's never been a better time to experience the origins of the Resident Evil story.

games.name: Little Nightmares II -リトルナイトメア２-
games.shortName: LITTLE NIGHTMARES II -リトルナイトメア２-
games.description: 「Little Nightmares 2」は、サスペンスアドベンチャーゲームです。プレイヤーは主人公の少年「モノ」となって、怪電波によって歪められた世界をさまよい、新たな友『シックス』と共に電波の発信源を探すことになります。

en.name: Little Nightmares II
en.description: Little Nightmares II is the second game in a series that has thrilled and captivated millions of players worldwide since 2017. Now it’s your turn to try to survive this critically acclaimed entry in the most charming horror series ever made.

games.name: We Were Here Too
games.description: 最期の時が近づき、はるか遠く、激しい嵐の中にそびえる巨大な城。コミュニケーションを活用するcoopアドベンチャーで城に潜む闇の真実を暴き出そう。

trailers.name: We Were Here - Too  | Official Release Trailer
We Were Here - Too | Official Gameplay Trailer
We Were Here - Too | Official Trailer

en.name: We Were Here Too
en.description: As your final hour approaches, a large structure looms up in the distance, towering above the relentless storm. Discover the truth behind this dark castle in a communication-based, cooperative puzzle adventure.

games.name: Into the Radius VR
games.description: 『Into the Radius』は、VRで楽しめるシングルプレイヤーのサバイバル系シューティングゲームです。幻想的な光景と、危険なアノマリーに溢れた「ペチョースク」エリアを探索しよう。リアルに作られた銃で自分の身を守り、謎が溢れる遺物を回収し、戦利品を探し求めながら、過酷な暗黒世界の謎を解き明かそう。

en.name: Into the Radius VR
en.description: Into the Radius is a single-player survival shooter in VR. Explore the Pechorsk zone filled with surreal landscapes and dangerous anomalies. Defend yourself with realistic firearms, recover strange artifacts, scavenge for loot, and uncover the mysteries of this unforgiving dystopian environment.

games.name: Fears to Fathom® - Scratch Creek
games.description: 自分の体験と『Fears to Fathom』のあるエピソードの間にある背筋が凍るような類似点に気づいたテッサとマーカスは、自分たちのエピソードを共有することにした。『Scratch Creek』は、オンライン限定の協力プレイ専用タイトルだ。

en.name: Fears to Fathom® - Scratch Creek
en.description: After noticing bone-chilling similarities to an episode of Fears to Fathom, Tessa and Marcus decide to share their own experience. Scratch Creek is an exclusively online co-op experience.

games.name: 恐怖の世界
games.description: 怪異とのバトル、そして容赦のない選択肢が紡ぎ出す、地獄のようなローグライトRPG。本作は、伊藤潤二氏とH.P. Lovecraft氏へ捧げる1ビットのラブレターである。プレイするたび変化する悪夢のような出会いが、不可解な事件を解き明かすカギとなる。謎の先に待つものは…

en.name: WORLD OF HORROR
en.description: Experience the quiet terror of this 1-bit love letter to Junji Ito and H.P. Lovecraft. Navigate a hellish roguelite reality with turn-based combat and unforgiving choices. Experiment with your deck of event cards to discover new forms of cosmic horror in every playthrough. The inevitable awaits...

games.name: Emissary Zero
games.description: 協力型ホラー (1～4 人用)。夜に謎の建物を探索するよう命じられます。月を見つけて、生きて帰れるように努力しましょう。

en.name: Emissary Zero
en.description: Co-op horror (1-4 players). You are sent to explore a mysterious building at night. Find the Moon and try to return alive.

games.name: Alice: Madness Returns
games.description: アリスはワンダーランドと自分自身を救えるだろうか － その両方を侵食する狂気から。

en.name: Alice: Madness Returns
en.description: Alice: Madness Returns is a third-person, single-player, action adventure platformer. Visit the grim reality of Victorian London and travel to the beautiful yet ghastly Wonderland to uncover the root of Alice's madness.

games.name: うみねこのなく頃に
games.description: 【うみねこのなく頃に】本作品は日本語モード、英語モードを搭載したサウンドノベルです。物語の前編となるＥＰ１～４が収録されています。

en.name: Umineko When They Cry - Question Arcs
en.description: Umineko When They Cry is the 2nd series of Sound Novel released by 07th Expansion. The steam version features renewed character sprites which is swappable from the classic art.

games.name: ヨグ=ソトースの庭
genres: 恋愛シミュレーション
games.description: 「死神」「ドラゴン」「斬霊師」「人造メイド」——個性豊かでキュートなスタッフたちを雇って、負債を抱えたホテルを経営しよう！採掘や冒険・錬金術・レストラン経営etc……多彩な手段で富を築いて、目指すは借金返済！人外スタッフたちとの恋愛模様が魅力の、ホテル経営シム×恋愛ADV！

trailers.name: 公開日決定プロモーションJa

en.name: Yog-Sothoth’s Yard
en.description: Manage a hotel and hire employees including Death, a dragon, a Spirit Hunter, and a bioroid maid. Build your wealth through various means and refine your strategies based on the predictions of Oracles. All employees can be romanced depending on your choices.

games.name: Look Outside
games.description: これは、アパートの一室から始まるサバイバルホラーRPG。謎だらけの出来事によって、窓の外を見た者はグロテスクな化け物へと姿を変えられ、世界を本物の混沌へと陥れる。建物の中を調べ回って食糧、物資、武器を探し出せ。そして奇妙な者たちと出会うことになるだろう。

en.name: Look Outside
en.description: Look Outside is a survival horror RPG set in a single apartment building. A mysterious event turns anyone who looks out the window into grotesque monsters, leaving the world in absolute chaos. Scavenge the building to seek food, supplies, and weapons while encountering strange characters.

games.name: Kiosk
games.description: 『Kiosk』は、雨に濡れた居心地の良いキオスクで深夜に訪れるお客様の注文を調理・提供するホラークッキングゲームです。不気味な雰囲気と緊張感が高まる中、謎めいた訪問者たちに応対します。

en.name: Kiosk
en.description: Kiosk is a horror cooking game where you prepare orders for late-night customers who visit your cozy, rain-soaked kiosk. The eerie atmosphere clashes with the mounting tension as you serve your mysterious visitors.

games.name: Amnesia: The Dark Descent
games.description: Amnesia: The Dark Descent, a first person survival horror. A game about immersion, discovery and living through a nightmare. An experience that will chill you to the core.

en.name: Amnesia: The Dark Descent
en.description: Amnesia: The Dark Descent, a first person survival horror. A game about immersion, discovery and living through a nightmare. An experience that will chill you to the core.

games.name: The Evil Within
games.description: Developed by Shinji Mikami -- creator of the seminal Resident Evil series -- and the talented team at Tango Gameworks, The Evil Within embodies the meaning of pure survival horror. Highly-crafted environments, horrifying anxiety, and an intricate story are combined to create an immersive world that will bring you to the height of tension. With limited resources at your disposal, you’ll fight for survival and experience profound fear in this perfect blend of horror and action.

en.name: The Evil Within
en.description: Developed by Shinji Mikami -- creator of the seminal Resident Evil series -- and the talented team at Tango Gameworks, The Evil Within embodies the meaning of pure survival horror. Highly-crafted environments, horrifying anxiety, and an intricate story are combined to create an immersive world that will bring you to the height of tension. With limited resources at your disposal, you’ll fight for survival and experience profound fear in this perfect blend of horror and action.

games.name: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Man of Medan
games.shortName: THE DARK PICTURES ANTHOLOGY: MAN OF MEDA
games.description: THE DARK PICTURES ANTHOLOGYは、一連の独立作品から成る、ブランチング・シネマチック・ホラー・ゲームです。 MAN OF MEDAN（マン・オブ・メダン）：友人同士で休日のダイビング旅行へと繰り出した5人。しかし、ある日を境に彼らの旅行は、突如として不吉なものへと変わる。

en.name: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Man of Medan
en.description: The Dark Pictures Anthology is a series of stand-alone, branching cinematic horror games that can also be played online with a friend. In Man of Medan, five friends set sail on a holiday diving trip that soon changes into something much more sinister.

games.name: Murky Divers
games.description: ソロまたは最大8人のプレイヤー。放棄された水中研究所から、雇い主の失敗した実験の痕跡を消去しなければならない。潜水艦を操縦し、深淵の恐ろしいものを避けつつ、全ての死体を排除しよう。

en.name: Murky Divers
en.description: Solo or up to 8 players. Get rid of your employer's failed experiments in abandoned underwater labs. Navigate your submarine, avoid abyssal terrors, and remove all corpses.

games.name: ANIMAL WELL
games.description: 入り組んだ迷宮の中を探索し、多くの秘密を解き明かそう。アイテムを集めて、驚きかつ巧妙な手段で周囲の環境を上手く利用しよう。暗闇に潜むものたちより生き延びようとする中で、恐ろしくも美しい生き物たちと遭遇することになるだろう。ここには目に見えるもの以外の何かが存在する。

en.name: ANIMAL WELL
en.description: Explore a dense, interconnected labyrinth, and unravel its many secrets. Collect items to manipulate your environment in surprising and meaningful ways. Encounter beautiful and unsettling creatures, as you attempt to survive what lurks in the dark. There is more than what you see.

games.name: Welcome to Elderfield
genres: 農場シミュレーション
games.description: 「Welcome to Elderfield」は、手描きのアートとダークなLo-Fi音楽でまったりくつろげるホラーRPG。農場を管理したり、近所のみんなと交流したり恋愛したり、ミステリーを調査したり、家を飾ったり、怖いバケモノと戦ったり、釣りをしたり、料理したり、旧神を探したり、眠りながら死んじゃったり、などなど…エルダーフィールドはできることが盛りだくさん！

en.name: Welcome to Elderfield
en.description: Welcome to Elderfield, a cozy horror RPG with hand-drawn art and dark lofi music. Manage your farm, befriend or romance the locals, investigate mysteries, decorate your home, fight terrifying creatures, fish, cook, seek the Old Gods, die in your sleep, and more... There's lots to do in Elderfield!

games.name: Baldi's Basics Plus
games.description: Baldi's Basics® Plus is an active stealth roguelike that parodies cheap '90s edutainment with a subtle horror twist! Play Hide & Seek with Baldi as he chases you through procedurally generated levels while using your surroundings, items, and game knowledge to shift chaos in your favor.

en.name: Baldi's Basics Plus
en.description: Baldi's Basics® Plus is an active stealth roguelike that parodies cheap '90s edutainment with a subtle horror twist! Play Hide & Seek with Baldi as he chases you through procedurally generated levels while using your surroundings, items, and game knowledge to shift chaos in your favor.

games.name: Carnival Hunt
games.description: Carnival Huntは、5対1の一人称視点非対称ホラーゲーム。5体のぜんまい仕掛けのウサギは、音を立てる鍵を管理し、姿を変えるカーニバルから協力して脱出しなければならない。もう1人のプレイヤーはカーニバル・モンスターとなり、彼らを狩る。

en.name: Carnival Hunt
en.description: Carnival Hunt is a 5v1 first-person asymmetrical horror game. Five wind-up Bunnies must work together, manage their noisy keys, and find a way to escape an ever-changing carnival world while one player hunts them as the Carnival Monster.

games.name: 殺戮の天使
games.description: 「お願い、私を殺して」「一緒にここから出る手助けをしてくれよ。そしたらお前を、殺してやるよ」 『殺戮の天使』はエピソード1からエピソード4の4部構成からなるサイコホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。

en.name: Angels of Death
en.description: "Please... kill me." "Help me get outta here, and I'll kill you." ~ Angels of Death is a psychological horror-adventure game, consisting of four episodes.

games.name: Outlast 2
games.description: Outlast 2 introduces you to Sullivan Knoth and his followers, who left our wicked world behind to give birth to Temple Gate, a town, deep in the wilderness and hidden from civilization. Knoth and his flock are preparing for the tribulations of the end of times and you’re right in the thick of it.

en.name: Outlast 2
en.description: Outlast 2 introduces you to Sullivan Knoth and his followers, who left our wicked world behind to give birth to Temple Gate, a town, deep in the wilderness and hidden from civilization. Knoth and his flock are preparing for the tribulations of the end of times and you’re right in the thick of it.

games.name: Granny
games.description: You have to escape Granny`s house...You have five days...

en.name: Granny
en.description: You have to escape Granny`s house...You have five days...

games.name: Sally Face - Episode One
games.description: 義顔の少年が主人公の、不穏な冒険譚。不可解な連続殺人事件をきっかけに、サールと3人の友人たちは町全体を覆う邪悪な存在に気づいてしまう。

trailers.name: Sally Face, Episode One: Strange Neighbors - Trailer

en.name: Sally Face - Episode One
en.description: An unsettling adventure following a boy with a prosthetic face. After a string of mysterious murders, Sal and his three friends discover something truly sinister casting shadows over their small town.

games.name: Horripilant
games.description: 己の神を討ち、己の力を示せ。Horripilantは忘れ去られた地下世界の恐怖を次第に体験していくダンジョンRPGです。放置ゲーム、パズル、オートバトルの要素を組み合わせ、廃ダンジョンの深部を進むために、戦い、採掘し、謎を解いていきます。

en.name: Horripilant
en.description: KILL YOUR GOD. BECOME WORTHY. Horripilant is a chilling idle incremental dungeon crawl through the horrors of a forgotten underworld.

games.name: Amanda the Adventurer
games.description: アマンダと友達のウーリーと一緒に一連の冒険に飛び込み、私たちの住む素晴らしい世界を探索し、理解しましょう！共に遊び、共に笑い、共に学ぶことができる新たなエピソードによって、常に楽しい要素が提供されます！ただし、アマンダが言うことは何でもしてあげましょう。さもないと、怒らせることになるかもしれません。

en.name: Amanda the Adventurer
en.description: Join Amanda and her pal Wooly on a series of adventures as they explore and learn about our wonderful world! With several NEW play-along, laugh-along, learn-along episodes there's always fun to be had! Just make sure to do everything Amanda says or she might get angry.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 3
games.description: Thirty years after Freddy Fazbear's Pizza closed it's doors, the events that took place there have become nothing more than a rumor and a childhood memory, but the owners of "Fazbear's Fright: The Horror Attraction" are determined to revive the legend and make the experience as authentic as possible for patrons, going to great lengths to find anything that might have survived decades of neglect and ruin. At first there were only empty shells, a hand, a hook, an old paper-plate doll, but then a remarkable discovery was made... The attraction now has one animatronic.

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 3
en.description: Thirty years after Freddy Fazbear's Pizza closed it's doors, the events that took place there have become nothing more than a rumor and a childhood memory, but the owners of "Fazbear's Fright: The Horror Attraction" are determined to revive the legend and make the experience as authentic as possible for patrons, going to great lengths to find anything that might have survived decades of neglect and ruin. At first there were only empty shells, a hand, a hook, an old paper-plate doll, but then a remarkable discovery was made... The attraction now has one animatronic.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
games.description: Welcome back to the new and improved Freddy Fazbear's Pizza! As always, Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for death or dismemberment.

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
en.description: Welcome back to the new and improved Freddy Fazbear's Pizza! As always, Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for death or dismemberment.

games.name: 魔女の家MV
games.description: 少女ヴィオラは、森の中にたたずむ謎めいた館へと容赦なく引き寄せられている。そこは痛みと混乱、そして死の場所である。その憎むべき闇と忌まわしい過去を調べよ。君の行く手を阻む謎を解け。そして魔女の家の地獄のような空間から逃げ出そう。

en.name: The Witch's House MV
en.description: A young girl, Viola, is drawn inexorably to a mysterious manor that seems to change behind her back. It is a place of pain, turmoil and death. Plumb its detestable depths and abominable history. Untangle riddles that bar your perilous path. And flee the hellish halls of The Witch’s House.

games.name: Rusty Lake: Roots
games.description: 登場するキャラクターたちの生と死を経験して、独自の家系図を作ろう！ Rusty Lake: RootsはCube Escapeシリーズのクリエイターたちによるポイントクリック型の謎解きアドベンチャーゲームであるRusty Lake Hotelの続編です。

en.name: Rusty Lake: Roots
en.description: Experience the beginning and end of characters' lives and build your own family tree! Rusty Lake: Roots is the second premium point-and-click adventure by the creators of the Cube Escape series and Rusty Lake Hotel.

games.name: That's not my Neighbor
games.description: 1955年、何らかの理由でドッペルゲンガーが通常より多く見られるようになっています。そのため、ドッペルゲンガー検出局（D.D.D.）が対策を講じました。 あなたはアパートの管理人で、自分の隣人だと主張する人を通すかどうかを判断する必要があります。

en.name: That's not my Neighbor
en.description: It's 1955, and for unknown reasons, doppelgangers are more common than usual. Therefore, the Department of Doppelganger Detection (D.D.D.) has taken action. You are the doorman of an apartment complex, and you must decide whether to let in those who claim to be your neighbors.

games.name: Garten of Banban 2
games.description: Continue the story of Banban’s Kindergarten. Delve deeper into the bizarre establishment where the place was left suspiciously empty. Try to survive the unexpected residents, all while uncovering the truth behind the place…

en.name: Garten of Banban 2
en.description: Continue the story of Banban’s Kindergarten. Delve deeper into the bizarre establishment where the place was left suspiciously empty. Try to survive the unexpected residents, all while uncovering the truth behind the place…

games.name: Eclipsium
games.description: 光を求め、太陽なき世界は自らを喰らいはじめる。彼女の痕跡を求め、進むたび足元の風景は姿を変えていく。

trailers.name: Eclipsium - The Dark Tar Update Trailer

en.name: Eclipsium
en.description: Longing for light, a sunless world begins devouring itself. Every step shifts the landscape beneath you as you search for what remains of her.

games.name: Detention
games.description: 1960年代の台湾、架空世界の学校を舞台にしたホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。台湾ならではの文化を表現したいため、キャラクターやシーンも台湾人に親しみのある要素を採用しており、一膳飯、廟宇、神壇など、当時の宗教や風習をゲームに組み込んでいます。

en.name: Detention
en.description: Detention is an atmospheric horror game set in 1960s Taiwan under martial law. Incorporated religious elements based in Taiwanese/Chinese culture and mythology, the game provided players with unique graphics and gaming experience.

games.name: 女吊
games.description: Scarlet Idol is a 3D Chinese folk horror puzzle game featuring a co-op two-player mode. The game integrates various folk cultural elements, including the funeral rituals of the Wu-Yue region, Ghost operas, Mulian operas, the duomin (outcast communities)

en.name: Scarlet Idol
en.description: Scarlet Idol is a 3D Chinese folk horror puzzle game featuring a co-op two-player mode. The game integrates various folk cultural elements, including the funeral rituals of the Wu-Yue region, Ghost operas, Mulian operas, the duomin (outcast communities)

games.name: Saiko no sutoka
games.description: Saiko No Sutokaは主人公として、あなたの死を望んでいる狂ったヤンデレの女の子から逃げるホラーサバイバルゲームです。

en.name: Saiko no sutoka
en.description: Saiko No Sutoka is a Horror Survival Game where you as a Protagonist must escape and avoid the crazy yandere girl who wants you dead.

games.name: Mad Father (マッドファーザー)
games.shortName: MAD FATHER (マッドファーザー)
games.description: あなたが見届けるのは、愚かな家族の物語。 名作と名高い探索型ホラーゲームのリメイク版が登場。

en.name: Mad Father
en.description: Witness the tale of a most foolish family. A remake of the classic horror exploration game makes its way to Steam.

games.name: Rusty Lake Paradise
games.description: Rusty Lake Paradiseの舞台はエジプトの十の災いによって呪われた小さな離島です。暗く不気味なパズルアドベンチャーに挑戦し全ての謎を解き明かしましょう。Paradiseは独特の雰囲気とワクワク感を持つRusty Lakeシリーズの作品です。

en.name: Rusty Lake Paradise
en.description: Rusty Lake Paradise is set on a small remote island which is cursed by the ten plagues of Egypt. Solve all the mysteries of this dark, macabre puzzle adventure. Paradise builds upon the distinctive atmosphere and excitement from the Rusty Lake series.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
games.description: In this last chapter of the Five Nights at Freddy's original story, you must once again defend yourself against Freddy Fazbear, Chica, Bonnie, Foxy, and even worse things that lurk in the shadows.

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
en.description: In this last chapter of the Five Nights at Freddy's original story, you must once again defend yourself against Freddy Fazbear, Chica, Bonnie, Foxy, and even worse things that lurk in the shadows.

games.name: KinitoPET
games.description: KinitoPET is a psychological horror experience that takes place through Kinito, an early 2000s virtual assistant. Kinito is able to walk, talk, browse, adapt, and play games as Kinito is like no other with its adaptive technology!

en.name: KinitoPET
en.description: KinitoPET is a psychological horror experience that takes place through Kinito, an early 2000s virtual assistant. Kinito is able to walk, talk, browse, adapt, and play games as Kinito is like no other with its adaptive technology!

games.name: Garten of Banban 3
games.description: バンバンの幼稚園の恐怖を受け入れます。疑わしいほど空のままにされた施設の深さをさらに深く掘り下げます。予想外の住民を生き残るために、あなたの子供のための検索を継続してみてください…

en.name: Garten of Banban 3
en.description: Embrace the horrors of Banban’s Kindergarten. Delve even deeper into the depths of the establishment that was left suspiciously empty. Try to survive the unexpected residents and continue the search for your child…

games.name: Rusty Lake Hotel
games.description: 『Rusty Lake Hotel』はラスティレイクとキューブエスケープシリーズのクリエイターによる、不可思議なポイント＆クリックアドベンチャーです。

trailers.name: Rusty Lake Hotel 6 Year Anniversary Trailer

en.name: Rusty Lake Hotel
en.description: Are you ready to serve the guests in the Rusty Lake Hotel? Solve all mysteries in this dark and eerie puzzle game. Rusty Lake Hotel is a point-and-click adventure by the creators of the Rusty Lake & Cube Escape series.

games.name: Ravenous Devils
games.description: 犯罪を隠し味にした、ホラークッキングシミュレーター。お店を改善して、新しい道具を買って、メニューを増やして、何よりも、お客さんに喜んでもらいましょう。

trailers.name: Ravenous Devils Trailer - Horror Cooking Simulator

en.name: Ravenous Devils
en.description: A horror cooking simulator where the secret ingredient is crime. Improve your shops, buy new tools, expand your menu, and above all, make your customers happy.

games.name: Cube Escape Collection
games.description: この独特なポイント＆クリック式アドベンチャーゲームのコレクションでは、デールやローラをはじめ、ミスター・クロウ、ミスター・アウルなどラスティレイクで人気のキャラクターの足跡をたどります。Flashゲームの終わりに備え、アップデートされたゲームを一つにまとめた新装版が新たに登場。

en.name: Cube Escape Collection
en.description: In this classic point-and-click adventure anthology you follow the path of Dale and Laura and other famous Rusty lake characters such as Mr. Crow and Mr. Owl. The series will be updated, preserved and bundled to survive the end of the Flash Games era.

games.name: Idols of Ash
games.description: Grapple, clamber and fall thousands of meters down into a dark and ancient place in this first-person horror climbing game. You are being hunted.

en.name: Idols of Ash
en.description: Grapple, clamber and fall thousands of meters down into a dark and ancient place in this first-person horror climbing game. You are being hunted.

games.name: The Cabin Factory
games.description: Cabin Factoryでの仕事はいたってシンプル：キャビンが霊に憑りつかれていないか検査すること。もし何らかの異変を発見したら…即刻退避せよ。

en.name: The Cabin Factory
en.description: Your job at the Cabin Factory is simple: inspect the cabins and decide on whether they’re haunted or not. If you do find any anomalies, get out…immediately.

games.name: Blood and Bacon
games.description: このマルチプレイCO -OP 」最初の人のシューティングゲームは「昼と夜のレベルは、プレイヤーはあなたが探検のように、 10日ごとに巨大なモンスターとMinibossesのように、 35敵の種類と多数のボスを取る撃つとブタの猛攻撃に対してあなたの人生のために実行されてい怪物。

en.name: Blood and Bacon
en.description: This Co-op Shooter , has Day and Night levels, multiple maps, players will take on 25 enemy types and numerous bosses, like Gargantuan Monsters and Minibosses every 10 days as you explore, shoot and run for your life against the onslaught of porcine monstrosities.

games.name: CONSCRIPT: Director’s Cut
games.description: 時は第一次世界大戦。一人のフランス兵が曲がりくねった塹壕を突き進み、限られた物資をかき集め、複雑なパズルを解きながら、人類史上最も残虐で恐ろしい戦闘からの生還をかけて戦う。『CONSCRIPT』は昔ながらのサバイバルホラーを新たに解釈したゲームだ。

en.name: CONSCRIPT: Director’s Cut
en.description: During the First World War, a lone French soldier must navigate twisted trenches, scavenge for limited supplies and solve complex puzzles—all whilst fighting for survival in the midst of mankind’s most brutal and horrifying conflict. CONSCRIPT is a new historical take on classic survival horror.

games.name: 怪異道  カイイミチ
games.shortName: 怪異道 カイイミチ
games.description: ドット絵の帰り道で、女子高生二人組が怪異に遭遇するノベルアドベンチャー。

en.name: On The Way Home : Strange Incidents
en.description: A novel adventure where two high school girls encounter the supernatural on their pixelated way home.

games.name: 呪ショッピング
games.description: 主人公が大手通販サイト『NOROIショッピング』で買い物を楽しんでいると、段々と奇妙な商品たちが並び始める。その商品のことを調べていくと、とある事件の全貌が見えてくる…

en.name: 呪ショッピング
en.description: You are shopping on a major online store when strange listings gradually begin to appear. The more you look into them, the more clearly the whole picture of a crime comes into view…

games.name: Cardsharp
games.description: 暗い部屋で遊ぶブラックジャック。ソロでも、最大4人のオンラインプレイでも。勝てば報酬、負ければディーラーに指を一本切り落とされる。他のプレイヤーから奪い、取っておいたカードを燃やし、呪われたアイテムを押し付けよう。

en.name: Cardsharp
en.description: Blackjack in a dark room. Solo or with friends. Win the hand and you get paid; lose it and the dealer takes a finger. Rob the other players, burn the card they were saving, push cursed items on them.

games.name: ■■になってくれませんか？
games.description: 誰でも日常で経験あるうかつな返事。うかつな返事をした代償を描いた恐怖。 全5つのEND短編周回型ジャパニーズホラー・ウォーキングシミュレーターゲーム。

en.name: ■■になってくれませんか？

games.name: Gateholt
games.description: Gateholtは1〜4人でプレイする協力ホラーゲームです。呪われた場所に入り、悪霊が残した痕跡を消してください。痕跡を消すほど、それは近づいてきます。立ち向かうことはできません。逃げるか、隠れてください。戻る道はまだ開いています。

en.name: Gateholt
en.description: Gateholt is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Enter a cursed place and erase the marks an evil spirit has left behind. Every mark you erase brings it closer. You cannot fight it — run, or hide. The way back is still open.

games.name: 60病　The 60-Second Syndrome
games.description: あなたは60秒後に死ぬ。 本作は、わずか60秒のタイムループに閉じ込められた男が密室から脱出するシングルプレーのホラー脱出ゲームです。 閉ざされた部屋で、死ぬたびに時はリセットされる。繰り返される現象を観察し、変化を記憶し、ループから抜け出せ。

en.name: 60病　The 60-Second Syndrome
en.description: You will die in 60 seconds. This is a single-player horror escape game in which a man trapped within a 60-second time loop must escape from a sealed room. Inside the locked room, time resets every time you die. Observe repeating phenomena, remember the changes, and break free from the loop.

games.name: 不安ごと
games.description: インターネット上で怪談や怖い話を読み漁ることを日課にするあなた。いつもの日課の後、何か異様な気配を感じた気が...？

en.name: 不安ごと - Anxieties -
en.description: Every day, you trawl the internet for ghost stories and horror tales. After the usual routine, something feels off...?

games.name: ひぐらしのなく頃に奉 罪滅し編
games.shortName: ひぐらしのなく頃に奉 罪滅し編

en.name: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Ch.6 Tsumihoroboshi
en.description: Higurashi When They Cry is a sound novel. The music, backgrounds and characters work together to create a world that is the stage of a novel for the user to read. They laugh and cry and get angry. The user takes the point of view of the protagonist to experience the story.

games.name: Ib

trailers.name: Ib 発売日発表トレーラー（日本語）

en.name: Ib
en.description: A 2D exploration adventure game set in a creepy, mysterious art gallery.

games.name: クソデカ囃子(ばやし) | Kusodeka Bayashi
games.shortName: クソデカ囃子(ばやし) | KUSODEKA BAYASHI
games.description: 「クソデカ囃子(ばやし) | Kusodeka Bayashi」は、一人称視点のホラーコメディゲームです。主人公であるボクは、特殊な力を秘めたMP3プレーヤーを使いこなし、恐怖の中を駆け抜ける。果たして、ボクは一族の呪いに打ち勝つことができるのだろうか…？

en.name: This Curse Is Metal as Hell! | Kusodeka Bayashi
en.description: This Curse Is Metal as Hell! is a first-person horror comedy game. Do you have what it takes to defeat the curse that plagued your family for generations?

games.name: HR: Human Remains
games.description: たとえ魔物の支配された世界でも、社会の歯車はひたすら回り続ける。崩壊した世界を生きるごく普通の会社員として、日々の仕事をこなし、パズルを解き、この歪んだ社会の真実を紐解いていこう。

en.name: HR: Human Remains
en.description: In a broken world ruled by demons, the gears of productivity still turn. Complete tasks, solve puzzles, and explore a society under demonic regime from the perspective of an ordinary office clerk.

games.name: デスバーガー
games.description: 街で人気のハンバーガーショップにウキウキでやってきた男。しかしそこは悪の皇帝「パティパティーン」が支配する恐怖の施設だった！暴れまわる人食いハンバーガーたち...光り輝くポテト、「ポテトセイバー」で戦うのだ！

en.name: DEATH BURGER
en.description: A cheerful man excitedly arrives at a popular burger shop in town. However, it turns out to be a terrifying facility controlled by the evil Emperor "Pattypatine"! Ravenous, rampaging burgers are everywhere... Fight back with the shining fries, the "Potato Saber"!

games.name: ひぐらしのなく頃に奉 綿流し編

games.name: Playrooms
games.description: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.

en.name: Playrooms

games.name: アクアリウムは踊らない Special Edition
games.shortName: アクアリウムは踊らない SPECIAL EDITION
games.description: 親友思いの少女が、恐怖の世界と化した水族館で友人を探すホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。クリーピーと呼ばれる異形の存在から逃れながら、水族館に隠された謎を解き明かしていきましょう。ホラー要素は弱めで、歯ごたえのある謎解きを楽しむことができます。主人公のほか、個性的で魅力的な少女たちが登場します。物語はマルチエンドで、あなたの選択によって結末が変化します。

en.name: The Aquarium does not dance Special Edition
en.description: Navigate your way through an aquarium overrun by gruesome creatures known as creepies and unravel its hidden mysteries. With each riddle you solve, you’ll find yourself one step closer to uncovering the chilling truth of Bianca Aquarium. Your choices affect the outcome of the game, so choose wisely.

games.name: 文字化化：Homicipher
games.description: 『文字化化（Homicipher）』は、ホラー男子との恋愛と言語解読を組み合わせた女性向けADVです。異界に迷い込んだ主人公が、不思議な言語を話す人外たちと交流しながら脱出を目指す探索型ホラーゲーム。開発元は八名木Games

en.name: Homicipher
en.description: Homicipher is a language deciphering and exploration ADV based on the concept of "romance with horror men." The protagonist, who has wandered into another world, interacts with non-human beings to decipher their language while striving to escape.

games.name: PIEN-ぴえん- & PAON-ぱおん- plus
