en.description: Walking through the forest, Reimu meets a stranger in the forest, now she needs to understand where he came from, and how he got through the barrier.

floor2.name: planetarian～雪圏球～
floor2.description: Keyが手がけた本格的SFキネティックノベル『planetarian～ちいさなほしのゆめ～』の前日譚『planetarian～雪圏球～』が、バイノーラル音楽にも対応して登場！ 遠くない未来、プラネタリウム館に配属されて来たコンパニオンロボットと職員たちとの、なにげない幸せの物語。

en.name: planetarian: Snow Globe
en.description: "planetarian: Snow Globe," the prequel to Key's sci-fi kinetic novel "planetarian: The Reverie of a Little Planet," is now available with binaural audio support! Enjoy the story of a companion robot and her coworkers at a planetarium, and the simple joys they find in their everyday lives.

floor2.name: JUSTICE SUCKS: Tactical Vacuum Action
floor2.description: JUSTICE SUCKSは、90年代のテレビの世界を舞台に、殺人ロボット掃除機が復讐のために活躍するステルス/アクションゲームです。獲物を追跡し、スマートデバイスをハッキングして致命的なトラップに変え、敵の血を摂取して壊滅的な力を解き放ちましょう。

en.name: JUSTICE SUCKS: Tactical Vacuum Action
en.description: JUSTICE SUCKS is a stealth/action game about a killer robot vacuum cleaner on a quest for vengeance through a 90s TV universe. Stalk your prey, hack smart devices, turn them into deadly traps and consume the blood of your enemies to unleash devastating powers.

floor2.name: 簡単なゴミ捨てゲーム
floor2.shortName: 簡単なゴミ捨てゲーム
genres: 没入シミュレーション
floor2.description: 私たちは世界中から試験員を大量に募集し、これまでにない秘密の試験に参加しています。私たちに参加して、この存亡にかかわる探索の旅に出て、あなたの選択は、地球の運命を決定します。この未知の実験の中で、あなたは、変化の力です！

trailers.name: A Simple Garbage Sorting Game Trailer

en.name: A Simple Garbage Sorting Game
en.description: We are recruiting a large number of testers from around the world to participate in an unprecedented secret experiment.. Join us and embark on this journey of exploration that is crucial to survival. In this unknown experiment, your choices will determine the fate of the Earth.

floor2.name: 怪異番号~20××~
genres: 選択方式アドベンチャー
floor2.description: ガラケーが当たり前だった時代、公園の公衆トイレには どこに繋がるかわからない電話番号がたくさんありました——。 本作はジャンプスケア(大きな音やグロテスクな画像での突然の驚かし)要素の無い 安心してプレイいただけるホラーテキストアドベンチャーです。

en.name: 怪異番号~20✕✕(ニーマルバツバツ)~
en.description: A mysterious phone number on a park restroom wall leads to an unknown “voice,” quietly awakening the town’s hidden apparitions. This is a horror text adventure with no jump scares—no loud noises or grotesque surprises—designed for a safe and tension-focused experience.

floor2.name: Bloxpath
floor2.description: 極簡解謎ゲーム「Bloxpath」は、転がるブロックをゴールに導くことを目的としています。約10種類のユニークな解謎メカニズムと約200のパズルがあり、満足感を与える滑らかなプログラムアニメーションが特徴です。

en.name: Bloxpath
en.description: A minimalist roll playing puzzle game. About 10 unique puzzle mechanics, around 200 puzzles, and satisfying smooth procedural animations.

floor2.name: Age of Borders: WW3
floor2.description: 世界が第三次世界大戦の瀬戸際へと向かう中、現実世界のマップ上で200以上の国からひとつを選び、指揮を執ろう。世界各地の9つの火種がエスカレートしていくなか、産業、外交、軍をリアルタイムで動かせ。結末が平和か、超大国同士の戦争か、核による破滅かは、あなたの選択で決まる。

en.name: Age of Borders: WW3
en.description: Take command of any of over 200 nations on a real-world map as the world edges toward World War III. Manage industry, diplomacy and armies in real time while nine global flashpoints escalate. Your choices determine whether it ends in peace, a superpower war or nuclear ruin.

floor2.name: 隙マ
floor2.description: 部屋の中のどこかの隙間が、ひとりでに少しずつ開いていく。 隙間が完全に開くまでに、見つけて閉じることができなければ—。隙間に恐怖する一人称視点脱出ゲーム。

en.name: SUKIMA: The Creeping Gap
en.description: Somewhere in the room, a gap slowly opens on its own. If you fail to find and close it before it fully opens— A first-person escape horror game about the fear of gaps.

floor2.name: Pogo Together
genres: 精密プラットフォーム
floor2.description: 一緒に跳んで、落ちて、キレて、登ろう。『Pogo Together』は、ムキムキすぎる動物たちがポゴスティックで過酷な障害物へ挑む、1～4人用の物理演算ベース精密プラットフォーマー。助け合うもよし、蹴り落とすもよし。もちろん一人でも遊べます。

en.name: Pogo Together
en.description: Bounce, fall, rage, and climb together. Pogo Together is a 1-4 player physics-based precision platformer where ridiculously jacked animals attempt to conquer brutal obstacles on pogo sticks. Help each other, kick each other off, or take on the climb alone.

floor2.name: クレーのウサギのぬいぐるみ
floor2.shortName: クレーのウサギのぬいぐるみ
floor2.description: 素晴らしい夜の下で目を覚ました猫耳少女ニャルは、パートナーがいないことに気づく。彼女を待ち受けているものはいったい何なのだろうか？

en.name: Nyakori's Rabbit Doll
en.description: Waking up in the beautiful night, maiden with cat’s ears whose name is Nyarutoru finds her friends nowhere. What are they waiting her ahead?

floor2.name: HER TREES : THE PUZZLE HOUSE
floor2.description: ハーツリーズ：ザ・パズルハウスは、 物を動かし組み合わせてパズルを解く、 独創的なポイント＆クリック・パズルゲームです。 この奇妙な部屋の謎を解き明かそう。

en.name: HER TREES : THE PUZZLE HOUSE
en.description: HER TREES : THE PUZZLE HOUSE is a unique point-and-click puzzle game where you move and combine objects to solve puzzles. Uncover the mysteries of this peculiar room.

floor2.name: ほりほりドリル
floor2.description: 『ほりほりドリル』はひとりで黙々と遊べる地面採掘、鉱石収集ゲーム。 敵もタイムリミットもない世界でのんびり地下を掘り進めよう！集めた資源を使ってオリジナルのドリルをつくろう！ コツコツ作業とハクスラ風装備システムで、時間を溶かす準備はできていますか？

en.name: DigDigDrill
en.description: DigDigDrill is an underground mining and resource collecting game. Dig freely for minerals and treasures. Use the items you collect to forge your original drills in a hack-and-slash style equipment system.

floor2.name: 焼肉シミュレーター
genres: 人生シミュレーション
floor2.description: 【ゲーム紹介】 お腹が空いた？焼肉食べたい？でもカロリーが気になる？ そんな時には「焼肉シミュレーター」！牛タン、ハラミ、上カルビ、カルビがアナタを待っています！ 「焼肉シミュレーター」ならいくら焼いてもカロリーゼロ！思う存分焼いちゃいましょう！ ※ライス、ビールは必要に応じて各々ご用意ください。

en.name: Yakiniku simulator
en.description: Simple and easy game! Just chill out and simulate eating yakiniku!

floor2.name: HOLE
floor2.description: カジュアル＆ハードなFPS。 ジャムに注意。

en.name: HOLE
en.description: Casual & Hard FPS. Be careful with jam.

floor2.name: たこパ サバイバル
floor2.shortName: たこパ サバイバル
floor2.description: タンパク質、炭水化物、脂質をバランスよく摂取して生き延びてください。 たこ焼きに入れる具材によって栄養バランスが変化します。 カロリーがオーバーするとお腹いっぱいで食べられなくなりますので、スクワットでカロリーを消費してください。

en.name: Takoyaki Party Survival
en.description: You should consume a good balance of protein, carbohydrates, and fats to survive. The nutritional balance changes depending on the ingredients you put in your takoyaki. If you are overloaded with calories, you will be too full to eat, so please consume calories by squatting.

floor2.name: life is not auto
genres: クイックタイムイベント
floor2.description: "LIFE IS NOT AUTO"はリズム＋サバイバル基盤の計時ゲームです。 皆さんは手動で器官をコントロールして、キャラクターの生命を一生維持することができ

en.name: life is not auto
en.description: "LIFE IS NOT AUTO"is a rhythm + survival based timing game. You manually control the organs to keep your character alive until life ends.

floor2.name: ChopChop
floor2.description: 斧を手にして、何も考えずに木を切ってみてください。

en.name: ChopChop
en.description: Pick up your axe and chop wood without thinking.

floor2.name: DEBRISVERSE
floor2.description: その借金は、罠だ。これはただのインクリメンタルゲームではない。非正規ツール、闇市場、ハッキングを駆使してB.R.I.S.社の秘密を暴く『謎解きインクリメンタル』だ。全7種の結末から、ディストピアを支配する巨大企業の真相に迫れ。

en.name: DEBRISVERSE
en.description: That debt is a trap. This is no ordinary incremental game. Use unauthorized tools, the black market, and hacking to uncover B.R.I.S. Corp’s secrets in a mystery incremental. Uncover the truth behind the megacorporation controlling this dystopia across 7 distinct endings.

floor2.name: My Little Someone
genres: デスクトップコンパニオン
floor2.description: あなたのもとに不思議な贈り物が届きました。開けてみると、そこにはお世話が必要な可愛いペットの姿が。ご飯をあげたり、撫でたり、お世話をしたりして、あなたのペットを大切に育てましょう。『My Little Someone』で新しい生活が始まります。

en.name: My Little Someone
en.description: An unusual gift has arrived for you. Upon opening it, you discover an adorable pet that is now yours to care for. Keep your new companion happy and healthy by feeding, petting, and nurturing them in My Little Someone.

floor2.name: Pizza Possum
floor2.description: 念願のネズミの夢が叶えられる…のかも？おまわりさんから逃げ回りながら、食べ物を食べられるだけ食べつくそう。協力プレイでも一人でも大丈夫。短い時間で楽しめる、ドタバタ騒ぎのアーケードゲーム。

en.name: Pizza Possum
en.description: Live your ultimate possum dreams in a snackable, chaotic arcade game focused on eating as much food as you can in single-player or local co-op - without getting caught.

floor2.name: Human-powered spacecraft
floor2.description: ユーモアあふれるノスタルジックなピクセルクリッカー

en.name: Human-powered spacecraft
en.description: A nostalgia-infused pixel clicker in a comedy wrapper.

floor2.name: DEFRAG
floor2.description: DEFRAGは、汚染されたセクターを浄化し、最適化を通じてより強力なビルドを完成させていくゲームです。 資源を集め、設定を調整し、進行に合わせてシステムを仕上げてください。

en.name: DEFRAG
en.description: DEFRAG is a game about cleansing corrupted sectors and refining them through optimization to build a stronger system. Collect resources, adjust configurations, and complete your build as you progress.

floor2.name: トルービズの秘薬師
floor2.description: 言語解読ゲームはなんぼあってもいいですよね。薬師として、架空の言語で書かれたマニュアルを読み解き、ポーションを調合して患者に処方していく短編パズルゲームです。“読めるようになる”快感と、治療の結果で変化する小さなドラマが楽しめる、手軽な言語解読体験を提供します。

en.name: The Apothecary of Trubiz
en.description: A short puzzle game where you decipher a fictional language, mix potions, and treat patients. Enjoy the thrill of understanding and the small stories that unfold from each cure.

floor2.name: リズムウィッチ ビートオブデス
floor2.shortName: リズムウィッチ ビートオブデス
floor2.description: リズムゲー × サバイバー系ローグライクの超爽快アクション！ ビートを刻んで、敵をなぎ倒せ！美貌を追い求める死霊使い「シベル」となり、ノリノリな音楽に合わせてスケルトン軍団を指揮しよう。弾幕地獄の中でリズムを刻み、群がるモンスターを華麗に一掃せよ！

trailers.name: Rhythm Witch:Beat Death Release Trailer JP

en.name: Rhythm Witch: Beat Death
en.description: Rhythm Witch: Beat Death is a game that melds rhythm and survival. Attack to the rhythm of the music while dodging monsters who move and attack to the beat. On your journey to eternal beauty, defeat dancing freaks, ghouls, dragon, and more!

floor2.name: 心霊物件
genres: インタラクティブフィクション
没入シミュレーション
floor2.description: 格安アパートで始まる新生活。 夜中の奇妙な現象と隣人の不審な行動が主人公を追い詰めていく。

en.name: Haunted Property
en.description: A new life begins in a low-cost apartment. Strange occurrences at night and the suspicious behavior of neighbors gradually push the protagonist to the edge.

floor2.name: 闇鍋人狼
genres: ソーシャルディダクション
floor2.description: 闇鍋人狼は皆で鍋を作る正体隠匿ゲームです。仲間同士で相談してダンジョンで食材を集め、おいしい鍋を作ります。ただし、中には裏切り者が紛れていて鍋を作るのを邪魔してくるかも……。お互いの正体を隠しながら理想の鍋を作ろう！

en.name: Hodgepodge Hunch
en.description: Hodgepodge Hunch is a who-done-it game where everyone chips in to make a hotpot dish. Collaborate with your buddies to collect ingredients in the dungeons and whip up a delicious feast. There's just one problem... A backstabber may be lurking among you who'll throw your dinner plans awry...

floor2.name: かぞえ飯
floor2.description: 白いご飯を食べているとき、お茶碗に何粒のお米が入っているか気になったことはありませんか？ このゲームは、お茶碗に入ったお米を数えるだけの、非常にシンプルなゲームです。 いったいどれだけのご飯粒が入っているのか、気になって眠れなかった日々とはおさらばです。

en.name: かぞえ飯
en.description: Have you ever wondered how many grains of rice are in your bowl when you are eating white rice? This game is a very simple game in which all you have to do is count the rice grains in the bowl. You will never have to worry about how many grains of rice are in your bowl again.

floor2.name: Slowly Sliding Ducks
floor2.description: Placid Plastic Duckがマルチプレイに？ レースにミニゲーム、さらに最大50人で集まれるプールまで？ そのとおり！ 友達とまったり過ごして、プールでいちばん気品あふれるアヒルになろう！

en.name: Slowly Sliding Ducks
en.description: Placid Plastic Duck in multiplayer? With races, minigames, and a shared pool for up to 50 players? Yes! Chill with friends and become the pool’s most distinguished duck!

floor2.name: 霜夜ゆく
genres: 選択方式アドベンチャー
floor2.description: 『霜夜ゆく』は方程式アドベンチャーゲームです。 密航者の〈少女〉と協力しながら、不用品を探して投棄しましょう。そして彼女を載せたことで発生した余剰重量——見た目よりいくらか、だいぶん、その、なんというか、かなり重いその重量を補いましょう。そして、まだ宇宙が完全に冷たく、冷え切ってはいないことを証明しましょう。さぁ、パイロット、あなたの出番です。

en.name: Cold Bed on Route
en.description: "Cold Bed on Route" is an equation-like adventure game. Work with to find and dump unwanted items. Then, let's make up for the excess weight caused by having her on board. And let's prove that the universe is not yet completely cold and frigid. Now, pilot, it's your turn.

floor2.name: The Legend Of Tiger And Phoenix
floor2.shortName: THE LEGEND OF TIGER AND PHOENIX
floor2.description: The Legend Of Tiger And Phoenixはエネルギーブラストと空中浮遊、そして透明人間の人生を経験することができるこれまでにないユニークなパリィ​/潜入ゲームです。

trailers.name: The Legend Of Tiger And Phoenix Teaser
The Legend Of Tiger And Phoenix Teaser 2
The Legend Of Tiger And Phoenix Gameplay Trailer

en.name: The Legend Of Tiger And Phoenix
en.description: The Legend of Tiger And Phoenix is a unique timing-parrying/infiltrating game that allows you to experience Fireballs, Energy Blast, ​levitating, and the life of an invisible man.

floor2.name: Wheel Make It
floor2.description: 1台の車椅子。2人のプレイヤー。無限大のカオス。チームワーク、ドタバタ、無敵の友情パワーを描くソロおよび協力プレイ対応の物理演算ゲーム。

en.name: Wheel Make It
en.description: One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos. Solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

floor2.name: ただお寿司食べよう！
genres: 没入シミュレーション
floor2.description: 最大4人で楽しめる、回転寿司体験シミュレーター！流れてくるネタを眺めて癒やされるも良し、ひたすら食べまくるも良し、友達と会話を楽しむも良し。 5つのモードで回転寿司屋ならではの魅力を心行くまで楽しみましょう！

en.name: Just Eat Sushi!
en.description: A revolving sushi simulator for up to 4 players! Relax and watch the plates go by, eat until you're stuffed, or just hang out and chat with friends.

floor2.name: カブトムシの森
floor2.description: 父親とカブトムシを捕まえに森を訪れた少年。夜の森を巡るうちに、異様な気配が少しずつ姿を現していく短編ホラーゲーム。

en.name: Beetle Forest
en.description: A young boy visits a forest with his father to catch rhinoceros beetles. As he wanders through the night forest, an eerie presence gradually begins to reveal itself in this short horror game.

floor2.name: The Bookwalker: Thief of Tales
floor2.description: The Bookwalkerは、本の中に飛び込む能力を持つ、作家から泥棒に転身したエティエンヌ・クイストとなってプレイするストーリー型アドベンチャーです。さまざまな力を使って現実と本の世界を行き来し、トールのハンマーやエクスカリバーといった伝説のアイテムを盗んで、執筆能力を回復させましょう。

trailers.name: The Bookwalker: Thief of Tales - Release Date Trailer
The Bookwalker: Thief of Tales - the MIX Trailer

en.name: The Bookwalker: Thief of Tales
en.description: The Bookwalker is a narrative adventure in which you play as Etienne Quist, a writer-turned-thief with the ability to dive into books. Use your powers to journey between reality and book worlds, and steal legendary items like Thor's Hammer and Excalibur to restore your ability to write.

floor2.name: Papetura
floor2.description: Papeturaは紙アニメーションで作られた独特な雰囲気のあるポイント＆クリックアドベンチャーゲームである。2匹の妖精、パペとチュラが「紙の世界」に害をもたらすモンスターたちに立ち向かう！

en.name: Papetura
en.description: Papetura is a short atmospheric adventure game, with unique world handmade entirely out of paper, and beautiful fragile music. It tells the story of two little creatures whose house is in danger of being burned down.

floor2.name: 你好！我们还有场恋爱没谈-番外篇
floor2.shortName: 你好！我们还有场恋爱没谈-番外篇
genres: インタラクティブフィクション
floor2.description: このゲームは単なる恋愛シミュレーションではありません——「サイバー試婚」体験です。あなたの一言一句、一挙一動が絶妙にバランスを変えていきます。天秤の行方はあなたが握っています：自分を貫くか、愛のために変わるか？問題から逃げるか、正直に向き合うか？約束が交わされる前の瞬間に戻り、最終的に天秤が真実の答えを示します。

en.name: 你好！我们还有场恋爱没谈-番外篇
en.description: More than a dating sim—this is your "cyber trial marriage." Each dialogue, choice, and interaction delicately shifts the balance. Will you stand firm or adapt for love? Confront or avoid the challenges? Rewind to before the promise is made, and let life's scales reveal where your heart truly leans.

floor2.name: Travellin Cats in Georgia
floor2.description: ジョージア州全体に隠れている100匹のネコを見つけよう！ このかわいい手描きの隠しネコゲームは、元祖バイラル「隠れネコ」ゲームのクリエイター Travellin Cats による作品です。 全部見つけられるかな？

en.name: Travellin Cats in Georgia
en.description: Find 100 cats hidden across Georgia in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator! Can you find them all?

floor2.name: Rhythm Sprout: Sick Beats & Bad Sweets
floor2.shortName: RHYTHM SPROUT: SICK BEATS & BAD SWEETS
genres: アクションアドベンチャー
floor2.description: オリジナルの楽曲と奇想天外なストーリーモードで展開する、スピード感溢れるリズムアクションゲーム。 リズムバトルでかわいいボスを倒し、好奇心をそそる3D環境でビートに合わせて走りましょう。さまざまなモードでレベルをアレンジして、挑戦とリプレイの楽しみが無限に広がります。 シュガーダディ王を止められるか？

en.name: Rhythm Sprout: Sick Beats & Bad Sweets
en.description: Enjoy chill Lo-fi walks and fight bosses to K-POP, EDM and Hip-Hop inspired tracks. Features a quirky story, 30 handcrafted levels and various EX-modes to refresh your gameplay.

floor2.name: Scritchy Scratchy
floor2.description: 『Scritchy Scratchy』はとっても満足感の高いスクラッチカードのインクリメンタルゲームです。スクラッチカードを大量に買い占め、自動スクラッチをアンロックし、特大ジャックポットを掴み取りましょう。安全にプレイするか、すべてを賭けるか？

en.name: Scritchy Scratchy
en.description: Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots. Will you play it safe or go all-in?

floor2.name: 古銭プッシャーフレンズ参
floor2.shortName: 古銭プッシャーフレンズ参
floor2.description: 江戸時代を舞台にした、オンライン協力プレイ型のコインプッシャーゲーム「古銭プッシャーフレンズ」のシリーズ3作目です。今作では、東海道五十三次をテーマにしたすごろくがあり、止まったマスによって様々なイベントが発生します。他のプレイヤーと協力して妖怪を退治したり、悪代官を成敗したり、ジャックポットを目指したりしましょう。ゲームを進めると様々な方法で能力アップできます。

en.name: Old Coin Pusher Friends 3
en.description: In this installment, there is a Sugoroku themed around the old Japan, with various events triggered by the squares you land on. Work together with other players to defeat yokai, and aim for the jackpot. As you progress in the game, you can enhance your abilities with various upgrades.

floor2.name: クジラゲームオンライン
floor2.shortName: クジラゲームオンライン
floor2.description: 【マルチプレイに対応】 キミはクジラをつくれるか！？ かわいい愉快な海の仲間たちをくっつけて、大きく成長させていくゲームです。 同じ種類の仲間をくっつけると、どんどん成長していきます。 たくさん成長させるほどスコアが大きくなるので、どんどん成長させていこう。

en.name: WhaleGameOnline
en.description: Can You Make a Whale? It's a delightful game where you connect cute sea creatures to make them grow bigger. Single Player and Multiplayer Modes! There are both a single-player mode and a multiplayer mode for competing with friends and rivals from around the world.

floor2.name: 光るだけしかない機械
floor2.shortName: 光るだけしかない機械
genres: インタラクティブフィクション
floor2.description: 光るだけしかない60分のアドベンチャー

en.name: Glow Box
en.description: A 60-minute adventure where all you do is glow.

floor2.name: Harvest Dice Profit
floor2.description: Harvest Dice Profitは、放置系インクリメンタル農業＆ダイスゲームです。ダイスキノコを育ててダイスを収穫し、ダイスを振って利益を稼ぎ、経済を自動化します。借金に追いつかれる前に成長を続けましょう...さもなければ、その代償を払うことになります。

en.name: Harvest Dice Profit
en.description: Harvest Dice Profit is an Incremental Idle Farming Dice Game where you grow diceshrooms into dice, roll for profit, and automate your economy. Stay ahead of debt... or face the consequences.

floor2.name: Miracle Heroes: Temporal Bounty Hunter
floor2.description: Miracle Heroes は、豊富な武器とアイテムの組み合わせを選んでプレイする、マルチプレイヤー対応のライト・ローグライクゲームです。各プレイごとに新しい体験が楽しめます。

en.name: Miracle Heroes: Temporal Bounty Hunter
en.description: Miracle Heroes is a multiplayer light rogue-like game. In the game, players must choose suitable combinations from a rich arsenal of weapons and items, with each playthrough offering a fresh experience.

floor2.name: ランダマックス
genres: 一騎当千方式シューティング
見下ろし型シューティング
floor2.description: 乱れる運を乗りこなせ！ プレイヤーの機転が試される新感覚縦スクローグライトSTG。 ランダムに誤配され続ける膨大な種類の武装。その中から最適解を見つけ出し、戦いの主導権を握ろう！

en.name: RANDOMAX
en.description: Ride or drive the turbulent waves of luck toward victory! A novel rogue-lite vertical scrolling Shmup that puts your resourcefulness to the test!

floor2.name: Shore Doodle –渚のお絵描き–
genres: デザイン＆イラストレーション
floor2.description: 起動すれば夏の砂浜はあなたのもの。砂浜を自由に歩き回り、木の枝で絵を描きましょう。描いた線が波に飲み込まれて消えるまでの短い時間で、どんな絵を描けるでしょうか。お絵描きしている間にも時間は流れて空の様子は変化します。たまに空を見上げると、そこに癒しや発見があるかもしれません。

en.name: Shore Doodle
en.description: Let's enjoy your own personal beach. Wander around at your leisure and use a branch to draw in the sand. What will you draw in the short time you have before the sea washes it away? The time-of-day changes as you draw, bringing you relaxation, and perhaps new discoveries...

floor2.name: 101 Cats: Melbourne
floor2.description: この冒険に参加して、手作りのメルボルンの風景の中に隠れている101匹の子猫🐾を見つけよう。🏆たくさんの実績を獲得しよう。何匹見つけられるかな😺？🔎急いで！⏱️

trailers.name: TRAILER - 101 Cats in Melbourne - PLAY NOW!

en.name: 101 Cats: Melbourne
en.description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Melbourne landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

floor2.name: ねこねこ釣り日記
genres: クリーチャーコレクター
floor2.description: 学びや仕事のお供に、静かに釣りをする癒しのパートナー。子猫のフィッシャーがデスクトップでのんびり釣りをしながら、あなたの作業をそっと見守る。たまに様子を確認して、新しい魚を見つけたり、釣り竿を強化したり、水槽を拡張したりするだけでいい。穏やかな時間を楽しもう。

en.name: Fischer's Fishing Journey
en.description: Put Fischer on your desktop as your ultimate study and work buddy. He'll fish quietly in the corner, taking care of it all—you just drop in occasionally to collect your rewards, unlock new fish, upgrade your rod, while enjoying that calming, healing atmosphere.

floor2.name: ８番出口
floor2.description: あなたは無限に続く地下通路に閉じ込められている。 周囲をよく観察し、「８番出口」まで辿り着こう。

en.name: The Exit 8
en.description: You are trapped in an endless underground passageway. Observe your surroundings carefully to reach "The Exit 8".

floor2.name: 蜀末：三国血月伝
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
floor2.description: 蜀末：三国血月伝は、プレイヤーが蜀の将軍の役割を担うターン制のローグライク カード ゲームです。ダンジョンを探索し、宝物を集め、カードのコレクションを蓄積します。カードと宝物の独特な組み合わせを作り、さまざまな敵に打ち勝ちます。

en.name: Three Kingdoms: The Blood Moon
en.description: Three Kingdoms: The Blood Moon is a turn-based Roguelike card game where you assume the role of a Shu general. Explore dungeons, gather relics, and amass a collection of cards. In each round, you can assemble a unique combination of cards and treasures to defeat your enemies and rewrite history!

floor2.name: ニンニク建築家
floor2.description: はユニークな建築ゲームです。 ガーリック・ファミリーの新世代ビルダー、ガーリック・ホワットとして、父親の建築ハンマーを受け継ぎ、様々な注文を受け、図面通りに、あるいは想像力を駆使して、顧客の奇妙な要求を満たすことができるだろうか？

en.name: Garlic Builder
en.description: Garlic Builder is a unique building game. As the new builder of the Garlic Family, can you inherit your father's building hammer, take various orders, follow the blueprint, or use your imagination to fulfill the strange needs of your customers?

floor2.name: 牛马
floor2.description: 最大8人でのオンラインマルチプレイ対応パーティゲーム。MODの共同制作も可能で、主な特徴は可愛い動物たちによる非対称対戦と、定番のジャンプアクションの楽しさです。

en.name: NiuMa
en.description: A party game that supports online multiplayer for up to 8 players, where you can also create mods together. It features asymmetric gameplay with cute animals and the beloved platforming fun.

floor2.name: Paragnosia
floor2.description: 部屋に設置されているレールに沿ってカメラを動かし、アパートの隅々まで監視しよう。超常的なアノマリー（異常）を見つけて写真を撮り、悪魔祓いをしよう。監視室に閉じ込められたあなたは、今夜の8ラウンドを乗り切れるだろうか？

en.name: Paragnosia
en.description: Observe every corner of your apartment by moving your camera along a rail that runs through the rooms. Find and take pictures of paranormal anomalies to exorcise them. Locked in your surveillance room, will you survive tonight's 8 rounds?

floor2.name: ゴブリン・ノーム・ホーン
floor2.shortName: ゴブリン・ノーム・ホーン
floor2.description: 手描きのグラフィックと愉快でシュールな世界観の2D横スクロールアクションゲーム

en.name: Goblin_Gnome_Horn
en.description: A 2D side-scrolling action game with hand-drawn graphics and a fun, surreal world view.

floor2.name: 血の百合怪談
floor2.description: 闇が深い女幽霊のホラーADV。オカ研の仲良し三人娘が深夜に集まり、怪談話に興じる。まさか自分たちの前に女の子を狙う「首絞め女」が現れるとは思いもせずに……

trailers.name: 闇が深い女幽霊のホラーADV『血の百合怪談』ＯＰ

en.name: Blood Lily Ghoststories
en.description: A horror game about a needy female ghost. A trio of close-knit occult club girls gather late at night to enjoy telling ghost stories. Little do they know that Miss Choker, a ghost that targets girls, is just dying to appear...

floor2.name: 失踪 - タケシ、お前の言う通りだった。あの廃村はヤバすぎる。
floor2.shortName: 失踪 - タケシ、お前の言う通りだった。あの廃村はヤバすぎる。
floor2.description: 「失踪 -タケシ。お前の言う通りだった。 あの廃村はヤバすぎる。」は、 行方不明になった親友を探すべく日本の廃村を探索する 一人称視点のホラーコメディゲームです。

en.name: Disappearance - Takeshi. You were right. That Abandoned Village is Too Bad
en.description: "Disappearance - Takeshi. You were right. That Abandoned Village is Too Bad" is a first-person horror-comedy game in which you search an abandoned Japanese village for your missing best friend.

floor2.name: Unwilling Host
floor2.description: これは、VHS風の演出が特徴的な、一人称視点の短編心理ホラーゲームです。恐ろしい存在と対峙することになるため、くれぐれもご注意ください。

trailers.name: 正式版宣传片/Official Release Trailer

en.name: Unwilling Host
en.description: This is a short, first-person psychological horror game with VHS effects. Be careful, you are facing a terrifying being.

floor2.description: 少女たちと一緒に楽しく数学をやろう！

en.description: Let's do some easy math with the girls!

floor2.name: Hidden Pets: 101 Cats in Vienna
floor2.description: この冒険に参加して、手作りのウィーンの風景の中に隠れている101匹の子猫🐾を見つけよう。🏆たくさんの実績を獲得しよう。何匹見つけられるかな😺？🔎急いで！⏱️

trailers.name: TRAILER - 101 Cats in Vienna - PLAY NOW!

en.name: Hidden Pets: 101 Cats in Vienna
en.description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Vienna landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

floor2.name: Glitchfall ~異変のある落ちものパズル~
floor2.shortName: GLITCHFALL ~異変のある落ちものパズル~
floor2.description: システムに異変を発見せよ！テトリス系パズルに観察ゲームをミックスした新感覚落ち物パズルゲームです。

en.name: Glitchfall
en.description: Detect system anomalies! A fresh take on falling block puzzles that mixes Tetris-style gameplay with observation challenges.

floor2.name: Factory Town Idle
floor2.description: Factory Town： Idel はインクリメンタルスタイルのタウンビルダーです。家や工場を建築し、アイテムを作る仕事を労働者に割り当て、完成品を販売してコインを稼ぎ、町の人々を幸福にしてから、終わることのない研究と改善にすべてを再投資してください。

en.name: Factory Town Idle
en.description: An entire town builder experience packed into a living spreadsheet. Build housing, assign workers, then craft and sell a huge variety of items to level up your town and expand your civilization across the world!

floor2.name: じゃあ、また
floor2.description: 「じゃあ、また」は別れに関係する物語。成長期の少年は、ある夏、時空を越えある人物と出会う。会った瞬間、少年の夏は、想像もできない不思議な夏へと変わる。

en.name: Once Again
en.description: Make up for lost time with Once Again, If you could travel through time, who’s the first person you’d meet? An interactive story about a boy who spends his summers wandering between past and present... After meeting her, summer will never be the same again...Who is she, and what journey awaits you?

floor2.name: Buckshot Roulette
floor2.description: ロシアンルーレット、12ゲージショットガン。入るは四人、出るは一人。命懸けの運試し。幸運を祈る。

en.name: Buckshot Roulette
en.description: Play Russian roulette with a 12-gauge shotgun. Four enter. One leaves. Roll the dice with your life. Good luck!

floor2.name: ARIDA: Backland's Awakening
floor2.description: ARIDA: Backland's Awakening. 歴史的なシングルプレイヤーゲームで、アドベンチャーとサバイバル要素を備えています。 ブラジルの荒野の物語を探求し、干ばつに立ち向かおう！

en.name: ARIDA: Backland's Awakening
en.description: ARIDA: Backland's Awakening. A story of survival and adventure in the brazilian backlands. Face the drought to explore the more arid regions, gather resources and discover clues about the fate of the young Cícera.

floor2.name: ジョイアクアリウム
genres: クリーチャーコレクター
floor2.description: 『ジョイアクアリウム』は、気軽に楽しめる魚育成ゲーム。プレイヤーは稚魚を育てて高く売り、得たお金で水草や流木などを追加したり、水槽を自由にレイアウトできる（色調やサイズも調整可能）。さらに、設備やフィルター、壁紙、音楽など、カスタマイズ要素も充実している！

trailers.name: Can be used as wallpaper JP

en.name: Joyquarium
en.description: Joyquarium is a relaxing casual fish-raising game. Buy various cute fry and sell them at a high price after they grow up. With the money you earn, you can purchase aquatic plants, driftwood, scenery stone, etc. to decorate your tank (you can freely adjust the color, size, and position).

floor2.name: 古銭プッシャーフレンズ２
floor2.shortName: 古銭プッシャーフレンズ２
genres: 没入シミュレーション
floor2.description: 江戸時代を舞台にした、オンライン協力プレイ型のコインプッシャーゲーム「古銭プッシャーフレンズ」のシリーズ2作目です。他のプレイヤーと協力して妖怪を退治したり、どくろの大群を退けたり、ジャックポットを目指したりしましょう。ゲームを進めると様々な強化や装備で能力アップできます。

en.name: Old Coin Pusher Friends 2
en.description: "Old Coin Pusher Friends 2" is an online cooperative coin pusher game set in the Edo period. Players work together to defeat yokai, repel skulls, and aim for the jackpot. As the game progresses, players can upgrade their abilities and equipment to become stronger.

floor2.name: Brotato
floor2.description: Brotatoは、トップダウン アリーナ シューターのローグライトです。一度に最大6つの武器を駆使してポテトを操作し、エイリアンの大群を撃退していきます。さまざまな特性とアイテムから選択して、自分だけのビルドにし、助けが来るまで生き残りましょう。

trailers.name: Full Release Trailer - Local Co-Op Update

en.name: Brotato
en.description: Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.

floor2.name: Love Letter
floor2.description: 姫に恋する何人もの若者たち…姫に恋文を渡すことができるのは誰？愛しい姫の心を手に入れるため、時にハッタリをかまし、時にはライバルを蹴落としながら、作戦を遂行しよう。 本作は、有名なカードゲームの公認を受けたデジタル版です。

en.name: Love Letter
en.description: The princess has several suitors... but which of them will manage to charm her? Choose a strategy, be it through bluffing or power of deduction, to win your beloved's heart. The official adaptation of the renowned card game.

floor2.name: ストッカーの中の死体っていくら？
floor2.shortName: ストッカーの中の死体っていくら？
floor2.description: 短編ビジュアルノベル。 ありふれた目的を胸に、ありふれた街で起こる、ありふれた物語。

en.name: How Much for the Body in the Freezer
en.description: Short visual novel. An all-too-familiar story, born from an all-too-familiar motive, on an all-too-familiar street.

floor2.name: FIND ALL 9: Fantasy
floor2.description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 9: Fantasy. You will explore the fairytale village, the colorful streets of the city of mages and the unique scenery of the soaring dragon islands. Look for hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.

en.name: FIND ALL 9: Fantasy
en.description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 9: Fantasy. You will explore the fairytale village, the colorful streets of the city of mages and the unique scenery of the soaring dragon islands. Look for hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.

floor2.name: holo8 -ホロハチ-
floor2.description: ループするホロライブ仮事務所から脱出しましょう。事務所をよく観察し、異変を見つけましょう。

en.name: holo8
en.description: Escape from the looping office. Observe the office carefully and look for any anomaly to reach the main entrance.

floor2.name: DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris
floor2.description: DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris is an intense mix of brick breaker, air hockey and bullet hell set in a post apocalyptic world. Destroy structures, dodge bullets, fire guns and buy perks to lay even more waste!

en.name: DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris
en.description: DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris is an intense mix of brick breaker, air hockey and bullet hell set in a post apocalyptic world. Destroy structures, dodge bullets, fire guns and buy perks to lay even more waste!

floor2.name: Zero Orders Tactics
genres: ターン制ストラテジー
floor2.description: 🌋⚔ ターン制のパズルストラテジーで、あなたは神です。ユニットを操作するのではなく、戦場を操作します！地形を操作し、ユニットを入れ替え、命令を一切出さずに彼らが戦いに勝利するのを見守りましょう！ ランダムな要素は一切なく、すべてが予測可能です。戦場は変化し続けます。あなたの一手ごとに。

en.name: Zero Orders Tactics
en.description: 🌋⚔ Terraforming + Into The Breach! An experimental puzzle strategy where you are not commanding your troops - now, you are shaping the battlefield itself! Nothing is random*, everything is predictable*, and the battlefield is changing. Every turn. By you.

floor2.name: 絶対遵守
floor2.description: 🌐 言語不要 【規則は絶対。破れば即、＂死＂】無人の雑居ビルからの脱出を目指す、一人称視点の短編脱出デスゲーム。ランダムに変化する規則を絶対に守り抜き、ギミックを突破して脱出せよ。

en.name: No exceptions
en.description: 🌐 Language Independent “Rules are absolute. Break them, and you die. No Exceptions.” Escape a building from the 10th floor in this death game. Each floor has prohibited actions. Break a rule and it’s game over. Don’t run. Don’t stop. Don’t look. Learn the rules. Obey them. Escape alive.

floor2.name: STAYHOMER
floor2.description: 全ての自粛違反者を”消毒”せよ

en.name: STAYHOMER
en.description: "Disinfect" all anti-lockdown protesters.

floor2.name: LOW VALUE JOB
genres: 没入シミュレーション
floor2.description: 机の上に散らばったボルトやナット、ワッシャーを種類ごとに仕分けるディストピア系の職業シミュレーションゲームです。あなたの仕事は、それらのパーツを一つずつ拾い上げ、観察し、正確に分類することです。オンライン対戦では世界中のプレイヤーと技術を競うことができます。

en.name: LOW VALUE JOB
en.description: LOW VALUE JOB is a dystopian job simulation game about sorting the bolts, nuts, and washers scattered across your desk by type. Your job is to pick up each part, examine it, and classify it accurately. In online matches, you can test your skills against players from around the world.

floor2.name: Dub Night Live
floor2.description: マイクを握って、インターネットの動画にアフレコしよう。Dub Night Liveはショートクリップの音声をミュートにし、あなたと最大8人のフレンドに配役を割り当てます。全員が一斉に録音を行い、録音中はお互いの声は聞こえません。そして、完成した映像をパーティー全員で一緒に鑑賞します。アプリ内エディターを使って自分だけのクリップを作成することも可能です。

en.name: Dub Night Live
en.description: Grab a mic and redub the internet. Dub Night Live mutes the cast of a short clip and hands the roles to you and up to 8 friends. Everyone records at once, nobody hears anyone, then the whole party watches the finished cut together. Build your own clips with the in-app editor.

floor2.name: Urbek City Builder
floor2.description: Urbek is a city building game where you can build your own neighbourhoods: from nightlife district to industrial district. Don't exhaust your natural resources before you have an educated population to build more efficient structures.

en.name: Urbek City Builder
en.description: Urbek is a city building game where you can build your own neighbourhoods: from nightlife district to industrial district. Don't exhaust your natural resources before you have an educated population to build more efficient structures.

floor2.name: Down in Bermuda
floor2.description: おかしな嵐に巻き込まれたとある冒険飛行家が、何十年もの間、悪名高いバミューダに取り残されてしまいました。奥地に潜むクリーチャーを倒し、島の秘密を解き明かし、帰る方法を見つけましょう。

en.name: Down in Bermuda
en.description: An unnatural storm leaves an adventurous aviator stranded for decades within the infamous Bermuda. Overcome creatures of the deep and unravel the islands secrets in search of a way back home.

floor2.name: タマゴクエスト
genres: 人生シミュレーション
floor2.description: 王国を守れるのはキミしかいない？ 守護霊となって勇者を育てあげ、闇の王に立ち向かえ！

en.name: Yolk Heroes: A Long Tamago
en.description: Someone has to protect this realm... is it you? Become a guardian spirit and raise your very own Hero to stand against the Dark Lord.

floor2.name: ITTA
floor2.description: 弾幕地獄とボス戦に特化した冒険に繰り出し、ITTAで自分の限界に挑戦しよう。父の残したリボルバーで武装する少女を、幽霊のように浮遊する不思議なネコが先に立って導く。行く手を阻む数々の試練、その先に待つ答えと平穏を求めて少女は戦い続ける。

en.name: ITTA
en.description: Test your limits in ITTA, a bullet-hell, boss-rush style adventure. Armed with her father’s revolver and guided by a strange ghostly cat, a displaced girl must battle her way through impossible trials in search of answers… and peace.

floor2.description: フルーツブームが始まった！谷へ駆け込み、収穫を集めて新記録を樹立しよう。このクレイジーなタイムアタックで実力を証明せよ！各レベルクリアの制限時間はわずか6秒！

en.description: Fruit season has started! Harvest them to make a new record. Show what you are really worth in this crazy time run! You have only 6 seconds to complete level, and to become the master farmer.

floor2.name: 超アロイレンジャー
floor2.description: 《超アロイレンジャー》は2Dサイドビュースクロールアクションゲームです。シューターのケリーや戦闘アンドロイド弐号として、危険に満ちた機械帝国にあるいろんなステージを挑み、新たな武器を解放します。ケリーの射撃と弐号のさまざまな必殺技で異常を起こした機械BOSSたちを倒しましょう。

en.name: Super Alloy Ranger
en.description: Super Alloy Ranger is a 2D side-scrolling action game. Play as Marksman Kelly or Combat Robot No.2 to challenge different levels within the dangerous Machine Empire and unlock new weapons. Use Kelly’s shooting and No.2’s deathblows to defeat abnormal Machine Bosses!

floor2.name: Re:Fresh
floor2.description: 可愛いらしい町民たちを助けながら、心地よい場所を冒険したり、ジャンプしたり、ダッシュして町を復興させましょう！動物やロボットでいっぱいの、絆の強いコミュニティの魅力に飛び込み、心温まるソーラーパンクアドベンチャーで町のヒーローを目指しましょう。

en.name: Re:Fresh
en.description: Restore your town as you run, jump and dash through cozy locales while helping lovable townsfolk! Become immersed in a tight-knit community of animals and robots while becoming the town hero in this heart-warming solarpunk adventure.

floor2.name: Hellsinker.
genres: 一騎当千方式シューティング
floor2.description: 多くのクリエイターに影響を与えた伝説のSTGが、進化してSteamに登場。ゲームシステム、ビジュアル、物語、そして音楽のすべてが一つの思想のもと高次元に融合したSTGの到達形！

en.name: Hellsinker.
en.description: A legendary SHMUP influential to the best makers in the genre, Hellsinker is now available on steam in its most advanced form! Gameplay, story, graphics, and even music all united into one cohesive and highly dimensional Shoot-em-up!

floor2.name: Puppet House
floor2.description: Puppet House is a puzzle-adventure horror with escape room elements. A freak ritual creates a killer puppet, murdering anyone who enters the ventriloquist’s mansion. Detective Rick, seeking missing locals, will soon face his greatest horror.

en.name: Sacabambaspis Chronicle
en.description: As a player, you become Sacabambaspis and live each day with your fellow Sacabambaspis, growing and evolving by swimming in the sea and eating plankton. Progress through the story with your companions in Sacabambaspis, and see what happens in the end.

floor2.name: Ultimate Godspeed
genres: 精密プラットフォーム

en.name: Ultimate Godspeed
en.description: Ultimate Godspeed is a party racing game. Place items on the track and bring chaos to the race! The goal: Create the shortest way for you or the most pain for your opponents.

floor2.name: Moon-Oriented Autonomous Biological Model

en.name: Bunker Tidy Up
en.description: Bunker Tidy Up is a relaxing game about organizing a bunker. Arrange 17,437 supplies on shelves, categorize resources, and relax!

floor2.name: 五目並べ レッツゴー
floor2.shortName: 五目並べ レッツゴー

floor2.name: Tchia

en.name: Tchia
en.description: A Tropical Open-World adventure. Climb, glide, swim, and sail your boat around a beautiful archipelago in this physics-driven sandbox. Take control of any animal or object you can find, and Jam on your fully playable Ukulele.

floor2.name: Realistic Ragdoll Sandbox

en.name: Realistic Ragdoll Sandbox
en.description: Realistic Ragdoll Sandbox is an immersive game that stands out for its realistic ragdoll physics, which together with various creation and damage tools, provides the player with a mix of realism and fun.

floor2.name: 指先農園
floor2.description: 「指先農園」へようこそ！これは忙しいワーカー向けに特化したデスクトップ放置ヒーリングゲームで、スクリーンの片隅を癒しの農園に変えてくれます。キーボードを叩く、マウスをクリックするといった日常的な動作だけで、作物が自動的に生長します。 ゲームにはポモドーロタイマー、タスクリスト、タイピング統計といった便利な効率化ツールが内蔵されており、娯楽と効率を両立させます。農作業の達成感と愛らしい生き物たちの癒しの力で、緊張した仕事の時間に柔らかな温かみを注ぎ込みましょう～

en.name: Typing Farmer
en.description: Welcome to Typing Farmer! This desktop idle healing game will make a corner of your screen a cozy farm. Your daily actions—typing and clicking—automatically foster crop growth, attract cute animals play with you. Let the healing charm of adorable creatures infuse your intense workdays~

floor2.name: Simple Fish Adventure
floor2.description: Simple Fish Adventure is an unusual short physics-based platformer. Jump like a fish, think like a fish, be a fish! Overcome obstacles and suffer. Also includes co-op for up to 4 players.

trailers.name: 《迷途猫的灵魂碎片》玩法展示 SC

《迷途猫的灵魂碎片》玩法展示

en.name: White Night Dream
en.description: White Night Dream is a card-based strategy rogue-lite game where a girl chases after a runaway cat on the streets at midnight. The game cleverly simulates the short yet long night through a simple card-flipping gameplay and a variety of interesting build combinations.

floor2.name: MainFrames
floor2.description: 『MainFrames』の主人公、フロッピーを紹介します！PCモニターのウィンドウとデスクトップで展開されるプラットフォーマゲームが登場しました。魅力溢れる世界を舞台に、いつまでもここにいたいと思わせる心優しい旅があなたを待っています。

en.name: MainFrames
en.description: MainFrames invites you to meet Floppy and to browse a clever and charming platformer that plays out entirely within the windows and desktop of a PC monitor. You won’t want to press the escape key on this cozy outing!

en.name: Idyll Isle
en.description: A cozy idle island sim for your desktop, in a slim window above the taskbar. Islanders of every trade farm, chop wood, fish, mine, and cook. Craft and place buildings, upgrade tools, and make the island the last livable place at sea. Then sail past the mist to rebuild five lost islands.

floor2.name: 神話構想スターノート
floor2.shortName: 神話構想スターノート

floor2.name: 地獄アパート

en.description: Team up with your friends with your pogo sticks and pass the obstacles! Reach the highest peak in this adventure playable with up to 4 friends. Pass through villages and caves, but be careful of the bosses. Let's see if you can reach the treasure waiting for you with your friends?

floor2.name: ワンダーボーイ：ドラゴンの罠
floor2.shortName: ワンダーボーイ：ドラゴンの罠
floor2.description: 探索、アクション、冒険がユニークにブレンドされた名作クラシックゲームが、美しい手描きアニメーションとオーケストラアレンジされた楽曲を伴ってここに蘇りました！

trailers.name: Wonder Boy: The Dragon's Trap - Steam launch trailer
Wonder Boy: The Dragon's Trap - Retro Feature trailer
Wonder Boy: The Dragon's Trap - Reveal Trailer

en.name: Wonder Boy: The Dragon's Trap
en.description: Boasting beautiful, hand-drawn animations and a re-orchestrated soundtrack, the cult classic returns with a unique blend of exploration, action, and adventure!

floor2.name: パドルパドルパドる
floor2.description: 痛みを乗り越えて漕ぎ出しましょう。ソロでもそうじゃなくても。1人1パドル。周りは溶岩だらけです。きっと落ちます。おそらく叫びます。泣くこともあるかもしれません。健闘を祈ります。

en.name: Paddle Paddle Paddle
en.description: Paddle through pain. Solo or co-op. One paddle each. Lava everywhere. You’ll fall. You’ll scream. You might cry. Good luck and embrace the salt.

floor2.name: プチゲームコレクション vol.1
floor2.shortName: プチゲームコレクション VOL.1
floor2.description: 『NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE』のスピンオフミニゲーム集。レトロなゲーム世界で超てんちゃんに会いましょう！

trailers.name: あめちゃんわくわくデートタイム

en.name: Petit Game Collection vol.1
en.description: A spin-off minigame collection of "Needy Streamer Overload". Meet your internet angel in this retro-style game world!

floor2.name: Nebulock
genres: ツインスティックシューティング
floor2.description: Nebulock is a short bullet-hell game with intense gameplay, where the player must destroy bosses made of blocks, collect resources and upgrade his spaceship.

en.name: Nebulock
en.description: Nebulock is a short bullet-hell game with intense gameplay, where the player must destroy bosses made of blocks, collect resources and upgrade his spaceship.

floor2.name: 20 Minutes Till Dawn
floor2.description: どんどん増加するラブクラフト系の敵を撃ち殺し夜を生き延びろ。色んなアップグレードを使い、ユニークで最強なビルドを選び出せ。色んなキャラを手に入れそれぞれのユニークな武器を活用しよう。

en.name: 20 Minutes Till Dawn
en.description: 20 Minutes Till Dawn is a survival roguelite where endless hordes of creatures lurk from the dark. Craft an array of overpowering builds and eradicate waves of Lovecraftian nightmares. Will you be able to survive the night?

floor2.name: Siege of Avalon: Anthology
floor2.description: Siege of Avalon is an isometric story-driven fantasy-RPG. The Citadel of Avalon is all that remains of the once-mighty seven kingdoms. The invaders have surrounded Avalon and the depleted garrison is bracing for the final assault. Now is the time for the birth of a legend.

en.name: Siege of Avalon: Anthology
en.description: Siege of Avalon is an isometric story-driven fantasy-RPG. The Citadel of Avalon is all that remains of the once-mighty seven kingdoms. The invaders have surrounded Avalon and the depleted garrison is bracing for the final assault. Now is the time for the birth of a legend.

floor2.name: 帝国の崩壊
genres: ターン制ストラテジー
floor2.description: 「帝国の崩壊」はディーゼルパンクを舞台にした戦争チェスゲームです。 ゲームのデザインは古典的なゲーム「ファミコンウォーズ」を参考にしています。 あなたは同盟と帝国という 2 つの戦線としてプレイし、さまざまな視点から戦争を体験します。

en.name: Empires Shall Fall
en.description: Empires Shall Fall is a turn-based tactics game set in a dieselpunk world. Upgrade your army and command your troops, then exploit terrain to eradicate your enemies with sheer power and sharp tactics.

floor2.name: The Excrawlers
genres: ハックアンドスラッシュ
floor2.description: Action-RPG slasher in which you have to get into the dark atmosphere of dungeons full of monsters and madness.

en.name: The Excrawlers
en.description: Action-RPG slasher in which you have to get into the dark atmosphere of dungeons full of monsters and madness.

en.name: Deadlock
en.description: Deadlock is a multiplayer game in early development.

en.name: Dear Passengers
en.description: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

en.name: Light No Fire
en.description: A game about adventure, building, survival and exploration together. Set on a fantasy planet the size of Earth.

en.name: Fable
en.description: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

en.name: Blight: Survival
en.description: Blight: Survival is a PvE Action-Horror Game set in a brutal medieval world. Play in solo or team-up with up to 3 friends as you face monsters and men in a tense battle for survival. How far are you willing to go?

en.name: Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000
en.description: Experience the brutal fusion of galactic strategy and grimdark warfare in Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000. Take command of iconic factions, customise your war machine, and engage in devastating battles as you carve a bloody warpath across the stars.

en.name: Resident Evil Veronica
en.description: Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica. In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.

en.name: Kingmakers
en.description: Go back in time to a war-torn medieval era with a vast arsenal of modern weapons, change the course of history, and save the future in this epic action/strategy sandbox. Build your kingdom, grab a gun, and lead an army of thousands into massive, real-time simulated battles — solo or in co-op.

en.name: Witchbrook
en.description: Discover magic and mystery in Witchbrook, a spellbinding witch life-sim for up to 4-players! Start your life as the newest resident witch in the bustling seaside town of Mossport. Make friends, find love, and discover a world filled with wonder and charm on the road to graduation and beyond...

en.name: ILL
en.description: A realistic first-person action horror game that takes you into a dark fort overtaken by a mysterious entity. Unpredictable monsters, a visceral dismemberment system, and realistic physics create an atmosphere of relentless terror.

en.name: Soulframe
en.description: From the creators of Warframe emerges a new Fantasy Action RPG. Forge your legend with blade, bow, and magick as you lead the charge against a world-devouring corruption.

en.name: ARK 2
en.description: Survive the past. Tame the future. Suddenly awakened on a primal world filled with dinosaurs and humans struggling for dominance, you must team-up with legendary heroes to confront powerful dark forces. Saddle up, and join the definitive next-gen survival experience with ARK 2!

en.name: METRO 2039
en.description: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

en.name: Unrecord
en.description: Unrecord is a single-player FPS that tells the story of a tactical police officer from the perspective of his body camera. As you work to solve a complex case, you'll need to use your tactical and detective skills to succeed.

en.name: Persona 4 Revival
en.description: Step into a Supernatural Turn-Based RPG Adventure Solve Mysteries, Strengthen Bonds, and Awaken Your Persona

en.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
en.description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

en.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
en.description: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

en.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
en.description: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

en.name: Tides of Annihilation
en.description: Tides of Annihilation is an action-adventure game steeped in the legends of King Arthur. When an otherworldly invasion shatters London, Gwendolyn, a lone survivor, embarks on a desperate quest to fight back and uncover the truth that lies beyond the veil.

en.name: Chrono Odyssey
en.description: Chrono Odyssey, A Next-generation Action MMORPG. Game features include awe-inspiring visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, a vast and intricately designed seamless open world, dynamic action-based combat mechanics based on time manipulation and extensive customization.

en.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
en.description: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.

en.name: State of Decay 3
en.description: Play as a community of survivors, build up your settlements with friends, and destroy zombies in State of Decay 3, the latest in the franchise from developer Undead Labs.

en.name: NAKWON: LAST PARADISE
en.description: NAKWON is a multiplayer zombie survival game set in urban South Korea. Venture into the city in the dead of night, and manage your shelter by day. Scavenge resources in a city crawling with the infected and hostile survivors. Survival is the only rule - trust no one, not even the living.

en.name: Vindictus: Defying Fate
en.description: Experience intense action brought to life with diverse, unique characters. Read your enemy’s attacks and strike back for maximum impact in Vindictus: Defying Fate. Immerse yourself in signature combat and a gripping narrative.

en.name: Chronicles: Medieval
en.description: Step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox set in the age of the Hundred Years' War. Explore a brutal but beautiful, historically grounded Europe, command armies in massive battles, leave a mark the chroniclers can't ignore as you make your name one fight at a time. What story will you write?

en.name: Railborn
en.description: Railborn is a survival game where you build your train piece by piece. Navigate a world entangled by branching tracks. Find rare plants to cultivate on your farms. Upgrade your train - manage its power systems, direct resource flow, and distribute water. Designed for 1 to 4 players.

en.name: Rooted
en.description: In this solo and multiplayer survival game, explore an ancient overgrown world full of dangers. Salvage, build, craft, hunt,.. and try to survive alone or with your friends in an evolving and fascinating post-apocalyptic environment. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.

en.name: PUBG: Black Budget
en.description: PUBG: Black Budget is an extraction shooter built around tension, survival, and the unknown. Join a classified operation and uncover the secrets of a mysterious island trapped in a time loop.

en.name: Alkahest
en.description: Alkahest is an Action-Adventure RPG set in a murky medieval world. Where satisfying melee combat with highly interactive environments takes center stage. Explore realistic locations, learn alchemy and make a name for your family.

en.name: Persona 6
en.description: The iconic RPG series returns! The highly anticipated next chapter delivers a bold, new standalone story blending heartfelt daily life and new characters with pulse-pounding, supernatural adventure. Whether it’s your first Persona game or you’ve been here since the beginning, this one’s for you.

upcoming.name: Rules of Engagement: The Grey State

en.name: Rules of Engagement: The Grey State
en.description: A horror-infused extraction shooter for squads of three. Crush monster hordes with devastating firepower in co-op PvE, or take on rival squads for The Vertex in PvP. Choose your battle, push as far as you dare, and make it out alive.

en.name: Emberville
en.description: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.

en.name: Showa American Story
en.description: Showa American Story is an RPG steeped in retro pop culture. In the late 1980s, a dominant Japan culturally colonized America. Resurrected from the grave, Chigusa Choko embarks on a road trip of combat, exploration, and growth across a world both absurd and strangely familiar.

en.name: Falling Frontier
en.description: Conquer a vast procedurally generated star system in Falling Frontier, a sci-fi RTS where intel and logistics are decisive factors. Design ships and raid enemy supply lines, lay minefields and construct recon stations, and ambush enemy forces within asteroid fields and nebulae.

en.name: Ardem
en.description: The zombies ended the world. You're going to switch it back on. Ardem is an open-world zombie survival game in an immersive handcrafted world. Restore electricity, rebuild vehicles, construct your base, and permanently reshape the world. Solo, co-op, or on up-to-64-player PvE, PvP, and RP servers.

en.name: Guild Wars 3™
en.description: Guild Wars 3 is an action-adventure MMORPG, a modern evolution of the genre that blends rich action-combat, character building, and skill collection. Set in the enchanting frontier of Orr, the world brims with mystery, magic, and wonder.

en.name: Haunted Paws
en.description: A cozy and spooky co-op adventure where two puppies rescue their owner from a haunted mansion. Customize your puppy, solve puzzles together, and defeat evil creatures. Play locally or invite a friend for free with Friend’s Pass.

en.name: Beautiful Light
en.description: Beautiful Light, a PvPvPvE tactical first-person extraction shooter where 6 squads of 3 operators are tasked with entering, securing, and extracting an artifact in a hostile, horrific environment. Face other operators and player-controlled anomalies, but beware: mistakes can risk your life and gear.

en.name: NO LAW
en.description: Welcome to Port Desire, a city that doesn't belong to anyone, but where everyone wants a piece. You’re Grey Harker, an ex-military attempting to live a quiet life after near fatal injuries in the field. All you want now is peace - but in a city of no laws, what you want isn’t always what you get.

en.name: The Bustling World
en.description: The Bustling World is an open-world RPG set in a fictional ancient China. Enjoy boundless freedom with features such as farming, crafting, building, management, crime, and exploration. Recruit your own army, stabilize the regime, and engage in diplomacy for an immersive experience.

en.name: Nirvana Noir
en.description: A noir adventure beyond time and space. The city of cosmic beings is under threat in two parallel realities - one where the Big Bang was never fired, the other exploding in color and sin. It’s up to you to solve the mysteries of the Bigger Bang in this follow up to the award-winning Genesis Noir.

en.name: Remnant Protocol
en.description: The assassination of the Blessed Mother has plunged the galaxy in darkness. Usurpers rule with absolute authority, and blood flows in rivers of red across the stars. Only the Protocol can restore Her light.

en.name: Bioneers
en.description: A strategy and simulation game set in a microworld. Build an organism from cells, automate biological processes, and fend off viral attacks. Explore the world, unlock mutations, and evolve into a predator, parasite, or herbivore. Survive, adapt, and grow

en.name: Highreach
en.description: When calamity struck, the world of Highreach was shattered. In this open-world survival game, build encampments, rescue survivors, and soar across the skies on your airship to explore a lost world and uncover the truth.

en.name: SECOND-LOOP™
en.description: Half-Like with Mech。In the SECOND-LOOP™, you're a hero mech pilot in the heart of a futuristic dystopian world. Use your enhanced gravity manipulation power to assemble objects.

en.name: B-17 Flying Fortress The Bloody 100th
en.description: Manage and take control of the 10-man crew of a B-17 Flying Fortress as they attempt to complete 25 harrowing missions inspired by the real-life battles of The Bloody 100th Bomber group.

en.name: Bagdex
en.description: Monster taming with base building! Collect over 160 creatures, manage and customize your base, conquer challenging battles, and unravel the mystery behind this fantastic world!

en.name: Project TurboBlast
en.description: Drift, boost, and spin around corners at BLASTING SPEEDS in this stylish Singleplayer + Multiplayer Arcade Racing game, Blending the familiar drifting of Kart racers and tight responsive handling of classic Anti-Gravity racing games. With a focus on being easy to pick up but difficult to master.

en.name: SKINWALKER: First Blood
en.description: Skinwalker is a hack n’ slash action platformer where you swear allegiance to a formidable beast to save your daughter from a terminal illness. Shapeshift into the creature’s monstrous form and wield untamed wrath in exchange for its freedom and the promise of a cure.

en.name: Killer Chat! - Expanded Edition
en.description: Killer Chat! Expanded Edition fleshes out our serial killer dating chatsim to make it bigger, better and bloodier than ever before! Play as a writer, pretend to be a serial killer, get inspiration for your book, and try not to call the cops as you fall in love with your murderous beau of choice.

en.name: Rhapsody in Scarlet
en.description: Set in the jazz-filled streets of 1920s New York, magus Ellie Myers embarks on a journey to confront a threat that could shake the world. Experience exhilarating combat and stack up combos with beasts and magick in this all-new action adventure game!

en.name: Lost Track
en.description: Survive alongside your companions in the outskirts of a town after a supernatural experimental accident. Gather survival resources, upgrade your vehicles and mobile fortress, and explore unknown areas to gradually uncover the truth behind the experiment…

en.name: Steel Bounty
en.description: Dive into an immersive first-person mech simulation featuring extensive customization and mercenary company management. Battle for glory and wealth in a dynamic campaign where your choices shape the course of the war.

en.name: Totemic
en.description: Totemic is an action-adventure game set in a beautiful pixel art world. You play as Mara, a young woman equipped with an enchanted axe and the ability to absorb her foes powers and use them as her own.

en.name: Afterconflict
en.description: A brutal tactical FPS focusing on unflinching realism and equipment accuracy, set during the twilight days of what was once the Cold War.

en.name: Dreampainters
en.description: Put your creativity to the test in this first-person puzzle game! Discover the surreal world of an artist's dreams and use a paintbrush to unfold its mysteries with striking colors. Or grab a friend to paint your dreams together in two-player co-op mode!

en.name: World of Slime
en.description: World of Slime is a casual MMORPG where you capture, collect, and grow with all kinds of slimes. Find new slimes through field capture, synthesis, and fishing, then take them with you into battles, exploration, and puzzles.

en.name: Scarlet Lake
en.description: Delve into a retro survival horror where everything is not what it seems. You control Ben Murphy, a detective sent to investigate the strange on-goings in a small town, only to be caught in a nightmare surrounded by terrifying creatures. What dark mysteries will you uncover in Scarlet Lake?

en.name: Far North Survival
en.description: FAR NORTH SURVIVAL is an open-world survival game set in the unique setting of a vast ice-bound area beyond the Arctic Circle.

en.name: HIPS N NOSES
en.description: HIPS N NOSES is a café management simulation! In a sleepless world, Mela is the only one who dreams. She runs a café that restores lost memories. Serve guests by day, battle in nightmares by night to collect the memory flower, customize your café, and become the most renowned owner!

en.name: Quiet Express: Cabin 909
en.description: “Do you know anything about Cabin 909?” In Quiet Express: Cabin 909, you spend seven days on the titular train, journeying from one side of the continent to the other.

en.name: Adopt Me Please
en.description: Welcome to the Softlight Shelter. The animals are cute. The coffee is warm. Your job: vet the strays and find them a home. But keep your eyes open. Mimics are hiding in perfect pet disguises with Innocent eyes, waiting to get inside. Are you sheltering a pet... or a Mimic?

en.name: Heistline
en.description: Choose your side – cop or criminal! Keep criminals locked up or escape, rob stores, and build your crime empire. Play with friends, create bases, and earn bounties. Action, strategy, and adrenaline-filled gameplay await!

en.name: ATOM RPG 2
en.description: A New Open-World Era of ATOM Begins! 1,225 km² of the Caspian Wastes! Open-world survival game with a story-rich CRPG soul, co-op or alone, vehicles, sandbox, crafting, and strange encounters.

en.name: KinForge
en.description: KinForge is a co-op, creature-collector action RPG where every fusion of powers creates new experiences, wild combos, and the strength to fight against spreading Corruption. Forge bonds with Ancient Elementals, beings of the Mystic Realm, and restore a world on the brink of collapse.

en.name: Mossfield Origins
en.description: A small cozy community builder where all buildings are based on the same foundation! Take your time, build a sustainable community for your residents in this relaxing game, with no time pressure or external forces. Upgrade foundations via tech tree to redefine and refactor your space.

en.name: Crimson Banner: War of Liberation
en.description: Command the Chinese People's Liberation Army in Crimson Banner: War of Liberation. Fight through the campaigns of the Chinese Civil War in a turn-based wargame played on a hex grid.

en.name: Scaredy Cats
en.description: Where resource management meets dungeon crawler. Collect rare loot, strategize monster encounters, and push your luck to descend to the bottom of the dungeon!

upcoming.name: Urban Yuri: A Lady's Romance Manifesto

en.name: Urban Yuri: A Lady's Romance Manifesto
en.description: Welcome to the Yuri story full of women! Play as an urban lady, would you choose your haunting-crush, assertive ex-girlfriend, cute best friend, mystery online friend, or...?

en.name: The Unworthy
en.description: What if Hell made a mistake? Based on the testimony of a man who survived clinical death, this cinematic psychological horror challenges you to confront your fears and fight your way back to life, while something lurking in the darkness does everything it can to keep you among the damned forever.

en.name: HushWood
en.description: You are the new ranger of a quiet forest reserve. Carry out your daily duties, explore the dense forest, and document any violations you encounter. Of course, it's just an ordinary forest. Nothing unusual ever happens here 😉

en.name: BREAKOUT BABY
en.description: BREAKOUT BABY is a blood-pumping, Pac-Man–infused, first-person horror roguelike where you must help a poor baby escape to the surface. Run from creatures, scoop up pellets, and shake your baby to survive.

en.name: Son of Thanjai
en.description: A spoiled prince is betrayed, exiled, and remade into something far more dangerous than a king. Outnumbered and alone, take an empire apart from the inside, with deception, fear, and the Surul Vaal, in a cinematic action-adventure set in an alternate-history medieval South India.

en.name: Times of Survival
en.description: Times of Survival is a co-op zombie survival game with souls-like inspired combat system, set in a post-apocalyptic world. Fortify your base, fight hordes of zombies and battle epic bosses. Explore, craft, and master punishing combat while building your settlement and leading survivors to hope.

en.name: Sakura Arms ~Radiant Duels~
en.description: Sakura Arms is a unique on-the-spot deck-building card game. Choose two Megami, combine their martial arts, anticipate your opponent’s tactics, and build a 10-card deck after seeing both sides’ selections.

en.name: Forest Hills: The Last Year
en.description: Enter the nightmarish world of Forest Hills, where you and four other Displaced try to survive, fight back and ultimately escape a horrifying Fiend in this unique horror asymmetric game.

en.name: Idle Cave Miner 2
en.description: Idle Cave Miner 2 is an idle incremental game about mining resources, crafting items, and improving your team of miners. Discover unique worlds, battle monsters, and strengthen your team on your quest to explore the mines, and find out what secrets lay at the bottom.

en.name: Arcticide
en.description: Explore dangerous procedural cities and landscapes in this gritty survival FPS with roguelike elements. Face harsh environments, hostile mercenaries, and mutant horrors as you navigate a dying near-future Arctic.

en.name: Terminus: Day Zero
en.description: Terminus: Day Zero is a free, short zombie survival adventure set in the world of Terminus: Zombie Survivors. On the first day of the outbreak, Daisy is home alone, and the dead are getting closer. Hide, shut the doors, and run.

en.name: Medieval Builders: Strongholds & Castles
en.description: Craft, hunt, and survive in fantasy medieval world. Build your village, manage and defend castles and whole kingdoms. Become a local lord and a builder. Strongholds & Castles are waiting for you to manage them - alone or with your friends!
